title: Azure AI/M365 Copilot Search - Architect
description:
Job Description - Azure AI/M365 Copilot Search Architect

**Key Responsibilities**

- Design and implement enterprise GenAI search architectures leveraging Azure AI Search and Microsoft 365 Copilot search to deliver reliable, scalable, and intelligent discovery experiences across the organization.
- Architect retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns and semantic search solutions, selecting appropriate vector search, hybrid ranking, and grounding strategies for enterprise knowledge bases.
- Analyze business requirements from diverse stakeholder groups and translate them into detailed search solution designs that balance relevance, latency, security, and cost.
- Configure and optimize indexing pipelines for structured and unstructured data, ensuring consistent ingestion, enrichment, skillset application, and normalization across multiple content repositories.
- Develop search relevance strategies including semantic ranking, vector embeddings, scoring profiles, synonym management, and domain-specific tuning to improve precision and recall for business-critical queries.
- Configure Microsoft 365 Copilot search connectors, semantic index integration, and Graph-based retrieval to surface organizational knowledge within Copilot experiences.
- Collaborate with application engineering teams to integrate search and GenAI capabilities into web portals, internal tools, and customer-facing applications using appropriate SDKs and APIs.
- Define and implement security and access models, ensuring search results respect data access policies, sensitivity labels, regulatory constraints, and privacy requirements.
- Lead client-facing architecture and consulting engagements, presenting solution designs, conducting technical workshops, and advising stakeholders on GenAI search strategy and roadmap.
- Monitor search system health by tracking relevance metrics, query latency, index freshness, and grounding quality, and recommend remediation to maintain high availability.
- Conduct capacity planning and performance testing for search and GenAI workloads, predicting growth patterns and optimizing resource utilization across cloud environments.
- Create detailed technical documentation for architectures, configurations, and runbooks, enabling operations teams to support and evolve search platforms efficiently.
- Provide guidance on migration strategies from legacy search platforms to Azure AI Search and Copilot-based solutions, minimizing disruption and ensuring continuity of critical services.
- Mentor junior engineers and architects on GenAI search technologies, design patterns, and best practices, fostering a culture of technical excellence and knowledge sharing.

**Required Skills**

- Hands-on expertise with Azure AI Search (index design, skillsets, semantic and vector search, scoring profiles).
- Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot search, Graph connectors, and semantic index integration.
- Proven experience designing GenAI search solutions, including RAG architectures and embedding-based retrieval.
- Strong background in search architecture and solution design for enterprise environments.
- Demonstrated client-facing architecture and consulting engagement experience.

The Key Skills are Azure AI Search, Microsoft 365 Copilot Search

along with GenAI search solutions, Search Architecture , Solution Design, Client-facing architecture, and consulting engagements.

title: Bilingual (English/Spanish) Legal Services Associate
description:
Position Only Available to Residents of Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, North Carolina, Virginia, Texas, Utah, Idaho, Tennessee, Missouri, Ohio, or Arizona.

We're on a mission to help the world work Anywhere. Whether working from home, an office, or Anywhere, we offer products and services designed to help people work and learn together, whether they're across a table or across the world. Work is what we do, not where we do it. We are looking for a Bilingual Legal Services Associate to join our team! Please see below for more information:

As a successful Bilingual Legal Services Associate, You’ll be

  • Lowering your carbon footprint by commuting less.

  • Modeling a better work-life balance.

  • Answering phone calls as a legal receptionist for our legal clients, in both English and Spanish.

  • Taking messages for law firms, transferring calls, and recording client information.

  • Helping attorneys globally care for their clients, allowing them to practice and work Anywhere.

You Are

  • Able to think quickly on your feet.

  • An excellent communicator, verbally and in writing, in both English and Spanish

  • Passionate about customer service, bringing a warm and upbeat tone to every interaction.

  • Enthusiastic about learning.

  • Able to work at a computer for your entire scheduled shift.

  • A good, empathetic listener with an emphasis on verbal soft skills.

  • Not afraid of experiments and thinking outside the box.

  • Comfortable with legal language and sensitive situations.

Your System

We operate on a 'Bring Your Own Device' policy and there are certain system requirements that must be met in order to ensure our applications can work successfully on your computer. The full system and internet requirements can be found here.

Work is what you do, not where you do it. We’re on a mission to help the world work Anywhere. We believe people should be able to work and learn together, whether they’re communicating across a table or across the world.

We offer a diverse set of products and services to a variety of businesses, from live answering services to scheduling and payment platforms to shared working spaces. We empower people to communicate, collaborate and produce. We’re committed to building a more inclusive future of work, where people can contribute from Anywhere.


What "Anywhere" Means to Us

Other terms out in the world are “remote” “distributed” “telecommuting” – for us, these words do not speak to the experience we hope you will have working with us Anywhere.

Isolation and a lack of social interaction are common concerns when people think about Remote working. The word “Remote” itself can conjure up ideas of loneliness and being disconnected from your colleagues. That’s why we like the more empowering language of “working Anywhere”, with Anywhere representing an unconstrained, plugged-in destination.

AnywhereWorks is committed to providing equal opportunity employment; creating, managing, and valuing diversity in our workforce; providing a safe work environment; and fostering a culture of belonging where all employees are included, treated with dignity and respect, promoted on their merits, and placed in positions to contribute to our future success.

We comply with all requirements of the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) to ensure the privacy and rights of our applicants are protected.

Equal Opportunity

title: Senior QA Engineer (Mobile)
description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior QA Engineer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation. We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

We champion modern, balanced working and offer a hybrid setup, asking you to collaborate in person 2 days a week from either our Glasgow, Edinburgh or Dundee offices.


Key Duties and Responsibilities

As a Senior QA Engineer, you will operate as a trusted quality champion, guiding engineering teams to define QA approaches for complex features and implementing scalable automation frameworks. You will lead collaborative defect triage sessions, design automated non-functional tests (NFRs), and help teams establish smart test data strategies. Acting as a supportive technical mentor, you will foster engineering growth through constructive code reviews and collaborate closely with developers to make our systems naturally easier to test.

  • Strategy & Collaboration: Shaping testing approaches for complex features, embedding risk analysis into the workflow, and guiding exploratory testing efforts.

  • Framework Architecture: Building and evolving modular, reusable, and scalable automation components, and seamlessly integrating quality checks into CI/CD pipelines.

  • NFR Integration: Designing and automating tests for performance, security, and accessibility to ensure quality is built-in from the very start.

  • Mentorship & Growth: Supporting and mentoring other QAs to help them grow their skills, and providing encouraging, constructive feedback through peer code reviews.

  • Community & Inclusion: Leading QA knowledge-sharing sessions and owning community initiatives such as accessibility or regression standards.

What you'll bring:

We know that excellent QA professionals come from all backgrounds, and no one matches a job description 100%. If you meet the core requirements below and are excited about the role, please apply—we value potential, adaptability, and diverse perspectives just as much as checkboxes!

  • Automation Expertise: Proven track record as a Lead or Senior QA Engineer with a deep understanding of test automation strategy and setup.

  • Mobile Testing Mastery: Extensive, hands-on experience building and scaling mobile automation suites across iOS and Android from the ground up.

  • Automation Toolkit: Hands-on experience working with mobile automation frameworks such as Appium, Detox or Maestro, along with Postman for API testing.

  • CI/CD & DevOps: Proficiency with Git and experience integrating automated quality gates into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions).

  • Relationship & Communication Skills: The ability to balance speed, quality, and risk while building trusted partnerships and managing client stakeholder expectations with empathy and clarity.

The Recruitment Process

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Acquisition Partner who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!).

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Open sollicitatie
description:
Staat jouw ideale baan er nu niet tussen? Reageer dan op deze open vacature. Wanneer we een mogelijke match zien, nemen we je op in onze talentpool. Zodra er een passende functie vrijkomt, nemen we contact met je op.

Op zoek naar een stage?

Wij ontvangen regelmatig berichten van enthousiaste mensen die op zoek zijn naar een stageplek. Dat waarderen wij. Onze stagevacatures komen twee keer per jaar op onze website: in het voorjaar voor de stages die per september starten en in oktober voor de stages die per februari starten. Sollicitaties naar stageplekken op deze vacature worden niet in behandeling genomen. Houd onze werkenbij-website in de gaten om op de hoogte te blijven van onze actuele stageplekken.

Werken bij ’t Kabouterhuis betekent werken in een omgeving waar iedereen wordt gedreven door hetzelfde: het jonge kind en hun ouders. Baby’s, peuters en kleuters die nog zo kwetsbaar zijn dat iedere stap telt en iedereen hier voelt: dit is waarom we dit werk doen.

Onze teams zijn bevlogen, multidisciplinair en staan altijd naast elkaar én naast ouders. Samenwerken is hier geen slogan, maar hoe we elke dag werken, en dat maakt dat mensen hier jarenlang blijven. Je komt terecht in een warme, betrokken groep professionals waar gelijkwaardigheid de standaard is en je altijd kunt terugvallen op collega’s.

De doelgroep - wat ons werk het mooiste werk maakt!

Het hele jonge kind, daar moet je echt voor willen gaan. Je werkt met gezinnen waar veel gebeurt en waar kwetsbaarheid groot is. Met alle disciplines samen puzzel je aan het totaalbeeld: wat speelt er écht? En wat heeft dit jonge kind en de directe omgeving nodig? Dat maakt het werk uitdagend, verdiepend en ontzettend betekenisvol.

Om te zorgen dat wij altijd blijven leren en samen groeien werken wij volgens het Infant Mental Health (IMH) principe. We zien het jonge kind altijd in de context waarin het opgroeit: de relatie met ouders, het netwerk, en de omgeving. Dat vraagt om een systemische blik, een open houding en veel kennis van ontwikkeling, hechting en regulatie.

Klaar om samen het verschil te maken voor het jonge kind?

title: Senior Analytics Engineer (100% Remote) (LATAM Only)
description:
About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent is a leading remote staffing company, offering top-tier professionals working 100% remote to businesses worldwide. Specializing in IT and software development, design, administrative support, digital marketing, and more. AllShore connects organizations with skilled talent to meet diverse business needs.

About The Role

Our client is expanding its modern data and analytics capabilities and is seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer with strong expertise in analytics engineering, dimensional data modeling, DBT, and cloud-based data platforms. This role is heavily focused on designing and building scalable analytical data models that support reporting, business intelligence, and modern analytics initiatives across internal departments. Candidates should have strong hands-on experience with dimensional modeling concepts such as facts, dimensions, star schemas, and Kimball methodology, along with practical experience using Databricks and cloud analytics tooling.

The ideal candidate is a strong SQL and analytics engineering professional who can work independently, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and deliver production-ready data solutions in enterprise environments.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics Engineering & Data Modeling (Primary Focus)

  • Design and implement scalable analytical data models using dimensional modeling best practices

  • Build and maintain fact tables, dimension tables, star schemas, and reporting datasets

  • Develop and manage DBT transformations, models, and analytics workflows

  • Create scalable ELT pipelines using Databricks, SQL, Python, and cloud-based technologies

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business and reporting requirements into reliable data solutions

  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across analytics environments

  • Support modern analytics initiatives using Microsoft Fabric, SQL endpoints, and related tooling

  • Use Terraform or Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tooling to manage data platform resources

  • Contribute to AI-enabled analytics initiatives, integrations, and modern data platform enhancements.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Provide light support for legacy Microsoft reporting environments (SSRS), on an as-needed basis only.

Required Qualifications (in priority order)

  1. Strong hands-on experience with DBT and analytics engineering workflows, including deep expertise in dimensional data modeling:

    • Facts and dimensions

    • Star schema design

    • Kimball methodology

    • Analytical warehouse modeling

  2. Hands-on experience with Databricks, including SQL, Python, and PySpark; advanced SQL skills for data transformation and analytics engineering

  3. Experience using Terraform or Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tooling

  4. Experience with Microsoft Fabric, especially SQL endpoints and analytics workloads

  5. Experience supporting AI-enabled analytics initiatives, copilots, agents, or modern AI integrations — candidates who can help teams adopt AI tooling are a strong differentiator for this client

  6. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills

  7. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Familiarity with Power BI or enterprise reporting environments

  • Experience modernizing legacy BI/data environments

  • Familiarity with Azure Data Factory, Synapse, or related Microsoft cloud analytics services

  • Experience with data quality frameworks, monitoring, or testing practices

Who You Are

  • You are an analytics-focused data professional with strong business and technical understanding

  • You excel at translating reporting and analytics requirements into scalable data models

  • You are comfortable working independently and collaborating across multiple teams

  • You bring strong ownership, communication, and problem-solving skills

  • You are confident explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Non-Technical Requirements (weighted equally to technical skills)

  • Strong spoken English

  • Reliable home/office connectivity and consistent meeting/standup attendance

  • Full Mountain Time working-hours overlap required

Engagement Details

  • Independent contractor role

  • Fully remote

  • 32 - 40 hours per week

  • Full-time, long-term commitment

  • Hourly rate: $23.75–$25 USD depending on experience

title: Senior Product Owner (on-site 1 day/week)
description:
gravity9 is a boutique IT consulting company headquartered in the UK with offices in the US, Canada, Poland, Ireland, and Colombia. Our team has deep experience in engineering, experience design and product management. We enjoy a challenge and pride ourselves on working with our clients on their most complex problems, finding elegant and flexible solutions that help them transform their businesses.

Role Overview

The Product Owner is accountable for defining and delivering solutions that drive real business and customer outcomes within a complex IT environment. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery—ensuring the team is always working on the right things and making measurable progress.
You will create clarity where there isn’t any, align stakeholders who don’t always agree, and drive delivery forward—consistently.

Location & Work Model

Work Model: Hybrid (4 days remote / 1 day on-site)

On-site Location: Client office located on the Las Vegas Strip

Frequency: 1 day per week (Fixed day to be coordinated with the team)

Availability: The candidate must be available every working day for at least 1–2 hours between 14:00/15:00 and 16:00 CET (5:00/6:00 AM to 7:00 AM PST/Las Vegas time), so they can collaborate with the Poland team in real time.

Commitment & Commute Requirements

We are looking for a candidate who is already based in, or willing to relocate to, the Greater Las Vegas Metropolitan Area or within a comfortable, reliable driving distance for a weekly commute. Because our client relies on regular, face-to-face collaboration once a week, candidates must have dependable transportation and be comfortable navigating a weekly commute to the Las Vegas Strip.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog aligned to business outcomes

  • Translate needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria

  • Partner with engineering to deliver incremental, high-quality value

  • Lead Agile ceremonies and enable team effectiveness

  • Drive decisions and manage tradeoffs across value, risk, and timelines

  • Build strong understanding of customer needs and business goals

  • Navigate a broad, complex stakeholder landscape across business and IT

  • Communicate priorities, progress, and risks with clarity and consistency

  • Coordinate across teams and dependencies to ensure end-to-end delivery

Core Experience

  • Product Owner/Product Management experience in Agile environments

  • Proven ability to work in large, complex IT organizations

  • Acting as the primary product contact for day-to-day client questions and coordinating issue investigation with the engineering team

  • Ability to break down complex problems into actionable work

  • Strong communication and data-driven decision-making skills

  • Experience with tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar

  • A basic technical understanding of SQL, APIs, data, and system integrations

  • Being comfortable with hands-on UAT and problem investigation

What It Really Takes

  • Drive: You take ownership, push work forward, and create clarity without waiting

  • Curiosity (Understand the Why): You dig beyond requests to solve the real problem and challenge assumptions

  • Grit: You navigate ambiguity, constraints, and resistance—and see things through

  • Stakeholder Navigation: You manage stakeholders who disagree, drive alignment where possible, and move forward without perfect consensus

  • Relentless Communication: You communicate more than feels necessary—ensuring priorities, decisions, and context are always clear

Success Looks Like

  • Clear priorities and consistent delivery of business value

  • Stakeholders aligned—or at least moving forward—despite differences

  • Risks addressed early and progress maintained in complex environments

  • A team that is focused, productive, and solving the right problems

Bottom Line

Great Product Owners don’t just write stories—they drive clarity, navigate complexity, and deliver outcomes through drive, curiosity, gritty execution, and constant communication.

title: Badhoevedorp - Firefighting Instructor
description:

For our training center in Badhoevedorp, we are looking for a driven and passionate Firefighting Instructor (m/f/d) who wants to enable people to work safely and optimally prepare them for emergency situations in offshore environments.

Who Are We?

At FMTC Safety, everything revolves around people and safety. We are a fast-growing, global organization preparing professionals to work safely in some of the world’s most demanding environments: from offshore platforms and wind farms to ships and industrial sites.

What makes us different?

We go where our clients need us. With training centers strategically located around the world, we offer maximum flexibility: in timing, location, and delivery. Our mindset is simple: we make it happen. Even if there’s only one participant, the training goes ahead. This requires more than just knowledge, it requires passion, flexibility and a true customer-first mentality. And that’s exactly what defines our instructors.

As a Firefighting Instructor in Badhoevedorp, you don’t just deliver courses, you create impactful learning experiences that truly prepare people for real-life emergencies.

What will you do?

  • You will train participants daily to manage various emergency incidents, including:

    • fires in internal accommodations,

    • hazardous materials,

    • spilled chemicals,

    • radiation incidents,

    • fires involving flammable liquids,

    • rescues from heights and confined spaces,

    • and aircraft fires and crashes.

  • Guide participants through realistic and hands-on exercises

  • Create a safe, energetic and engaging learning environment

  • Uphold the highest safety standards, because in this role, rules and procedures are non-negotiable

What do you bring?

  • Experience as an instructor is a plus - your mindset matters most.

  • Experience as a firefighter

  • Good command of English

  • A proactive, flexible, and hands-on attitude

  • A genuine passion for safety, training and working with people

  • Experience in an offshore environment, airport, industrial complex or local government where aircrafts are used

  • You understand the relevant standards, including OPITO, STCW, NOGEPA, and GWO

  • A serious commitment to safety rules and protocols, because the well-being of our participants is our top priority

Why FMTC?

  • Work in a truly international and fast-growing environment

  • Take ownership and make a visible impact from day one

  • Grow with us through training, certifications, and development opportunities

  • Experience an open, informal culture with short lines and big ambitions

Not yet fully qualified? No problem! If you have the right attitude and a passion for safety, we’ll provide the training you need to succeed.

title: Bilingual Client Experience Associate
description:
Position Only Available to Residents of Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, North Carolina, Virginia, Texas, Utah, Idaho, Tennessee, Missouri, Ohio, or Arizona.

We're on a mission to help the world work Anywhere. Whether working from home, an office, or Anywhere, we offer products and services designed to help people work and learn together, whether they're across a table or across the world. Work is what we do, not where we do it. We are looking for a Client Experience Associate to join our team! Please see below for more information:


Your Role

  • Please watch: A Day in the Life of a Client Experience Associate

  • You will be taking customer calls, capturing incoming leads, taking orders, and scheduling appointments, while working from the comfort of your own home.

  • In this role, you will be taking inbound calls and forwarding messages to our clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • You will work from your computer for the duration of your shift and regularly work 40 hours per week with a minimum of 8 hours on Fridays, Saturdays, and Mondays.


Your Skills

  • An excellent communicator, verbally and written in both English & Spanish (fluent in both languages).

  • Growth mindset, and is excited to learn new things.

  • Passionate about customer service, bringing a warm and upbeat tone to every interaction.

  • People-focused, friendly and knows how to listen.

  • Dependable and shows up when expected.

  • Above-average computer skills, including typing.

  • The ability to stay calm and efficient under pressure.

  • Willingness to complete an introductory learning and development phase at satisfactory levels.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Starting at $16.00/hour.

  • Benefits are available after 60 days of employment.

Your System

We operate on a 'Bring Your Own Device' policy and there are certain system requirements that must be met in order to ensure our applications can work successfully on your computer. The full system and internet requirements can be found here.


About AnywhereWorks

Work is what you do, not where you do it. We’re on a mission to help the world work Anywhere. We believe people should be able to work and learn together, whether they’re communicating across a table or across the world.

We offer a diverse set of products and services to a variety of businesses, from live answering services to scheduling and payment platforms to shared working spaces. We empower people to communicate, collaborate and produce. We’re committed to building a more inclusive future of work, where people can contribute from Anywhere.


What "Anywhere" Means to Us

Other terms out in the world are “remote” “distributed” “telecommuting” – for us, these words do not speak to the experience we hope you will have working with us Anywhere.

Isolation and a lack of social interaction are common concerns when people think about Remote working. The word “Remote” itself can conjure up ideas of loneliness and being disconnected from your colleagues. That’s why we like the more empowering language of “working Anywhere”, with Anywhere representing an unconstrained, plugged-in destination.

AnywhereWorks is committed to providing equal opportunity employment; creating, managing, and valuing diversity in our workforce; providing a safe work environment; and fostering a culture of belonging where all employees are included, treated with dignity and respect, promoted on their merits, and placed in positions to contribute to our future success.

title: Amsterdam - Instructor Offshore Safety
description:
Do you thrive on inspiring others, sharing knowledge, and making a real impact through hands-on training? Are you someone who takes ownership, embraces variety, and feels at home in an international and fast-moving environment?

For our training center in Amsterdam, we are looking for a driven and passionate Offshore Safety Instructor (m/f/d) who wants to enable people to work safely and optimally prepare them for emergency situations in offshore environments.

Who Are We?

At FMTC Safety, everything revolves around people and safety. We are a fast-growing, global organization preparing professionals to work safely in some of the world’s most demanding environments: from offshore platforms and wind farms to ships and industrial sites.

What makes us different?

We go where our clients need us. With training centers strategically located around the world, we offer maximum flexibility: in timing, location, and delivery. Our mindset is simple: we make it happen. Even if there’s only one participant, the training goes ahead. This requires more than just knowledge, it requires passion, flexibility and a true customer-first mentality. And that’s exactly what defines our instructors.

Your Role as an Offshore Safety Instructor

As as Offshore Safety Instructor (m/f/d) in Amsterdam, you are at the heart of our training center.

You don’t just deliver courses, you create impactful learning experiences that truly prepare people for real-life offshore emergencies.

What will you do?

No two days are the same and that’s exactly what excites you.

You take full ownership of your trainings and:

  • Deliver BOSIET (Basic Offshore Safety Induction and Emergency Training) and FOET (Further Offshore Emergency Training) courses

  • Execute and continuously improve training sessions for helicopter safety, sea survival, firefighting and emergency breathing systems (EBS)

  • Guide participants through realistic and hands-on exercises, including underwater escape (HUET) and self-rescue scenarios

  • Create a safe, energetic and engaging learning environment

  • Uphold the highest safety standards, because in this role, rules and procedures are non-negotiable

What do you bring?

  • Experience as an instructor is a plus - your mindset matters most

  • Ideally, certifications in BOSIET/FOET/OPITO (or the willingness to obtain them)

  • Good command of English

  • A proactive, flexible, and hands-on attitude

  • A genuine passion for safety, training and working with people

  • Experience working offshore or in maritime environments is a strong advantage

  • A serious commitment to safety rules and protocols, because the well-being of our participants is our top priority

Why FMTC?

Because here, you don’t just join a company—you become part of a journey.

  • Work in a truly international and fast-growing environment

  • Take ownership and make a visible impact from day one

  • Grow with us through training, certifications, and development opportunities

  • Experience an open, informal culture with short lines and big ambitions

Not yet fully qualified? No problem! If you have the right attitude and a passion for safety, we’ll provide the training you need to succeed.

title: 3D Artist (Talent Pool)
description:
Please note, this listing is not for an immediate open position but for our Talent Pool for 3D Artists.

We are continuously looking to connect with talented and experienced 3D Artists, who have an extensive background specifically in product advertising to join our talent pool. Whether your strength lies in modeling, texturing, shading, lighting, animation, or rendering. We're interested in hearing from artists who are passionate about creating high-quality, visually striking content.

We are also looking to connect with Compositing Artists experienced in product visualization and/or the automotive field with strong skills in Nuke and After Effects.

About INDG

INDG is a technology company specializing in large-scale CGI content creation, digital twin production, and automated content generation at a global scale. Our clients span all consumer product industries: food and beverage, beauty and luxury, personal care, health and hygiene, automotive, healthcare, fashion, and consumer electronics.

INDG blends over two decades of industry expertise with proprietary tech to transform physical products into digital twins, rich content, and interactive experiences for any platform. INDG combines artistry with CGI expertise to virtualize content production.

About Grip

As INDG's software branch, Grip is an end-to-end content automation platform that generates infinite ad variations by combining CGI, rule-based generative AI, and post-production into an easy-to-use automated content generation platform that transforms master ad creatives into endless variations—empowering brands to scale content production globally without compromising on quality or brand consistency.

What You'll Do:

  • Contribute to various stages of the 3D content creation process: modeling, texturing, shading, lighting, animation, and/or rendering.

  • Collaborate with artists, creatives, and project managers to deliver high-end visuals.

  • Work with different pipelines depending on project requirements and software environments.

  • Propose and implement improvements in visual quality, efficiency, or workflows across 3D production.

  • Stay aligned with quality benchmarks and delivery standards.

Would be amazing if you have:

  • Professional experience in one or more 3D software such as 3ds Max, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, V-Ray, Redshift and Clo3D.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating skill and attention to detail across the 3D process.

  • Understanding of form, light, texture, and visual storytelling in a 3D context.

  • Familiar with the process of integrating 3D elements in live-action footage.

  • Ability to work in a structured and team-oriented environment.

  • Excellent English communication skills.

The Procedure

Please send your resume and portfolio in English via the link provided. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact our Recruitment Department at jobs@indg.com.

After reviewing your application, if there’s a potential fit, a member of our recruitment team will be in touch with you.

INDG Grip handles and uses personal data of job applicants in line with its Recruitment Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to contribute to our mission to improve our patients' health and their lives. This is a hybrid role for our office in London (UK) or Sofia (BG)

Who you are

  • You’re a software engineer with at least 5 years commercial experience

  • You have a genuine enthusiasm for software engineering and take no greater pleasure than finding the right solution to the problem at hand and making practical tradeoffs

  • You are excited about contributing to a product that can drive positive change to the lives of millions of people around the world

  • You have strong ownership mindset - “you build it, you run it”

  • You’re eager to continuously learn, grow and step out of your comfort zone

  • The idea of working in a successful, high growth startup in a fast paced role excites you


What you will do

Develop scalable & reliable systems

  • Develop core functionality for our own customer facing and internal products, systems and data platforms, and e-commerce capabilities using modern frameworks

  • Develop extensible platforms and architectures that make it possible to quickly and efficiently launch new products and lines of business

  • Develop and maintain integrations with third party systems

  • Develop the APIs powering the web & mobile platforms for our product portfolio

Drive impact in a team environment

  • You’ll work with other software engineers, designers, QAs, product managers, business stakeholders and domain experts

  • You’ll drive impact and own your work end2end - from scoping & planning, architectural design decisions, implementation and testing, to production deployment and operations.

  • At least 5 years of commercial experience as a software engineer or equivalent

  • Familiarity with scalable cloud architectures, design patterns and best practices

  • Practical experience with CI/CD and IaC (Infrastructure-as-code)

  • Readiness to quickly learn PHP (our main BE language for the moment)

  • Experience with databases & data management practices - relational databases & search engines

  • Experience with TDD and testable code - unit / integration / performance testing

  • Great verbal and written communication skills and the ability to explain complex ideas in a simple way to non-engineering teammates

  • Ability to zoom in and out - be comfortable with getting into the relevant low-level details while also making the optimal tradeoffs for achieving the “big picture” goals

  • This is a hybrid role and you need to be based in London (UK) or Sofia (BG) so you can be in the office 3 days per week


Experience you may have

  • A degree in CS or equivalent is a plus

  • Practical experience with building scalable & highly reliable cloud systems that support product used by millions of users around the world 24/7

  • Familiarity with modern JS frameworks

  • Experience working in cross functional teams

  • An eye for user behaviour and design and attention to detail



Our recruitment process

  • Team fit interview: you'll meet with product & tech leaders

  • Case study: a take home tech task to assess your software engineering skills

  • Tech interview: you'll meet with tech team and discuss your case study solution

  • 2 Interviews with members of the executive team

  • Offer



ABOUT MANUAL

MANUAL delivers healthcare at scale thanks to its comprehensive digital clinic. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lives for a large part of the population in the UK, Brazil, and beyond focusing on life-impeding conditions like hormonal imbalance, obesity and hair loss.


MANUAL has steadily grown since inception and is now serving 500k+ patients, across 2 geographies. We are centralising the diagnosis, custom medications, doctor specialist services, behavioural change and fully vertically integrated management of the treatment journey, under one roof and consumer brand.


We’re destigmatising how people approach their health by offering easy access to diagnostics, a holistic range of treatments, ongoing care and medical advice, as well as a community to help proactively improve one’s health and wellbeing. A place that didn't exist until now.


Innovating on healthcare delivery, MANUAL provides patients with engaging treatment plans generating superior clinical outcomes: 90%+ of patients see an improvement in their Quality of Life (QoL) within 6 months. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lifespan for a big part of the population in the UK, Brazil and beyond,


After a $30 million Series A round, we are on a mission to build one of the most impactful teams in the healthcare space. We are looking for incredibly ambitious, entrepreneurial, driven and fun people to join us as we accelerate our growth and expansion. This is an exciting time to join the UK’s fastest-growing healthtech and help supercharge our mission.

title: Senior CG Art Director – Automotive (AI-Driven)
description:
At INDG we're looking for a Senior CG Art Director, who will be responsible for continuous creative oversight and creation of stills for our wide range of clients in the automotive industry. INDG does all things 3D, focusing on presenting physical products in digital space in all sorts of interesting ways.

About INDG

At INDG we develop technology that enables engaging, hyper-realistic digital product experiences. Our goal is to make "every product playable", by combining the science of technology with the artistry of computer-generated content. Our offices are in Amsterdam, Bucharest and New York. Clients include Honda, Acura, Yamaha, Adidas, Ralph Lauren, Electrolux, and Philips. Our CG artists, interactive designers, and developers focus on creating virtual versions of our clients' products, so lifelike it feels like you could reach out and touch them.

Our culture brings together creative, tech and business individuals. It’s a heady cocktail that keeps us inspired, empowered and passionate.

We're seeking a CG Art Director with strong 3D experience and a solid background in car photography who can lead virtual shoots creatively and technically, while leveraging the power of AI to craft stunning automotive visuals. With exceptional composition, lighting, and art direction skills, you'll guide an international team of experienced 3D artists to push boundaries and deliver unparalleled visual experiences. The ideal candidate has an entrepreneurial mindset, a deep understanding of the automotive industry, and a drive to own projects from concept to delivery.

What will you be doing?

  • Conceptualizing and communicating ideas: Develop pitch decks, style proposals, storyboards, sketches, concept art, mood boards, and mock-ups to articulate concepts to clients and teams.

  • Interpreting client briefs: Identify client needs and translate them into clear, actionable directions for the team.

  • Brand integration: Understand each brand's unique essence and ensure seamless integration of creative elements into its universe.

  • Driving visual uniqueness: Infuse every project with innovative, visually distinct ideas while meeting objectives and client expectations.

  • Leveraging AI tools: Incorporate AI-powered image generation tools to create cutting-edge concepts and expand creative possibilities in automotive visualization.

  • Coordinating teams and QA: Lead in-house and external teams, provide feedback and approvals, troubleshoot technical challenges, and ensure renders achieve top-tier quality.

  • Overseeing production: Manage all stages of production, ensuring projects meet creative and visual standards from concept to delivery.

Would be amazing if you have:

  • Experience in the automotive industry: Proven expertise in automotive-focused projects, with a strong understanding of the industry's specific visual and technical demands.

  • Background in car photography: An eye for automotive composition, lighting, and storytelling that translates seamlessly into the CG space.

  • Experience: 8+ years in a similar position, with a portfolio showcasing your exceptional eye for detail and ability to push boundaries in automotive visualization.

  • Product love: A passion for cars, motorcycles, and marine engines, paired with an understanding of their unique needs and how they work.

  • People skills: Comfort in interacting directly with brands and leading a diverse, global team of talented artists.

  • Strong technical and creative skills: Expertise in composition, lighting, and CG visual standards, with a keen understanding of the latest trends in automotive visualization and AI technology.

  • Hands-on attitude: While primarily directing, you're comfortable diving into production when needed and can independently handle smaller projects from start to finish.

  • Deadline resilience: Thrive under pressure and lead teams through tight deadlines.

  • AI curiosity: Interest or experience in using AI tools to drive innovation in visual storytelling.

  • Fluency in English: Clear communication in a fast-paced, international environment.

Working at INDG

At INDG we develop technology that enables engaging, hyper-realistic digital product experiences. Our goal is to make "every product playable", by combining the science of technology with the artistry of computer-generated content. Our offices are in Amsterdam, Bucharest and New York. Clients include Adidas, Honda, Yamaha, Ralph Lauren, Electrolux, and Philips. Our CG artists, interactive designers, and developers focus on creating virtual versions of our clients' products, so lifelike it feels like you could reach out and touch them.

Our culture brings together creative, tech and business individuals. It’s a heady cocktail that keeps us inspired, empowered and passionate.We’re committed to excellence, and we’re always looking for more people who want to focus their care and attention on making beauty scalable through technology.

What do we offer?

Apart from an amazing team of enthusiastic professionals to learn from and a warm atmosphere where your input is welcomed and valued, we offer a comprehensive package to keep you happy. With the role being located in the heart of Amsterdam, our environment and our creative space are very important to us. We offer a competitive salary, paid annual leave, an office overlooking the Amsterdam canals, training and self-improvement plans, get fit schemes, a pool table, darts, fresh fruits, snacks, and dinner options each evening for those staying later than working hours.

title: Investigator - Lafayette, LA
description:
Grow with us! We are featured in Inc. Magazine's prestigious 2023 Inc. 5,000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies List and are the 25th fastest-growing private company in the entire state of Louisiana!

Do you find satisfaction in helping people and making a difference in their lives and the lives of their communities? Laborde Earles is committed to providing quality representation to our clients and being fully attentive to their needs, which starts by providing the same favorable environment for our team members. Join us in standing up for our clients, with our community, by our work, and beside each other!

The Opportunity

Expanding Personal Injury Law Firm is seeking a personable and service-oriented Investigator to create a welcoming first impression for prospective clients. In this role, you will meet with potential clients, guide them through the sign-up process, gather case information, and, when needed, assist with transportation to appointments.

We're looking for an empathetic, self-motivated professional with experience in sales, customer service, or client relations who excels at building trust and delivering an exceptional client experience. As part of our Investigator Team, you will play a key role in helping qualified leads become valued clients. This position requires excellent communication skills, professionalism, and availability for a rotating on-call schedule for evenings and weekends.

Objective

Provide support for the day-to-day operations of the intake department and other general duties.

Desired Outcomes

  1. Accountable to sign up new cases.

    • Meet with potential clients and complete intake paperwork.

    • Demonstrate ability to converse with varying client personalities to collect pertinent details.

    • Responsible for demonstrating the highest level of customer service.

    • Fully investigate accident scenes, take photographs, obtain accident reports and insurance information and verify all parties by requesting documentation.

    • Obtain witness statements if applicable.

    • Report outcome of intake appointment to appropriate office staff in a timely manner.

  2. Accountable to provide general office and intake support.

    • Act as backup to intake team whenever sign up schedule allows.

    • Assist with maintaining data integrity on intakes and associated records.

    • Maintain a minimum of 30 sign up packets with current version of all documents.

    • Maintain stock of the assigned copy machine and intake fridge and proper shredding and disposing of assigned shredder box and bin contents.

    • Complete various job-related errands for all positions in the firm.

    • Provide back up for absent support staff.

    • Travel to other office locations to deliver inter-office envelopes and other job related items or packages.

    • Assist with management of intake referrals.

    • Provide general office maintenance on as as needed basis.

    • Additional responsibilities as assigned by Intake Team Lead, Investigator Team Lead or firm leadership.

  3. Accountable to maintain assigned Laborde Earles vehicle(s).

    • Bring vehicles for routine maintenance and cleaning.

    • Keep track of mileage and schedule oil changes and tire rotations when appropriate.

    • Maintain cleanliness of assigned vehicles (interior and exterior) so that they are presentable to clients at all times.

Skills/Abilities

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

  • Attention to detail and accuracy

  • Confidentiality and strong judgment

  • Problem analysis and problem-solving

  • Valid driver’s license

  • Willingness to perform any/all tasks as assigned by handling attorney, supervisor and/or firm leadership in support of the firm’s growth and success

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • 1-3 years general clerical, sales and/or customer service experience in a high paced office

Physical Requirements

  • Driving for up to 4 hours at a time

  • Must be able to stand up for 30 minutes at times

  • Must be able to work weekends and evenings as needed

The Perks of Being Part of Our Laborde Earles Community

  • Optional companywide events allowing you to play as hard as you work, such as Crawfish Boils, Christmas parties, Retreats, and more!

  • Work-life balance is encouraged as we consider 36.5 hours your full-time requirement and we rarely exceed a 40-hour workweek. We prefer you work to live, not live to work.

  • We celebrate life's little (& big) moments with you from birthdays & work anniversaries to marriages and births, as well as, support you when the going gets tough from procedures/hospitalizations to loss of a loved one.

  • Collaboration and team member rapport is cheered and emboldened.

  • We offer many competitive benefits upon eligibility waiting periods:

    • Company-paid Short-term disability & Life/AD&D;

    • Health, vision, dental, long-term disability, critical illness, and additional life insurance policies upon eligibility waiting periods;

    • 401(k) upon eligibility waiting periods;

    • PTO, paid holidays (10), and paid maternity leave;

    • Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), including dependent care;

    • Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Who We Are

We are a team and community-oriented personal injury law firm dedicated to winning for our clients who have had their lives turned upside down from injuries through no fault of their own. With multiple offices across Louisiana, we focus on ensuring people get maximum monetary compensation for various types of personal injuries or loss of a loved one from incidents like car wrecks, truck accidents, offshore, and workplace injuries. Our founders joined forces to build the premier law firm in Louisiana. With over 250 years of combined experience, our attorneys have earned a powerful reputation and have been nationally recognized as top trial lawyers. As a dedicated and high-performing team, we pride ourselves in our core values: All In, Work Hard, Play Hard, Honorable, Cutting Edge, Community, and Winners, Not Whiners. With all the proper tools in place, our mission is to stand up for our clients, stand with our community, stand by our work, and stand beside each other. You may begin your journey with Laborde Earles for many different reasons, but you stay for the team.

Our Core Values

All In: Being fully committed to a task or endeavor. Giving 110% for the team and our common goals.

Work Hard, Play Hard: Emphasizing work life balance. Putting in the hard work for the clients that depend on us as well as turning work-mode off sometimes to add fun, laughter, and relaxation into our routines.

Honorable: Making moral and just decisions, having an ownership mentality, being reputable and respectable through your work product, client and teammate interactions, and personal and family life.

Cutting Edge: Having the most advanced or newest version of a product or service, ensuring that we are functioning at our highest capacity as a firm, both effective and efficient.

Community: Being a pillar for the surrounding area and the people within by rallying for and supporting them through giving back and volunteering. Supporting the constant growth and improvement of ourselves and each other.

Winners, Not Whiners: Being a team-player even when the going gets tough to support the goals of our team and the firm, maintaining a positive outlook through the day-to-day challenges and setbacks, celebrating the wins and successes, being willing to step in and help for the sake of the common goals we strive to achieve.

title: Klantadviseur Schade
description:
*In deze functie werk je volledig op kantoor in Zoetermeer, thuiswerken is hierbij niet mogelijk.*

Kies voor een serieuze carrière-upgrade als Klantadviseur Schade bij KCD en verdien direct een uitstekend startsalaris van € 18 bruto per uur. Met een direct KCD-contract en een gezonde werk-privébalans laat je onregelmatige uren, repetitieve belscripts of administratieve sleur definitief achter je.

Jouw status-upgrade: Geen simpele belbaan, maar complex dossierbeheer

Als Klantadviseur Schade bij KCD ben je geen 'callcenter-operator' die haastig telefoontjes afwikkelt. Jij bent een volwaardige Schade specialist in de dop. Klanten bellen jou op de meest kwetsbare momenten: na een aanrijding, bij waterschade of stormschade aan hun woning.

Jij bent de regisseur van het dossier. Je luistert niet alleen, je analyseert:

  • Analyseren en beslissen: Je duikt diep in de schadedossiers van Interpolis Particulieren, toetst de polisvoorwaarden en neemt zelfstandig dekkingsbeslissingen over claims.

  • Puzzels oplossen: Geen enkel dossier is hetzelfde. Jij ontrafelt complexe situaties, weegt belangen af en bepaalt of een schade gedekt is.

  • Adviseren met impact: Je legt complexe beslissingen helder, empathisch en overtuigend uit aan de klant. Jij biedt rust en duidelijkheid wanneer mensen dat het hardst nodig hebben.

Waar je terechtkomt: Altijd gecoacht, nooit alleen

Wij geloven niet in eenzame starttrajecten thuis aan de keukentafel achter een laptop. Bij KCD kom je terecht in een warm, hecht en ontzettend gezellig team. Vanaf dag één ervaar je de kracht van échte verbinding:

  • Persoonlijke Buddy: Je staat er nooit alleen voor. Je krijgt vanaf je eerste werkdag intensieve, live 1-op-1 begeleiding en coaching van een vaste, ervaren buddy op de werkvloer.

  • On-site start voor maximaal succes: Je start je inwerkperiode volledig op ons kantoor in Zoetermeer. Tijdens dit live traject van 5 weken fulltime leiden we je stap voor stap op (we vragen je dan ook om in deze periode geen vakantie te plannen), zodat je de systemen, het vak én je collega’s direct goed leert kennen.

  • Hybride vrijheid zodra jouw KPI’s op orde zijn: Zodra je de inwerkperiode succesvol hebt doorlopen en we er zeker van zijn dat je de functie onder de knie hebt, stap je over op ons flexibele hybride model: je werkt dan 2 dagen per week comfortabel vanuit huis (inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding).

Waarom dit jouw ideale volgende stap is:

  • Direct een top startsalaris: Een bruto uurloon van € 18 bruto per uur.

  • Direct zekerheid: Vanaf dag één krijg je een eigen KCD-contract. Wij investeren in jouw toekomst.

  • Geen examenstress of studiedruk: In tegenstelling tot veel andere financiële functies is er bij ons geen zware Wft-studiedruk en geen officieel, extern wettelijk examen met faalrisico. Wij leiden je intern, praktijkgericht en zonder stress op tot volwaardig expert.

  • Uitstekende reiskostenregeling: Werk je op kantoor? Dan worden al je kantoordagen volledig gecompenseerd via een dekkende kilometervergoeding.

  • Hybride werken: Zodra je zelfstandig aan het werk kan, werk je tot 2 dagen per week thuis met een fijne thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Een ijzersterk merk op je cv: Je werkt exclusief voor het betrouwbare merk Interpolis.

Wat neem je mee?

Je hoeft nog geen achtergrond in de verzekeringswereld te hebben—wij leren je het vak van A tot Z. Wel herken je jezelf in de volgende punten:

  • Minimaal mbo-4 werk- en denkniveau.

  • Een scherp analytisch vermogen (je vindt het leuk om complexe dossiers uit te pluizen en de details te snappen).

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift.

  • Ervaring in een klantgerichte of administratieve omgeving (bijvoorbeeld horeca, retail, hospitality, zakelijke dienstverlening of traditioneel klantcontact).

  • Een flinke dosis leergierigheid en de wil om samen met je team te winnen.

  • Een beschikbaarheid van minimaal 28 uur en maximaal 40 uur per week.

Solliciteren is heel eenvoudig!

Heb je zin om je tanden te zetten in uitdagende schadedossiers en wil je deel uitmaken van een gezellig, hecht team in Zoetermeer? Dan maken we heel graag kennis met je.

Solliciteren kost je slechts 1 minuut. Klik op de sollicitatiebutton en laat je gegevens achter. Wij nemen al binnen 2 werkdagen telefonisch contact met je op voor een laagdrempelig kennismakingsgesprek.

title: Financieel Controller
description:
Je vindt hier een korte omschrijving van deze vacature. Nog vragen? Of benieuwd of dit een passende rol voor jou is? Neem contact met ons op!

Als Financieel Controller versterk jij het financiële team, bestaande uit zeven collega’s. Jullie verzorgen de financiële administratie van het bedrijf en gelieerde entiteiten. Je ondersteunt bij de maand-, periode- en jaarafsluitingen en bij financiële projectadministratie. Op termijn kun je ook het hoofd administratie vervangen bij afwezigheid. Naast het dagelijkse werk, denk je ook mee in optimalisatie en automatisering van de processen.

Dit familiebedrijf is al een aantal decennia actief in civiele en bouwkundige projecten in binnen- en buitenland. Creativiteit, vakmanschap en kennis spelen een grote rol. Het is een dynamische organisatie waar ze veel bezig zijn met innovatie en het creëren van nieuwe ontwerpen en oplossingen.

Met jouw cijfermatige inzicht en nauwkeurige werkwijze ben jij de geschikte aanvulling van dit team. Je werkt graag samen, maar pakt ook zelfstandig zaken op. Ook durf je jouw verantwoordelijkheid te pakken. Daarnaast heb je:

  • Mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau met een afgeronde opleiding in een financiële richting;

  • Ervaring met Excel, affiniteit met ICT;

  • Ervaring met projectadministratie en kennis van wet- en regelgeving is een pre.

In deze rol is het essentieel dat je vloeiend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft vanwege de communicatie met klanten en collega’s. Ook is de voorkeur dat je in de omgeving van de werkgever woont, in verband met (deels) werken op kantoor.

If you are a Senior Frontend Engineer with experience, please read on!


NutriSense is a 100% remote health-tech startup on a mission to optimize metabolic health and prevent chronic diseases through personalized nutrition for All. We are VC-backed and tech-forward. Over the last 12 months we have experienced a 6x increase in revenue, currently experiencing 10% MoM increase in new customers. Our customers range from the ultra-healthy trying to take their life to new levels to the diabetic trying to manage their disease. title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Waracle are looking for a Principal Product Manager for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role working from our London office 2 days a week.

Shaping the Future of Product at Waracle

Are you a collaborative product leader who thrives on bringing clarity to complex spaces and lifting up the teams around you? As a Principal Product Manager, you will act as a vital champion for our growing Product Practice, operating as a trusted advisor to executive and C-suite stakeholders. In this highly collaborative multiplier role, you won't just manage products—you will architect the very discovery and delivery frameworks that empower our cross-functional squads to succeed. If you are a holistic thinker who loves bridging the space between Product, UX, and Delivery, and you enjoy mentoring the next generation of product talent, we would love to welcome your perspective to our team.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Strategic Vision: Developing the 3–5 year strategic focus for high-stakes propositions, blending deep research with collaborative insights to uncover new market opportunities.

  • Discovery Architecture: Leading inclusive, cross-functional discovery programmes that turn ambiguous business challenges into clearly validated product journeys.

  • Product Governance: Designing and embedding best-practice discovery frameworks across the organisation, ensuring our backlogs are structured to deliver genuine value to customers.

  • Cross-Team Orchestration: Guiding multiple squads through complex dependencies, building supportive environments that simplify large-scale programmes.

  • Data & Value Realisation: Helping teams define meaningful, long-term business metrics and nurturing advanced data capabilities across the wider organisation.

  • Executive Partnership: Cultivating trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, facilitating alignment sessions to shape multi-year goals, and mindfully managing risks.

  • Mentorship & Coaching: Providing warm, impactful thought leadership to support Product Managers with their communication, navigation of complex spaces, and career progression.

  • Commercial Growth: Infusing creative product thinking into new business proposals and partnering with our Client Services Group to evolve our consulting offerings.

What you'll bring:

At Waracle, we believe that great leadership isn't about matching a rigid checklist—it's about the unique experiences, insight, and empathy you bring to a team. If you are excited about this role and share our passion for creating meaningful digital experiences, we highly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every single requirement listed above. We are dedicated to building an inclusive environment where your voice will be heard and celebrated.

  • Consultancy Leadership: Extensive experience guiding product strategy within a digital consultancy environment, with a proven ability to foster collaboration and deliver client value.

  • Delivery Leadership: A strong track record of supporting and guiding multiple cross-functional squads or complex portfolios.

  • Agile Strategy & Frameworks: A deep, practical understanding of scaled Agile frameworks and modern, human-centred delivery models.

  • Data-Informed Strategy: Comfort using delivery data and core product metrics to gently challenge assumptions and shape impactful client strategies.

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with a history of building trust with executive and C-suite leaders.

  • Organisational Design: Experience helping shape, resource, and nurture team structures during complex enterprise agile transformations.

  • Domain Credibility: The ability to quickly grasp technical concepts, clarify ambiguous requirements, and provide supportive, authoritative guidance.

  • Proactive & Collaborative Mindset: A positive, results-oriented approach that prioritises open communication, team alignment, and thoughtful progress.

Our Recruitment Process

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Acquisition Partner who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!).

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-up and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Creative Producer (Men's Health)
description:
We’re looking for an exceptionally organised and inspiringly creative, Creative Producer. This is the role for you if you thrive on turning ideas and concepts into reality. You’ll fit in well if you’re a team player who enjoys bringing people together to make engaging creative assets and campaigns.

What you’ll be responsible for:

  • Work alongside the Senior creative producer and Creative Producer (female health) to manage our talent network of actors, influencers and customers, booking talent as required.

  • Lead on the coordination and on-the-day execution of studio and location photo / video shoots.

  • Source creative talent to compliment the skills of our in-house creative team on a range of projects and briefs.

  • Support our Senior Creative Producer and Creative Producer in the development of creative assets; from managing the flow of work to updating stakeholders across the business

  • Contribute to the development of creative content and campaign ideas

  • Research competitors and businesses of note, influencers, and viral campaigns to inform current and fresh ideas.

  • Lead end-to-end on our paid ad production for MANUAL’s main categories; Hair Loss, Hair Transplants, TRT and Weight Loss.

What we’re looking for:

  • Demonstrable experience of creative production in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience managing multiple stakeholders of varying levels.

  • Cutting-edge interest in creative, especially for Social Media.

  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills are essential.

  • An understanding of performance creative adverts is a plus.

What we offer:

  • A fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas and contributions will make a real impact.

  • The opportunity to work in an experimental and innovative team.

  • A supportive and inclusive workplace dedicated to improving the lives of women navigating menopause.

  • Competitive salary with a generous stock option plan.

  • Hybrid role in Bermondsey with in-office perks.

  • Professional development budget, wellness benefits, annual retreat, and more.

  • 25 days of holiday, flexible working policies, and private healthcare plan.

ABOUT MANUAL AND MENOPAUSE CARE

MANUAL delivers healthcare at scale thanks to its comprehensive digital clinic. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lives for a large part of the population in the UK, Brazil, and beyond focusing on life-impeding conditions like hormonal imbalance, obesity and hair loss.

MANUAL has steadily grown since inception and is now serving 500k+ patients, across 2 geographies. We are centralising the diagnosis, custom medications, doctor specialist services, behavioural change and fully vertically integrated management of the treatment journey, under one roof and consumer brand.

We’re destigmatising how people approach their health by offering easy access to diagnostics, a holistic range of treatments, ongoing care and medical advice, as well as a community to help proactively improve one’s health and wellbeing. A place that didn't exist until now.

Innovating on healthcare delivery, MANUAL provides patients with engaging treatment plans generating superior clinical outcomes: 90%+ of patients see an improvement in their Quality of Life (QoL) within 6 months. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lifespan for a big part of the population in the UK, Brazil and beyond,

After a $30 million Series A round, we are on a mission to build one of the most impactful teams in the healthcare space. We are looking for incredibly ambitious, entrepreneurial, driven and fun people to join us as we accelerate our growth and expansion. This is an exciting time to join the UK’s fastest-growing healthtech and help supercharge our mission.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Menwell Limited, trading as MANUAL, is an Equal Opportunities Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of gender and gender reassignment, age, disability, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, marriage and civil partnership. We base all our employment decisions on merit, job requirements and business needs. This applies to all decisions related to hiring, training, remuneration, promotion and discipline.

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is essential to our success. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued and respected, regardless of their background, identity or beliefs. We believe that Inclusion, Diversity, Equity and Accessibility (IDEA) is essential to our ability to offer the best possible health outcomes to our patients and customers.

title: Dordrecht - Firefighting Instructor
description:
Do you thrive on inspiring others, sharing knowledge and making a real impact through hands-on training? Do you have experience as a friefighter preferably with offshore experience?

For our training center in Dordrecht, we are looking for a driven and passionate Firefighting Instructor (m/f/d) who wants to enable people to work safely and optimally prepare them for emergency situations in offshore environments.

Who Are We?

At FMTC Safety, everything revolves around people and safety. We are a fast-growing, global organization preparing professionals to work safely in some of the world’s most demanding environments: from offshore platforms and wind farms to ships and industrial sites.

What makes us different?

We go where our clients need us. With training centers strategically located around the world, we offer maximum flexibility: in timing, location, and delivery. Our mindset is simple: we make it happen. Even if there’s only one participant, the training goes ahead. This requires more than just knowledge, it requires passion, flexibility and a true customer-first mentality. And that’s exactly what defines our instructors.

As a Firefighting Instructor in Dordrecht, you don’t just deliver courses, you create impactful learning experiences that truly prepare people for real-life emergencies.

What will you do?

  • You will train participants daily to manage various emergency incidents, including:

    • fires in internal accommodations,

    • hazardous materials,

    • spilled chemicals,

    • radiation incidents,

    • fires involving flammable liquids,

    • rescues from heights and confined spaces,

    • and aircraft fires and crashes.

  • Guide participants through realistic and hands-on exercises

  • Create a safe, energetic and engaging learning environment

  • Uphold the highest safety standards, because in this role, rules and procedures are non-negotiable

What do you bring?

  • Experience as an instructor is a plus - your mindset matters most.

  • Experience as a firefighter

  • Good command of English

  • A proactive, flexible, and hands-on attitude

  • A genuine passion for safety, training and working with people

  • Experience in an offshore environment, airport, industrial complex or local government where aircrafts are used

  • You understand the relevant standards, including OPITO, STCW, NOGEPA, and GWO

  • A serious commitment to safety rules and protocols, because the well-being of our participants is our top priority

Why FMTC?

  • Work in a truly international and fast-growing environment

  • Take ownership and make a visible impact from day one

  • Grow with us through training, certifications, and development opportunities

  • Experience an open, informal culture with short lines and big ambitions

Not yet fully qualified? No problem! If you have the right attitude and a passion for safety, we’ll provide the training you need to succeed.
