title: Client Experience Associate
description:
Position Only Available to Residents of Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, North Carolina, Virginia, Texas, Utah, Idaho, Tennessee, Missouri, Ohio, or Arizona.


We're on a mission to help the world work Anywhere. Whether working from home, an office, or Anywhere, we offer products and services designed to help people work and learn together, whether they're across a table or across the world. Work is what we do, not where we do it.


To help us review applications efficiently, we ask that you apply to only one Client Experience Associate role at a time. If you are Bilingual (English/Spanish), one application can be considered for both Bilingual and Non-Bilingual opportunities. Please note that multiple applications for the same role will not be considered.

We are looking for a Client Experience Associate to join our team! Please see below for more information:


Your Role

  • Please watch: A Day in the Life of a Client Experience Associate

  • You will be taking customer calls, capturing incoming leads, taking orders, and scheduling appointments, while working from the comfort of your own home.

  • In this role, you will be taking inbound calls and forwarding messages to our clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • You will work from your computer for the duration of your shift and regularly work 40 hours per week with a minimum of 8 hours on Fridays, Saturdays, and Mondays.

Your Skills

  • An excellent communicator, verbally and written.

  • Growth mindset, and is excited to learn new things.

  • Passionate about customer service, bringing a warm and upbeat tone to every interaction.

  • People-focused, friendly and knows how to listen.

  • Dependable and shows up when expected.

  • Above-average computer skills, including typing.

  • The ability to stay calm and efficient under pressure.

  • Willingness to complete an introductory learning and development phase at satisfactory levels.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Starting at $16.00/hour.

  • Benefits are available after 60 days of employment.

Your System

We operate on a 'Bring Your Own Device' policy and there are certain system requirements that must be met in order to ensure our applications can work successfully on your computer. The full system and internet requirements can be found here.

About AnywhereWorks

Work is what you do, not where you do it. We’re on a mission to help the world work Anywhere. We believe people should be able to work and learn together, whether they’re communicating across a table or across the world.

We offer a diverse set of products and services to a variety of businesses, from live answering services to scheduling and payment platforms to shared working spaces. We empower people to communicate, collaborate and produce. We’re committed to building a more inclusive future of work, where people can contribute from Anywhere.

What "Anywhere" Means to Us

Other terms out in the world are “remote” “distributed” “telecommuting” – for us, these words do not speak to the experience we hope you will have working with us Anywhere.

Isolation and a lack of social interaction are common concerns when people think about Remote working. The word “Remote” itself can conjure up ideas of loneliness and being disconnected from your colleagues. That’s why we like the more empowering language of “working Anywhere”, with Anywhere representing an unconstrained, plugged-in destination.

Background Check

Please note that all candidates who receive a conditional offer of employment will be required to undergo a background check as part of the pre-employment screening process. This is to ensure the safety and integrity of our workplace and to comply with our company policies.

We comply with all requirements of the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) to ensure the privacy and rights of our applicants are protected.

Equal Opportunity

AnywhereWorks is committed to providing equal opportunity employment; creating, managing, and valuing diversity in our workforce; providing a safe work environment; and fostering a culture of belonging where all employees are included, treated with dignity and respect, promoted on their merits, and placed in positions to contribute to our future success.

title: Customer Experience Specialist - Menopause
description:
We’re looking for a customer experience specialist to join our female health team. We’re expanding a service which supports women through perimenopause, and menopause. We want to provide the best service to women going through this journey - and we need proactive individuals ready to support patients on all aspects outside of their clinical appointments.

Menopause is a new area of the business that we’re all incredibly excited about. Our Menopause category operates under the brand Menopause Care - led by the founder Dr Naomi Potter. Dr Potter has built a strong organic brand which we want to develop with this service.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about creating an excellent patient service experience, where patients feel supported on all aspects outside of clinical appointments. You'll be the first person our patients speak to and you'll advocate their voice throughout the company. You’re someone who makes things happen despite ambiguity and can calmly handle periods of breakneck scaling and moments of chaos. You have a passion for solving real patient problems as well as design and innovation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Being the voice of Menopause Care, helping guide women through their journey with compassion and understanding

  • Taking a nimble approach to problem solving, ready to help patients with a variety of questions when they get in touch

  • Working collaboratively within patient experience and the broader Menopause Care team to provide comprehensive service to our patients and unblock any potential barriers patients may face

  • Creating and improving processes that allow us to help patients in the most effective way possible

  • Skilled Communicator - You're good at explaining things to people in written or verbal communication and you are thoughtful in all of your interactions

  • Highly Organised - You know how to stay on top of moving parts and can jump from speaking with a patient on the phone to getting to the bottom of a missing order

  • Growth Mindset Analytical Thinker - You don’t shy away from change or evolving processes and you are keen to make recommendations to improve the experience for our patients

  • Passionate and Driven - You are hungry to deliver the best support to our patients and approach new challenges with a “roll up your sleeves” mentality

  • Team Player - you enjoy working collaboratively and learning from your team; you have a humble attitude and are ready to jump into different tasks

  • Prior experience - you have some experience either in a customer support role within a tech startup environment or a healthcare environment

Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary is up to £30,000 depending on experience

  • 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays

  • Hybrid role based in London Bridge 3 days a week with lunch once a week

  • Private medical insurance

  • £400 annual Learning & Development budget

  • Gym & Wellness benefit with Wellhub

  • Annual company retreat

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Electric car scheme

  • Healthy snacks & drinks in the office

ABOUT MENOPAUSE CARE

Menopause Care was founded by Dr Naomi Potter, Co-author of Menopausing with Davina McCall which won the British Book Award Prize last year. Manual and Menopause Care joined forces earlier this year with a vision to provide the best menopause treatment and support for women in the UK and beyond. She leads an exemplary team of doctors, allied health professionals and admin who are dedicated to providing the best for their patients.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
gravity9 is a boutique IT consulting company headquartered in the UK with offices in the US, Canada, Poland, and Colombia. Our team has deep experience in engineering, experience design and product management. We enjoy a challenge and pride ourselves on working with our clients on their most complex problems, finding elegant and flexible solutions that help them transform their businesses.

Join Our Growing Team - Future Opportunities Await!

We are excited to share that our company is experiencing significant growth and expansion, and as a result, we're on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

We want to be upfront about our hiring process. At this moment, we are in the process of securing projects that align with our business goals and objectives. Our intention is to ensure that once we bring new team members on board, they will have a meaningful and impactful role to play from day one. While we might not be able to extend an offer immediately, we are highly interested in considering you for these future projects.

If you're open to the idea of potentially joining our team in the future, we encourage you to continue with our interview process. We value your time and effort and believe that getting to know you better will help us make an informed decision.

Once you have effectively concluded the entire recruitment procedure, we will retain your profile and reach out to you once a suitable opportunity emerges. Additional interviews will not be necessary at this stage, and we anticipate being able to extend an offer to you promptly.

What does the recruitment process look like?

1. Recruiter Screen

In the first call, our recruiter will learn more about you and your story to check a potential fit for gravity9. This is also an opportunity to ask your questions about the role and company. This step might take around 60 mins.

2. Tech 1 Interview with our AI Practice Lead

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.
This step will take around 75 mins.

3. Tech 2 Interview with our software consultants

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.
This step will take around 60 mins.

4. Final Interview

You made it to the very last stage! Here we already strive to cooperate with you and give you an opportunity to meet our leadership team during this informal talk. This step will take around 30 mins.

The salary details for the role will be communicated ahead of the first recruitment meeting.

Thank you for considering the opportunity to be a part of our growing journey. We look forward to the possibility of working together and achieving great things.

Role Description

gravity9 is expanding its Forward Deployed Engineering team to build production agentic AI systems for enterprise clients, in partnership with leading frontier-model providers. We already support clients from different verticals to have agentic and RAG systems live in production across healthcare, financial services, retail and global logistics.

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you work embedded in the client's environment, from discovery, through architecture and build, to production and handover. This is end-to-end agent engineering, not proofs of concept and not advisory work. Two flavours of engagement:

  • Internal enterprise use cases, such as reconciliation and KYC workflows in financial services, clinical and claims workflows in healthcare, operations and supply-chain workflows in logistics.

  • Product- and customer-facing agents, more greenfield, often exploratory, built into the client's own product.

Engagements are typically a team of engineers over a few months, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the client's team including architects, DevOps and QA.

  • Embed with the client. Work hand-in-hand inside the client's environment, codebase and cloud tenancy, often in a hybrid team alongside their engineers. You are visible to the client from day one.

  • Design and build production agentic AI systems. Multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, retrieval, planning and routing, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, state and checkpointing, guardrails, failure handling and recovery.

  • Do the unglamorous data work. A large share of every engagement is data engineering: ingestion, flattening deeply nested structures, extracting content from unstructured documents, classification, summarisation, tagging, enrichment, indexing. Models reason over data, bad data beats a good model every time.

  • Own evaluation and accuracy. Establish a baseline eval dataset at the start of the engagement, automate grading, and track groundedness, faithfulness and retrieval quality per tool, not just at the agent level. Be ready to defend accuracy numbers to a sceptical enterprise stakeholder.

  • Engineer for cost and latency. Model selection and routing (cheaper, faster models for non-reasoning steps; frontier models where reasoning genuinely earns it), prompt and context budgeting, caching. Cost is a non-negotiable metric on every engagement.

  • Ship it properly. Observability and tracing, CI/CD, IaC, monitoring the client can actually operate, security and compliance review.

  • Transfer knowledge deliberately. We don't run a long-term support business. Every engagement is designed so the client owns and can extend the system after we leave. You architect with their team in the room, pair with their engineers, and hand over working monitoring and documentation.

Technical skills

Essential

  • Programming: Strong Python (async, typing, testing, packaging). Working competence in TypeScript / Node is a plus.

  • LLM application engineering: Hands-on production experience with frontier models: prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, tool and function calling, streaming, token and context-window management.

  • Agentic architecture: Built and shipped multi-agent or agentic workflows, planner/router patterns, supervisor and sub-agent designs, ReAct-style loops, state and checkpointing, retries and interrupts, human-in-the-loop review gates.

  • Frameworks: At least one of: Anthropic Agent SDK, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or an equivalent orchestration framework, plus the judgement to know when to use none of them.

  • RAG and retrieval: Chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid and semantic search, re-ranking, citation and provenance, natural-language-to-query translation.

  • Data platforms: NoSQL databases such as MongoDB (aggregation pipelines, Atlas Search, Atlas Vector Search) or a strong equivalent, plus SQL. Comfortable designing schemas for agent retrieval, not just for OLTP.

  • Data engineering: Building ingestion and enrichment pipelines over messy structured and unstructured sources, documents, PDFs, object storage.

  • Evaluation: Building eval harnesses and eval datasets, LLM-as-judge with its limits understood, regression testing of prompts and agents, metric selection per use case.

  • Cloud: Production delivery on AWS (incl. Bedrock), Azure or GCP, containers, serverless, networking basics, secrets management, IAM.

  • Engineering discipline: Git, code review, testing, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform or equivalent), observability.

Strong advantage

  • Anthropic certification (Claude Developer / Anthropic-issued credential), an explicit advantage at shortlisting.

  • Anthropic Agent SDK production experience, a significant bonus.

  • MCP (Model Context Protocol): building servers and clients, tool exposure, auth patterns.

  • Claude Code as an autonomous SDLC agent: sub-agents, hooks, custom skills, agent marketplaces, context sharing across a team.

  • LLM observability and tracing tooling (LangFuse, LangSmith, Arize, Braintrust or similar).

  • Regulated-environment delivery: HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, FCA/PRA, PII handling, data residency, guardrails and red-teaming.

  • Graph or taxonomy-based knowledge representation alongside vector retrieval.

  • Kafka / streaming, Databricks, or comparable large-scale data platform experience.

Nice to have

  • Voice and multimodal agents; evaluation of non-text outputs.

  • FinOps for AI workloads; unit-economics modelling for agent systems.

  • Open-source contribution to the agent / LLM ecosystem, or conference speaking.

  • Prior experience as an FDE, solutions architect, or delivery consultant at a frontier-model, data platform, or infrastructure vendor.

Soft skills

An FDE is an engineer who is safe in front of a client. We screen as hard on this section as on the technical one.

  • Client presence and credibility. Can hold a technical conversation with a client architect and a business conversation with their CTO or head of operations in the same hour, and be trusted by both. Can present, whiteboard, and answer hard questions without deflecting.

  • Translation. Turns a business problem described by non-technical people such as a clinician, campaign manager or supply-chain planner into a technical design, and explains the technical design back in their language.

  • Ego-free collaboration in a supporting role. On some engagements the tech lead will come from the client or a partner, not from us. You need to contribute strongly, disagree well, and take direction without friction. Brilliant-but-territorial doesn't work here.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and greenfield. Engagements often start before the requirements, the data access, or sometimes the problem statement are settled. You make progress anyway, and you make the ambiguity visible rather than hiding it.

  • Bias to production. Instinctively asks "how does this get deployed, monitored and maintained?" rather than stopping at a working notebook.

  • Teaching instinct. Actively enjoys upskilling the client's engineers, because self-sufficiency at handover is the definition of success, not follow-on billing.

  • Ownership and pace. Short engagements, small teams, no layers to hide behind. You unblock yourself, chase the access request, and follow the thread to the answer.

  • Commercial awareness. Understands that scope, cost and the client's willingness to pay are part of the engineering problem, and contributes to scoping and estimating honestly.

  • Resilience and adaptability. New client, new domain, new stack every few months; occasional travel; occasionally a sceptical stakeholder who has been told AI is coming for their job. You stay steady and constructive.

  • Written communication. Clear design docs, decision records, handover material and status updates in English. Much of this is asynchronous and cross-timezone.

  • Genuine curiosity about the field. This ecosystem changes monthly. We want people who are already reading, building side projects and forming opinions — not waiting for training to be scheduled for them.

Experience profile

  • FDE (mid): 3+ years software engineering, 1+ years hands-on LLM / agentic work with at least one system live in production. Client-facing exposure.

  • Senior FDE: 5+ years engineering, 2+ years AI or agentic AI, has owned the architecture of at least one production agent system end-to-end and led a client conversation about it.

  • Lead FDE: 7+ years, has led delivery teams of 3–7 people, can act as engagement tech lead, contributes to pre-sales and estimation, and can mentor a growing FDE bench.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days — owning a meaningful component of a client-facing agent system, including its evals, and trusted in front of the client.

  • 6 months — designing agent architectures independently, leading a workstream, and running the handover and knowledge-transfer track.

  • 12 months — a reference point for others on the team, contributing to reusable assets, pre-sales and interviewing.

What we offer

  • Support for vendor certifications and access to partner training programmes.

  • Company-wide AI tooling as part of how we work day to day.

Wil jij jouw ervaring in klantcontact inzetten en je verder ontwikkelen tot adviseur in verzekeringen? Bij KCD krijg je de kans om je te specialiseren in verschillende verzekeringsproducten, terwijl je werkt in een omgeving waar groei, flexibiliteit en afwisseling centraal staan.

De rol

Als Klantenservice Medewerker bij FBTO ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten. Je helpt hen met vragen over hun verzekeringen en zorgt ervoor dat ze snel en vriendelijk worden geholpen. Of het nu gaat om een wijziging, een financiële vraag of een schade, jij denkt mee en biedt een passende oplossing.

Jouw taken bestaan uit:

  • Klanten doorverbinden of doorverwijzen naar de juiste afdeling wanneer dat nodig is.

Naast het klantcontact werk je ook actief aan je eigen ontwikkeling en die van het team:

Zodra je de benodigde kennis en ervaring hebt opgedaan, breid je jouw werkzaamheden verder uit en ga je ook telefonisch klantcontact verzorgen. Dat is geen toeval – bij Wajer ligt de focus op innovatie, kwaliteit en ultiem comfort. En dat alles begint met een team van gepassioneerde vakspecialisten zoals jij.


Service is jouw domein. Als Service Engineer ben jij degene die ervoor zorgt dat onze jachten blijven functioneren op het hoogste niveau, zowel bij de klant als op locatie. Voor ons team zijn we op zoek naar een Service Engineer die onze klanten wereldwijd helpt om hun jachten perfect in topconditie te houden. Klinkt dat als jouw uitdaging? Lees snel verder!


Dit wordt jouw werk

Daarbij voer je o.a. de volgende werkzaamheden uit:

🛠️ Het uitvoeren van onderhoud en reparaties aan jachten, zowel op locatie als in de werkplaats
🛠️ Het zelfstandig oplossen van storingen aan de mechanische, elektrische en elektronische systemen
🛠️ Het uitvoeren van installaties en upgrades op jachten bij klanten wereldwijd
🛠️ Het communiceren met klanten om hun wensen en problemen te begrijpen en op te lossen
🛠️ Het documenteren van je werkzaamheden en het bijwerken van de servicegeschiedenis van de jachten

Dit krijg je van ons

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer or an Azure wrangler, a Databricks whisperer, a senior "works-on-my-cluster" engineer… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself, you'll join our Delivery team and build the data platforms our clients actually run on, the pipelines and models behind the moment a client leans forward and says "wait, show me that again."

What you get

  • A salary between €3,900–€5,000/gross monthly, based on the role, your experience, and your local market.

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then.

  • Fully remote, from anywhere in Europe, ideally within a couple of hours of CET, so the team overlaps.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

What the job looks like

  • Build and own the Azure data platforms our client accounts run on, SQL Server, Databricks, pipelines end to end.

  • Design the data models that keep it all maintainable, and Kimball dimensional modelling, where it earns its place.

  • Challenge a requirement when it doesn't add up, and bring a better option. We'd rather you push back than build the wrong thing well.

  • Take a genuinely messy, complex data problem and turn it into something the client, and the team, can actually follow.

  • Reason about what the work changes for the client, not just the ticket in front of you.

What you bring

  • Attitude: honest and constructive. You have the real conversations, and you'll challenge something that doesn't make sense, kindly, with an alternative in hand.

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Senior Data Engineer, designing, building, and maintaining scalable, reliable data platforms and pipelines in production environments.

  • Azure data engineering: hands-on across the Azure stack, including SQL Server and Databricks. You build platforms, not just wire them together.

  • Data modelling: Kimball dimensional modelling is second nature.

  • Impact over output: you think about what the work changes, not just the code you ship.

  • Communication: you can take something genuinely complex and make it land, for a teammate or a non-technical client, without needing someone else to translate for you.

  • Track record: at least one role you stayed in long enough to deliver something real, and recent proof you keep learning, a new tool, a cert, an idea you ran with.

  • Nice to have: a real IT education and solid software-engineering foundations, functional and object-oriented programming. Data Vault, logistics or industrial data experience, and Dutch are pluses too.

We're 60+ data heroes across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

title: OpenShift Engineer
description:
Heb jij een passie voor platformtechnologieën en werk je graag met Red Hat OpenShift? Wil je bijdragen aan het ontwerpen en beheren van schaalbare containerplatformen bij toonaangevende organisaties? Dan is deze rol bij ITQ misschien precies wat je zoekt.


Over ITQ
Bij ITQ helpen we organisaties om te innoveren met technologie. Dat doen we met een persoonlijke aanpak, technische diepgang en een sterke focus op kwaliteit. Als OpenShift Engineer maak je deel uit van ons Cloud Native team – een groep experts die elkaar continu scherp houdt, kennis met elkaar deelt en samenwerkt aan uitdagende projecten.


Wat ga je doen?
Als OpenShift Engineer richt jij je op het opzetten, configureren en beheren van Red Hat OpenShift-platformen – zowel on-premises als in de cloud. Je helpt klanten met het bouwen van een betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en veilig platform voor hun gecontaineriseerde applicaties. Daarbij werk je intensief met DevOps-teams, security-specialisten en architecten.


Je taken zijn onder andere:

  • Installatie en lifecycle management van OpenShift-clusters (bare metal, VMware, cloud)

  • Configuratie van operators, networking, storage en security policies

  • Automatisering met Ansible, GitOps en Infrastructure as Code (zoals Terraform)

  • Troubleshooting en performance tuning van platformcomponenten

  • Adviseren van klanten over best practices en governance


Wat breng jij mee?
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met OpenShift of vergelijkbare containerplatformen en ervaring met enterprise-omgevingen. Verder herken je je (grotendeels) in het volgende:

  • Grondige kennis van Red Hat-technologieën zoals RHEL, OpenShift, Ansible

  • Ervaring met containerisatie (Docker/CRI-O), Kubernetes en GitOps-principes

  • Kennis van CI/CD pipelines en tooling zoals Tekton, ArgoCD, Jenkins of GitLab

  • Bekend met netwerken, load balancing en security in containeromgevingen

  • CKA/CKAD of Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift is een pré (of je wil deze behalen)

  • Ervaring met hybride of multicloud-infrastructuren is een pluspunt

  • Ervaring met monitoring en observability tools (zoals Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) is een pré. Scripting met Python, Bash of Go wordt gewaardeerd.


Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

  • Werken aan technisch uitdagende projecten bij diverse enterprise-klanten

  • Deel uitmaken van een team met diepe expertise en kennisdeling als kernwaarde

  • Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, inclusief leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget

  • Jaarlijks opleidingsbudget en support bij het behalen van certificeringen

  • Flexibiliteit om jezelf te ontwikkelen én een balans te vinden tussen werk en privé

  • Een informele, open cultuur waarin we oog hebben voor elkaar

  • Bij ITQ werk je niet alleen aan technologie, maar ook aan het succes van de klant. Je krijgt de kans om mee te denken over strategische keuzes en werkt hybride: bij de klant, op kantoor of thuis.


Ben jij onze nieuwe OpenShift Engineer?
Solliciteer of plan een kennismaking – we horen graag wie je bent en waar je naartoe wilt!

title: Operationeel Inkoper
description:
Welkom bij Wajer Super Yachts – waar luxe en vakmanschap samenkomen

Wajer Yachts is een Nederlands familiebedrijf in de luxe jachtbouw. Elk jaar bouwen we zo'n 60 jachten: van de 38, 44 en 55 ft in Heeg tot de 77 en onze eerste superjacht van ruim 100 ft in Lemmer. Jachten waar mensen van dromen, gebouwd met gepassioneerd vakmanschap en oog voor het kleinste detail.

Als Operationeel Inkoper ben jij degene die ervoor zorgt dat de productie in Lemmer onbelemmerd doorgang vindt. Jij brengt inkoop op de kaart als stevige schakel tussen leveranciers, productie en de rest van de organisatie.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Operationeel Inkoper ben je de schakel tussen leveranciers, productie en planning. Je zorgt ervoor dat materialen en onderdelen op tijd beschikbaar zijn, zodat de bouw van de jachten zonder vertraging kan doorgaan. Je begint de week vaak met het afstemmen van de productieplanning en het signaleren van eventuele knelpunten. Wanneer een kritisch onderdeel eerder nodig blijkt dan de afgesproken levertijd toelaat, schakel je direct met leveranciers om alternatieven te bespreken of een spoedlevering te regelen. Zo voorkom je dat de productie stil komt te liggen.

Naast het contact met leveranciers ben je regelmatig aanwezig op de werkvloer in Lemmer. Door nauw samen te werken met de coördinatoren en co-makers krijg je snel inzicht in praktische uitdagingen. Als materialen bijvoorbeeld niet volgens specificatie worden geleverd, onderzoek je de oorzaak, analyseer je de gegevens in het systeem en voer je verbeteringen door. Hiermee los je niet alleen acute problemen op, maar voorkom je ook dat ze zich in de toekomst opnieuw voordoen. Ook leveranciersmanagement speelt een belangrijke rol. Je monitort prestaties op het gebied van kwaliteit, leverbetrouwbaarheid en afspraken. Samen met collega's bespreek je waar processen of contracten aangescherpt kunnen worden en bereid je gesprekken met leveranciers voor wanneer verbeteringen nodig zijn.

Gedurende de week houd je overzicht over openstaande bestellingen, bewaak je levertijden, verwerk je inkooporders en stem je continu af met verschillende afdelingen. Dankzij jouw proactieve aanpak blijven materialen beschikbaar, worden problemen snel opgelost en draag je direct bij aan een soepel en efficiënt productieproces. Als Operationeel Inkoper ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het zelfstandig uitvoeren van de dagelijkse inkoop van materialen en diensten voor de productie in Lemmer

  • Het bewaken van levertijden, kwaliteit en compleetheid en proactief schakelen wanneer dat nodig is

  • Het opbouwen en onderhouden van een sterk leveranciersnetwerk, met oog voor kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid

  • Het inrichten en verbeteren van inkoopprocessen, zodat inkoop bij Wajer professioneel en toekomstbestendig is

  • Het inrichten, beheren en onderhouden van de projectstructuur, het artikelbestand en het leveranciersbestand in ons ERP-systeem ISAH.

  • Het zijn van een gesprekspartner voor interne stakeholders van productie tot finance

Wat breng je mee?

✔️ Een afgeronde MBO+ opleiding.

✔️ Je bent digitaal onderlegd en heb je ervaring/affiniteit met ERP.

✔️ Relevante werkervaring als inkoper, bij voorkeur in de maakindustrie (ervaring in de jachtbouw is een mooie bonus).

✔️ Je bent communicatief sterk en niet bang om het gesprek aan te gaan met leveranciers, collega's op de werkvloer of het management.

✔️ Hebt lef, neemt initiatief en weet anderen mee te nemen in jouw aanpak.

✔️ Je hebt een goed gevoel bij het inrichten van processen en ziet altijd waar het slimmer kan.

✔️ Bent nauwkeurig, resultaatgericht en behoudt het overzicht ook wanneer meerdere projecten tegelijk lopen.

✔️ Je spreekt goed Nederlands en Engels en voelt je thuis in een internationale omgeving.

Werken bij Wajer

Jouw passie uitvoeren op een unieke en inspirerende werkplek: dat is werken bij Wajer. Als Operationeel Inkoper doe je dat vanuit onze Super Yachts locatie in het Friese Lemmer, midden in de productie van de mooiste jachten die we bouwen.

Met wereldwijd meer dan 400 werknemers streven we elke dag naar het beste resultaat, met oog voor zelfs het allerkleinste detail. We gaan voor niets minder dan pure perfectie. Maar ook genieten we samen, van borrels, uitjes en onze successen. Wajer Super Yachts: waar vakmanschap en ambitie samenkomen.

Wat je verder van ons kunt verwachten:

⭐ Een salaris tussen €3300 en €4000 bruto per maand (CAO Metalektro).

⭐ 8% vakantiegeld en een goede pensioenregeling via PME.

⭐ 27 vakantiedagen en 6,5 ADV-dagen.

⭐Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer.

⭐Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen via opleidingen en trainingen.

⭐De mogelijkheid om je vaarbewijzen (KVB 1 & 2) te halen, op onze kosten.

Zo stap je aan boord
Geïnteresseerd in deze rol? Upload je cv en motivatie via onze website. Voor vragen kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter, Laurens ten Cate Hoedemaker via 06-34849125

title: Software Defined Datacenter Consultant
description:

At our company, as a Software-Defined Datacenter Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work with leading organizations and apply cutting-edge technologies to optimize their datacenters.

This is your chance: ITQ offers an environment where learning is central and high-quality standards are the norm. We are passionate about our clients, but also about empowering our employees to embrace new skills and ways of working.

Your Role at ITQ


As a Software-Defined Datacenter Consultant, you will support our clients in transforming their traditional datacenters into modern, flexible, and efficient software-defined environments. You’ll work closely with clients to understand their business needs and design tailored solutions using the latest technologies. You jump in and save the day by simplifying complex datacenter infrastructures, reducing costs, and improving overall performance.

Your responsibilities and technologies:

  • You have a solid background in technologies such as VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), VCF Operations, VMware NSX, and Red Hat OpenShift (especially OpenShift Virtualization).

  • You are hands-on with Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI) solutions; experience in this area is essential.

  • You possess architectural skills related to SDDC and have a strong understanding of x86 virtualization, operating systems, and advanced networking and storage architectures.

  • You hold current VMware and/or Red Hat certifications and are willing to pursue further certifications.

Four Key Benefits of Working at ITQ
➔ Onboarding: A comprehensive onboarding program, concluding with a casual lunch or dinner with your assigned buddy.
➔ ITQonnect: Plenty of opportunities to socialize and share knowledge; we regularly meet to discuss the latest trends and developments.
➔ Clear Direction: We have a clear vision for ITQ and are open to your ideas and feedback.
➔ Top Class: You’ll work alongside the best in your field, attend conferences and events regularly, and connect with like-minded professionals worldwide.

What We’re Looking for in You

  • You are passionate about your work as a consultant or architect and skilled at identifying customer needs and translating them into tangible solutions.

  • You are communicative in both Dutch and English and able to act as a professional advisor to business clients.

  • You are curious and naturally interested in new technologies — that’s what energizes you.

What We Offer

  • Significant room for personal and professional growth.

  • A competitive salary package, including the option of a company car/mobility budget, a collective bonus, and an annual budget for training and certification.

  • A physical office as your home base, with support for remote work through a home office budget.

  • A chance to be part of the warm and inclusive ITQ family.

Join ITQ
At ITQ, the person comes first; we encourage everyone to pursue their unique passions. Are you a driven and passionate professional? Then we’d love to get to know you!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Maybe you call yourself a Data Engineer or a Data Specialist or a BI Developer or a Data Architect or an Azure Developer, or maybe you just call yourself Alex? This vacancy is part of our Delivery team and applies to all the above titles.

What you get

  • A salary between €3,200–€4,000/gross monthly, based on the role, your experience, and your local market.

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then.

  • Fully remote, from anywhere in Europe, ideally within a couple of hours of CET, so the team overlaps.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

What the job looks like

  • Build and maintain end-to-end pipelines in the Azure stack, ingesting source data into the Data Lake and Azure SQL, orchestrated with Azure Data Factory.

  • Develop the data warehouse layers from raw staging through the Data Vault and Business Vault into the dimensional Data Mart, primarily in T-SQL.

  • Write and optimise stored procedures for transformation and loading (full, incremental and delete loads), including watermark-driven incremental processing.

  • Model data correctly, designing hubs, links and satellites in the vault, and conformed facts and dimensions in the mart.

  • Investigate and understand source systems (e.g. terminal operating and maintenance systems) so the model reflects what the data really means, not just its shape.

  • Deliver in Power BI, building datasets/semantic models and reports yourself, not just opening someone else’s dashboard.

  • Own data quality, building validation and monitoring into the platform, and debugging broken pipelines, stored procedures or database projects without flinching.

  • Wear the analyst hat, profiling new datasets, answering data questions directly, and validating that numbers reconcile before they reach the business.

  • You'll work in with T-SQL · Azure (Data Factory, Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure SQL) · Power BI · Git — plus Data Vault and dimensional modelling.

What you bring

  • ~5+ years hands-on, across data engineering and database development. We weight depth and range over the exact number, but this isn't a junior seat; you've owned real warehouse work, not just touched it.

  • Real relational-database depth: you model in 3NF, read an execution plan, tune a slow query, and work confidently in the Data Vault layer beneath the mart, not just the semantic layer on top.

  • Excellent T-SQL: especially stored procedures for transformation and loading.

  • Hands-on Azure data engineering: you've built end-to-end pipelines with ADF, Data Lake Gen2 and Azure SQL.

  • You build in Power BI, not just consume it: datasets/semantic models, relationships, DAX, reports.

  • A reliability habit: data quality validated and monitored as part of the work, Git as a default, and the confidence to trace a broken pipeline/proc/DB project to root cause and fix it calmly.

  • Communication: fully comfortable in English to collaborate with clients and a remote team.

  • Nice to have: experience with Data Vault 2.0 specifically (hubs, links, satellites, hash keys); knowledge in Python; exposure to a semantic-layer tool such as Dremio; background in operational / logistics / industrial domains (e.g. ports, terminals, maintenance/CMMS, IoT-style event data).

We're 60+ data heroes across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

title: Mid-Level Backend Developer
description:
Waracle are looking for a mid-level Developer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.


This is a Hybrid role working from our Dundee or Glasgow office 2 days a week.

Shape the Future of Digital Products

Are you a collaborative software developer looking to take the next step in your career within a supportive, forward-thinking environment? As a Mid Developer at Waracle, you won't just write code—you will help bring meaningful digital products to life.

We are looking for someone who thrives on problem-solving, values clean engineering practices, and enjoys working as part of a connected team. If you are eager to grow your technical skills, contribute to architectural discussions, and mentor others along the way, we would love to welcome your unique perspective to our community.


Key Aspects of the Role Include

  • Feature Development: Crafting high-quality backend features and services independently from well-defined requirements, applying robust coding standards.

  • Cloud Operations: Using cloud services for secure storage, authentication, and deployment while following modern practices like version control and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Open Communication: Providing concise updates in team stand-ups and proactively raising blockers early so the team can solve them together.

  • Collaboration & Mentorship: Managing your own tasks with minimal oversight while helping to onboard new team members and supporting junior colleagues.

  • Continuous Improvement: Contributing to the evolution of our internal processes by participating in retrospectives and Communities of Practice (CoP) ceremonies.

  • Performance Optimisation: Identifying application bottlenecks using profiling tools and prioritising tasks effectively during sprint planning.

What you'll bring:

We know that great developers come from all backgrounds, and no one echoes a job description 100%. If you bring a strong foundational knowledge and a passion for learning, we want to hear from you. We are looking for experience or familiarity with:

  • Core Tech Stack: Strong proficiency with C#, .NET, and Azure environments.

  • Technical Curiosity: A willingness to dive into legacy technologies and stored procedures to understand, maintain, and help modernise existing systems.

  • Architecture & Design: A solid understanding of backend architectures (including microservices and event-based systems) and a familiarity with SOLID principles.

  • Quality Practices: Awareness of code maintainability, security standards, and modern testing strategies.

  • Growth Mindset: An openness to learning new tools, contributing to architectural decisions, and a genuine drive to continuously develop your own skills.

Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often only apply to jobs if they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Waracle, we are looking for potential, passion, and collaborative spirit. If you meet many of these points and are excited about the role, please apply!

The Recruitment Process

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Acquisition Partner who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!).

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.


We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Events Project Manager
description:
About Viderity

Viderity is a HUBZone-certified and Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) delivering award-winning IT, digital, and creative solutions across federal and commercial markets. Our services span application development, creative services, cybersecurity, data analytics, strategic communications, event management, training, and program management. With over 15 years of proven success and exceptional past performance, we empower clients with innovative, measurable results.

Position Overview

The Events Project Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and execution of meetings, conferences, outreach events, and trade show exhibits in support of the Office of Legislative and Public Affairs (OLPA). This role oversees end-to-end event logistics, project management, and vendor coordination to ensure events are delivered efficiently, professionally, and in alignment with organizational objectives. The Events Project Manager collaborates with internal stakeholders, venue partners, and vendors to manage event operations, audience engagement activities, and exhibit activations across both in-person and virtual environments.

Key Responsibilities

Event Planning and Coordination

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of meetings, conferences, outreach events, and trade show exhibits.

  • Provide logistical support for internal and external events, including venue management, signage, invitations, attendance tracking, and other operational requirements.

  • Research event requirements and context to ensure leadership and staff are prepared to engage effectively with stakeholders and event audiences.

  • Recommend appropriate venues and event formats such as expos, networking sessions, breakout sessions, and concurrent sessions to support outreach objectives.

  • Manage multiple high-profile events simultaneously and respond to time-sensitive or quick-turnaround requests.

Event Logistics and Operations

  • Oversee venue coordination including contracts, electrical services, internet, rentals, décor, signage, and catering arrangements.

  • Coordinate building security requirements with venue staff and internal stakeholders.

  • Manage shipping and receiving logistics for event materials, including direct-to-site delivery, advanced warehouse shipments, overnight shipping, and event-to-event transfers.

  • Provide on-site support including event setup, breakdown, equipment coordination, and troubleshooting to ensure events run smoothly.

  • Coordinate purchasing of event-related materials and ensure documentation and reporting are completed following events.

Exhibits, Expos, and Activation Management

  • Coordinate design, development, and implementation of trade show exhibits and experiential activations.

  • Manage relationships with expo organizers, trade show vendors, and exhibit production partners.

  • Oversee the design, build, management, shipping, storage, setup, and breakdown of expo-style booth exhibits or activation kits.

  • Provide recommendations for booth design, exhibit displays, engagement strategies, and visitor experiences aligned with event objectives.

  • Manage inventory of outreach materials, educational resources, and exhibit assets.

Speaker and Attendee Coordination

  • Coordinate invitation management, RSVP tracking, and attendee engagement using event platforms such as Eventbrite or similar tools.

  • Identify and recommend speakers, moderators, or facilitators for events.

  • Manage speaker communications including collection of biographies, headshots, and presentation materials.

  • Coordinate speaker preparation including event briefings, agendas, background information, logistics details, and rehearsal sessions.

Reporting and Communication

  • Develop and distribute event surveys, analytics, and performance reports.

  • Prepare detailed after-action reports documenting event outcomes, insights, and recommendations.

  • Provide weekly updates and participate in status meetings with project stakeholders.

Qualifications

General Requirements

  • Expert-level proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud (e.g., Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop) for design of event materials, exhibits, and signage.

  • Expert-level proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Outlook.

  • Demonstrated ability to gather requirements from stakeholders and translate objectives into actionable event plans.

  • Ability to work collaboratively within cross-functional teams as well as independently on assigned projects.

  • Ability to interpret and execute creative direction from leadership and stakeholders.

  • Expert-level experience with asset management systems to organize and maintain event materials and digital assets.

  • Demonstrated expertise working with major trade exposition companies, including managing vendor relationships, purchasing materials and services, and coordinating logistics.

  • Proven ability to manage complex shipping and receiving logistics, including advanced warehouse shipments and event-to-event transfers.

  • Ability to develop comprehensive after-action reports documenting event outcomes and recommendations.

Specific Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent from an accredited four-year college or university.

  • Minimum seven (7) years of professional experience supporting trade show-style events, exhibits, and large-scale outreach initiatives.

  • Expert-level experience with project management and planning software used to manage event timelines, resources, and logistics.

  • Expert-level experience managing shipping and receiving logistics, including direct-to-site shipping, advanced warehouse shipments, overnight delivery, and event-to-event transfers.

  • Demonstrated expertise working with major trade exposition companies, including vendor management, logistics coordination, and procurement of event materials and services.

  • Professional experience managing large teams responsible for event operations, logistics, and exhibit support.

  • Expert-level knowledge of current best practices for demonstrations, trade show exhibits, and experiential event spaces.

Work Samples - Events Project Manager

  • 3-5 Pictures of expo-style booths they have managed

  • A sample (pdf/link to a dashboard or system/screenshot) report of inventory forecasting

  • A sample event checklist

What We Offer

  • Competitive hourly rate (commensurate with experience).

  • Flexible, remote work arrangement.

  • Opportunity to contribute to a high-impact, federally mandated modernization initiative.

  • Collaborative environment with direct visibility on a nationally recognized federal program.

title: Data Liaison (Business Analytics & Insights)- 6 Month Contract
description:
OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization. We work with some of the world's largest organizations across a variety of industries, including Financial Services, Specialty Retail, Telecommunications, Hospitality, and Software, helping them gain a deep understanding of their customers, develop actionable insights, and improve business processes.

Our client is a global leader in the Consumer Packaged Goods industry, with a focus on delivering data-driven insights that support commercial decision-making and business growth. Their Growth Analytics team develops dashboards and reporting solutions used by senior leadership across the organization. They are seeking a Data Liaison to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring reporting solutions accurately reflect business needs and industry metrics.

This is a 6-month remote contract with the potential for extension.

About the Role

The ideal candidate is analytical, commercially minded, and an exceptional communicator who enjoys translating business needs into actionable data requirements. You will work closely with business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers to ensure dashboards and reporting solutions are built using the correct business logic, calculations, and data sources.

This role is ideal for someone with experience in business analytics, commercial insights, or consumer insights who understands both the language of the business and the language of data. should be comfortable working closely with technical teams, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and validating data before it reaches senior leadership.

You'll also play an important role in helping the analytics team build a stronger understanding of the business, enabling them to become increasingly self-sufficient over time.

Responsibilities Include

  • Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers, translating executive requests into clear business requirements, data specifications, and analytical approaches.

  • Review dashboards, calculations, and reporting logic before release, ensuring the correct business logic, methodologies, metrics, and data sources (including syndicated datasets such as Nielsen) are used while proactively identifying and resolving reporting inaccuracies.

  • Participate in business and executive reporting discussions to understand business priorities, reporting requirements, and how data is used to support decision-making.

  • Document business metrics, calculation methodologies, and data source guidance to establish consistent reporting standards and best practices.

  • Coach and mentor analytics developers to strengthen their understanding of business metrics, commercial context, and reporting expectations, with the goal of enabling greater independence over time.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve reporting processes, strengthen communication between business and technical functions, and develop scalable documentation and best practices that enhance the long-term capability of the analytics team.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Consumer Insights, Market Research, Strategy, or a related analytical role.

  • Experience within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Retail, or a similar commercial environment is strongly preferred.

  • Experience working with syndicated data sources, particularly Nielsen, with the ability to determine the most appropriate data source for different business questions.

  • Strong understanding of retail and commercial performance metrics, including velocity, points of distribution, market share, merchandising, pricing, and related KPIs.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to validate data, calculations, business logic, and reporting accuracy.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into clear guidance for technical and analytics teams.

  • Experience collaborating with analytics, BI, engineering, or dashboard development teams in a cross-functional environment.

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools is advantageous.

  • Technical coding or dashboard development experience is not required; however, the ability to engage credibly with technical teams is essential.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Waracle is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious, and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design, and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role based in Sofia.

Are you a collaborative tech leader who thrives on building scalable solutions and uplifting those around you? As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Waracle, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our technical landscape, driving pipeline automation, and empowering engineering teams to succeed. If you are passionate about continuous growth, fostering inclusive practices, and solving meaningful technical challenges, we would love to welcome your perspective to our team.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Engineering & Automation: Designing modern, end-to-end features, and introducing scalable CI/CD pipelines to empower continuous delivery.

  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Guiding tactical direction, helping stakeholders navigate technical trade-offs, and championing robust architecture using SOLID principles.

  • Mentorship & Community: Supporting colleagues in their career journeys, conducting constructive peer reviews, and actively contributing to Waracle’s Communities of Practice.

  • System Optimisation & Security: Ensuring application security, high availability, and modularity through sound defensive engineering.

  • Collaborative Delivery: Partnering closely with clients and cross-functional team members to transform business goals into clear, impactful technical solutions.

Research shows that women and underrepresented groups often apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Waracle, we hire for potential, passion, and a collaborative mindset just as much as current experience. If you share our values and believe you can excel in this role, we strongly encourage you to apply—even if you don't tick every single box.

What you'll bring:

  • Experience designing automation workflows and robust CI/CD pipelines.

  • Strong knowledge of modern application security standards, performance optimization, and clean architecture practices (such as SOLID principles).

  • A thoughtful approach to problem-solving, with the ability to balance speed, quality, and risk mitigation effectively.

  • A supportive leadership style with an interest in mentoring peers, encouraging knowledge sharing, and fostering an inclusive team culture.

  • Excellent communication and consultative skills, with comfort presenting technical ideas to varied stakeholders.

The Recruitment Process

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner and an engineer from our technical panel who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!). It’s also a great opportunity for us to get a high-level overview of your technical background.

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Attraction Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

Healthcare and insurance:

  • Additional health insurance with dental treatment included

  • Wellbeing support

Entertainment and discounts:

  • Team parties and teambuildings

  • Multisport card

  • CoolFit card

Professional development:

  • Certification Courses

  • Learning Pathways and Transparent career paths

  • Udemy Business

  • Networking Opportunities

  • Public Speaking Opportunities

Others:

  • MacBook, peripherals, and other gadgets that are needed

  • Charity Committee

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
gravity9 is a boutique IT consulting company headquartered in the UK with offices in the US, Canada, Poland, and Colombia. Our team has deep experience in engineering, experience design and product management. We enjoy a challenge and pride ourselves on working with our clients on their most complex problems, finding elegant and flexible solutions that help them transform their businesses.

Join Our Growing Team - Future Opportunities Await!

We are excited to share that our company is experiencing significant growth and expansion, and as a result, we're on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

We want to be upfront about our hiring process. At this moment, we are in the process of securing projects that align with our business goals and objectives. Our intention is to ensure that once we bring new team members on board, they will have a meaningful and impactful role to play from day one. While we might not be able to extend an offer immediately, we are highly interested in considering you for these future projects.

If you're open to the idea of potentially joining our team in the future, we encourage you to continue with our interview process. We value your time and effort and believe that getting to know you better will help us make an informed decision.

Once you have effectively concluded the entire recruitment procedure, we will retain your profile and reach out to you once a suitable opportunity emerges. Additional interviews will not be necessary at this stage, and we anticipate being able to extend an offer to you promptly.

What does the recruitment process look like?

1. Recruiter Screen

In the first call, our recruiter will learn more about you and your story to check a potential fit for gravity9. This is also an opportunity to ask your questions about the role and company. This step might take around 60 mins.

2. Tech 1 Interview with our AI Practice Lead

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.
This step will take around 60 mins.

3. Tech 2 Interview with our software consultants

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.
This step will take around 60 mins.

4. Final Interview

You made it to the very last stage! Here we already strive to cooperate with you and give you an opportunity to meet our leadership team during this informal talk. This step will take around 30 mins.

The salary details for the role will be communicated ahead of the first recruitment meeting.


Thank you for considering the opportunity to be a part of our growing journey. We look forward to the possibility of working together and achieving great things.

Role Description

We are looking for a smart, enthusiastic AI/ML Engineer or Data Scientist who is passionate about leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning to solve complex problems. As an integral member of our team, you'll be responsible for conceptualizing, developing, and deploying innovative AI/ML solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work on diverse projects, providing bespoke solutions to our clients.

We believe small, multi-disciplinary teams are most effective in delivering complex change. As such, we are looking for someone with a collaborative mindset who is happy to be flexible and take on different responsibilities over the lifetime of our projects.

As an AI/ML Engineer, you will be an experienced developer with a strong interest in state-of-the-art AI and Machine Learning technologies. You’ll be primarily “hands-on” and actively providing technical expertise across a broad range of AI/ML disciplines, developing AI applications using LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and particularly agentic AI solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Engage with clients to understand their unique challenges and deliver tailored AI/ML solutions.

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, efficient, and robust end-to-end ML/AI systems.

  • Manage the entire ML/AI development lifecycle, including planning, pipeline management, and deployment.

  • Provide technical support to engineering team members, promoting best practices in ML engineering.

  • Collaborate with AI Practice Lead to inform and shape the company's AI strategic direction.

Role requirements - technical skills and experience

This role will suit a highly capable AI/ML Engineer with at least 5 years of experience. Skills and experience should include:

  • Extensive experience in AI/ML development, particularly in NLP, and machine learning domains.

  • Hands-on experience in developing AI applications using LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and particularly agentic AI solutions is essential

  • Proficiency in designing and maintaining AI/ML solutions that are cost-effective, accurate, and scalable.

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to think analytically.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the aptitude to navigate complex project requirements with clients and stakeholders.

  • A growth mindset with a commitment to personal and professional development.

  • Excellent command/highly proficient in spoken and written English (working directly with UK/US based clients).

Essential skills:

  • Advanced knowledge of Python specifically for machine learning and data science.

  • Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen.

  • Proficiency in cloud services related to ML/AI (e.g., Azure, OpenAI, Hugging Face, AWS, GCP).

Nice to have:

  • Certification as an Azure AI Engineer Associate or equivalent credentials is highly advantageous.

  • AWS Professional Certifications.

  • Experience with ML/DL frameworks like TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.

  • Experience with C# or Java, node.js.

  • Knowledge in MLOps, encompassing the ML applications development lifecycle and toolsets.

  • Robust software engineering background, with a track record of leading agile teams and expedited delivery of complex projects.

  • Leadership experience.

Role requirements – soft skills
Key attributes and behaviours to succeed in this role will be:

  • Customer Focus – passion for understanding the problem we are trying to solve with software and to advocate solutions to your client.

  • Delivery focus - strong analysis and problem-solving skills. Ability to evaluate, design and implement effective solutions. Flexibility to adapt skills to a spectrum of client engagements, use cases and modes of change delivery.

  • Exemplary standards of personal integrity and respect for others – professional approach to all aspects of client engagement and collaborative team working, able to quickly build relationships based on trust and transparency. Strong presentation and written and verbal communication are essential given the client facing nature of the role.

  • Value driven - Creative thinking, with aptitude for innovation and strong desire to exceed client expectations.

title: Product Manager – Payments & Billing (m/f/d)
description:
Let’s shoot for the stars:

Billing and payments sit at the center of Limehome's revenue — and we're looking for someone to take full ownership of this function from day one. This isn't a UX-focused product role; it's an operational, cross-functional one where you'll work directly with a small engineering team, Accounting, and Customer Service to make sure every payment and invoice flows correctly across our European markets.

How you’ll be hosting with heart:

  • Own the payment experience end-to-end — from guest checkout through post-stay charges — monitoring success/failure rates across methods and countries, and driving down failures (declines, gateway timeouts, 3DS/SCA issues) through product and process fixes.

  • Manage the full billing cycle for room revenue recognition across multiple countries, and act as the internal expert on how payments and billing flow through Adyen and Apaleo — spotting and closing integration gaps.

  • Partner with Accounting to resolve billing discrepancies, support reconciliation, and investigate OTA payment/payout mismatches — building durable fixes rather than one-off patches.

  • Run daily triage with the Customer Service back office, prioritizing payment-related tickets by impact and unblocking the team on edge cases.

  • Ensure invoicing compliance with VAT, city tax, and other local regulations, working closely with Accounting to flag risks early.

  • Turn recurring fixes into scalable processes and a data-driven roadmap — using SQL and product analytics to spot patterns and translate them into clear priorities for non-technical stakeholders.

What you need to shoot for the stars:

  • Solid knowledge of EU billing and payments in hospitality, plus accounting literacy — comfortable with reconciliation, invoicing logic, and financial detail without needing to be an accountant

  • Experience with agile project management and impact-based prioritization, even when everything competes for attention

  • A proven track record managing stakeholder relationships across diverse departments (Accounting, Customer Service, Engineering)

  • Working knowledge of SQL, scripting, and basic statistical analysis, plus familiarity with product analytics tools

  • A proactive, curious mindset with high ownership and autonomy in a flat structure — you ask the right questions before being asked

  • Strong, structured problem-solving under ambiguity, and the ability to explain data insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders

We're designed to stay because:

  • Hybrid Office Model: Enjoy some days in our beautiful offices or from home.

  • Competitive Salary: Live comfortably in Milan with a competitive salary.

  • Feedback: Develop yourself through constant feedback and peer reviews.

  • Oneteam: Great team spirit with regular team lunches and events.

  • Everything for our limehomies: Up to 26 paid vacation days in a year, support with mental health (Nilo.health), staycations in one of our suite Limehomes, and many more benefits.

  • Free Drinks and Snacks: We always provide fresh fruits, healthy snacks and chocolate, as well as juices and coffee.

Who we are:

Limehome is a leading tech-enabled operator in the hospitality industry offering functional, design accommodations across Europe. Using proprietary technology, Limehome delivers comfortable and convenient stays with a seamless digital guest experience for business and leisure travellers. Our vision is to be the first choice in travel for everyone, everywhere. By now, our portfolio consists of more than 10,000 apartments and hotel rooms under contract across 150 cities in 13 European countries.

title: Jachttechnicus
description:
Welkom bij Wajer Yachts – waar luxe en vakmanschap samenkomen

Bij Wajer Yachts bouwen we niet zomaar jachten; we creëren luxe ervaringen over de hele wereld. Van Heeg tot Miami, overal trekken ze bewonderende blikken. Dat is geen toeval – bij Wajer ligt de focus op innovatie, kwaliteit en ultiem comfort. En dat alles begint in Friesland, met een team van gepassioneerde vakspecialisten zoals jij.

Techniek is jouw domein. Van aircosystemen tot aan een seakeeper: alles werkt dankzij jouw precisie. Voor onze werf in Heeg zoeken we een jachttechnicus die zorgt dat onze jachten technisch perfect zijn. Klinkt dat als jouw uitdaging? Lees snel verder!


Dit wordt jouw werk

In Heeg bouwen we aan de Wajer 38, 44 en 55 – luxe jachten die stap voor stap, vanaf de romp, worden opgebouwd. Als jachttechnicus werk je aan boord van onze jachten. Jij zorgt ervoor dat alle werktuigbouwkundige installaties worden geplaatst. Denk hierbij aan drinkwaterleidingen, IPS, fenders en motoren.

Daarbij voer je o.a. de volgende werkzaamheden uit:

🛠️ Je plaatst (technische) systemen en installaties

🛠️ Je werkt nauw samen met de Elektromonteurs om de systemen aan te sluiten
🛠️ Je houdt wijzigingen in werktekeningen en technische schema’s bij en verwerkt deze

Wil je graag met eigen ogen zien hoe een dag als jachttechnicus bij Wajer eruit ziet? Andries en Klaas laten het je zien!

Dit krijg je van ons

Bij ons draait alles om kwaliteit, innovatie en passie. Dat geldt voor onze jachten én voor ons team. We dagen je dan ook uit om het beste uit jezelf te halen en beloven dat je daar elke dag plezier en gezelligheid voor terugkrijgt.

Wat je verder van ons kunt verwachten:
⭐ Een passend salaris tussen de €2.900 en €3.800 per maand

⭐ Vakantiegeld, 27 vakantiedagen en 6,5 ADV-dagen

⭐ Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per km

⭐ Een 39-urige werkweek, waarbij je op vrijdag om 15.15 uur het weekend in kunt stappen

⭐ Een jaarcontract met één maand proeftijd, die we na afloop graag verlengen

⭐ Een stabiele en eerlijke cao (Metalektro) en bijbehorend pensioenfonds (PME).

⭐ We betalen jouw vaarbewijzen (KVB 1 & 2) zodat je ook op het water uit de voeten kunt

⭐ Onbeperkt toegang tot de Wajer Academy zodat er genoeg ruimte is voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Dit ben jij

Techniek is jouw passie. Je werkt nauwkeurig, levert topkwaliteit en hebt oog voor de kleinste details. Je denkt altijd een stap verder en zoekt naar manieren om dingen nóg beter te maken.

✔️ Je hebt een mbo 3- of 4-opleiding in de richting van werktuigbouwkunde, mechatronica, maritieme techniek of autotechniek
✔️ Je bent secuur en werkt graag met hoogwaardige techniek
✔️ Je wilt jezelf ontwikkelen en steeds beter worden in je vak

Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar ook als starter of zij-instromer ben je welkom! Dus beschik jij niet over een afgeronde technische opleiding, maar ben je in je vrije tijd veel aan het klussen aan bijvoorbeeld auto’s en brommers? Dan nodigen we je ook uit om te solliciteren.

Zo stap je aan boord

Upload je cv en motivatie via onze website. Heb je nog vragen? Neem contact op met onze recruiter Lieseth Flisijn via 06-29805895. Zien we jou binnenkort op de werf voor een rondleiding?
