title: Gezinsbegeleider Hoofddorp
description:
Waar je écht dicht bij het kind staat en het verschil maakt in het dagelijks leven van gezinnen.

Functieomschrijving

Als Jeugdzorgwerker B (gezinsbegeleider) werk je 24 tot 32 uur per week met gezinnen met jonge kinderen van -9 maanden tot 7 jaar. Je komt bij gezinnen thuis, ziet wat er in het dagelijks leven gebeurt en helpt ouders om hun kind beter te begrijpen en te ondersteunen.

Je observeert, analyseert en begeleidt gezinnen in de thuissituatie en op locatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar het gedrag van het kind, maar ook naar de relatie tussen ouder en kind, de gezinsdynamiek en wat ouders nodig hebben om weer meer grip te ervaren. Je vertaalt jouw observaties naar praktische handvatten waar ouders direct mee aan de slag kunnen.

In deze rol heb je een belangrijk aandeel in de gezinsdiagnostiek. Je brengt scherp in kaart wat er speelt, denkt mee over wat nodig is en stemt in complexere situaties af met de regiebehandelaar. Je werkt zelfstandig in de gezinnen, maar staat er niet alleen voor: je kunt terugvallen op de expertise van het multidisciplinaire team.

Bij ’t Kabouterhuis hebben we allemaal dezelfde drijfveer: het jonge kind en hun ouders. Begeleiden in die eerste kwetsbare stappen maakt ons werk zo waardevol. Dat is waarom we dit doen.

Onze teams zijn bevlogen, multidisciplinair en staan altijd naast elkaar én naast ouders. Samenwerken is bij ons niet slechts een lege term, maar onderdeel van hoe we elke dag met elkaar werken. Dat maakt dat mensen jarenlang bij ’t Kabouterhuis blijven werken. Je komt terecht in een warme, betrokken groep professionals waar gelijkwaardigheid de standaard is en je altijd kunt terugvallen op collega’s.

Je hebt

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding (MWD, Social Work, Pedagogiek) of wo-opleiding

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met complexe gezinssituaties en/of psychiatrische problematiek

  • Ervaring met behandelingsgericht werken met ouders en jonge kinderen

  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie (of je kunt deze voor start regelen)

  • Kennis van ontwikkeling en psychopathologie bij jonge kinderen

  • Bereidheid om VHT-certificering te behalen (of in bezit)

  • Je bent in bezit van rijbewijs en auto

Wat je bij ons krijgt

  • Salaris volgens CAO Jeugdzorg schaal 9 (€ 3.191,69 - € 4.766,96 p/m bij fulltime)

  • Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%

  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 24 -32 uur per week voor een jaar met uitzicht op verlenging voor onbepaalde tijd.

  • Volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten en een fietsenplan

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden via De Jonge Kind Academie

  • Werken in een multidisciplinair team met een bijzondere doelgroep

  • Een dienstverband voor een jaar met mogelijkheid tot verlenging

De doelgroep – wat ons werk het mooiste werk maakt

Het hele jonge kind, daar moet je echt voor willen gaan. Je werkt met gezinnen die erg kwetsbaar zijn en veel meemaken. Met alle disciplines samen puzzel je aan het totaalbeeld: wat speelt er écht? En wat hebben dit jonge kind en de directe omgeving nodig? Dat maakt het werk uitdagend, verdiepend en ontzettend betekenisvol.

De Infant Mental Health (IMH) visie vormt het uitgangspunt van hoe wij werken, samenwerken en behandelen. Vanuit die visie blijven we leren en ons samen ontwikkelen. We zien het jonge kind altijd in de context waarin het opgroeit: de relatie met ouders, het netwerk en de omgeving. Dat vraagt om een systemische blik, een open houding en veel kennis van ontwikkeling, hechting en regulatie.

Klaar om samen het verschil te maken voor het jonge kind?

Stuur je sollicitatie in of neem contact op voor meer informatie.

We ontmoeten je graag.

Wat je kunt verwachten als je op de sollicitatie knop hebt gedrukt:

Je krijgt zo snel mogelijk reactie van ons team, daarna volgt een 1e gesprek en eventueel een 2e gesprek (bijvoorbeeld een meeloopdag). We checken je referentie (verplicht) en als we beiden enthousiast zijn doen we je een aanbod. We verwelkomen je graag in ons team.

title: Mid DevOps Engineer
description:
The Mission

Grip operates at the intersection of enterprise content operations and advanced automation. As our platform footprint expands across global enterprise clients, infrastructure reliability, deployment velocity, and system observability are no longer support functions — they are strategic enablers.

The Mid DevOps Engineer ensures our cloud infrastructure scales predictably, deploys consistently, and operates securely across Azure and AWS. This role exists to reduce manual operations, strengthen platform resilience, and turn infrastructure into a programmable, repeatable system.

You are not maintaining servers. You are building the foundation that allows engineering to ship faster, safer, and at enterprise scale.

What You Will Do

Own and Evolve CI/CD Infrastructure

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines across GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps.

  • Improve deployment velocity while increasing reliability and rollback safety.

  • Standardize pipeline-as-code practices to eliminate manual configuration drift.

  • Partner with engineering teams to reduce build failures and deployment bottlenecks.

  • Measure and optimize DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, change failure rate).

Manage Multi-Cloud Infrastructure as Code

  • Build and maintain Azure and AWS infrastructure using Pulumi.

  • Ensure infrastructure is version-controlled, reproducible, and environment-consistent.

  • Optimize compute, storage, networking, and security configurations for performance and cost efficiency.

  • Contribute to infrastructure modernization initiatives as platform scale increases.

  • Implement automated cost-monitoring and capacity planning mechanisms.

Strengthen Kubernetes & Container Operations

  • Support Kubernetes cluster management, scaling strategies, and workload optimization.

  • Improve container orchestration patterns, resource allocation, and deployment strategies.

  • Standardize Docker image best practices and runtime security configurations.

  • Improve cluster reliability and automate failover strategies.

  • Contribute to automation of environment provisioning and cluster lifecycle management.

Elevate Monitoring, Observability & Incident Response

  • Maintain and improve Kubernetes dashboards, and system health metrics.

  • Enhance observability using Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK where applicable.

  • Reduce mean time to detection and resolution through proactive monitoring design.

  • Participate in incident response and contribute to root cause analysis.

  • Implement post-incident improvement actions and preventive automation.

Embed DevSecOps and Operational Discipline

  • Integrate secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and compliance checks into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Strengthen infrastructure security posture across environments.

  • Apply least-privilege access models and secure configuration baselines.

  • Contribute to DevOps best practices documentation and internal enablement.

  • Support hiring processes and participate in technical interviews.

Who You Are

You are a hands-on infrastructure engineer who builds systems instead of manual processes. You think in automation first, consistency always. You are comfortable owning problems from detection to resolution and improving the system afterward.

You Have:

  • 3–5 years of DevOps or cloud engineering experience in production environments.

  • Proven experience with Azure and AWS (compute, networking, storage, IAM, cost optimization).

  • Solid hands-on experience with Pulumi for multi-cloud infrastructure as code.

  • Strong working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and orchestration patterns.

  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.

title: Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Want to shape the future of renewable energy? Your ideas matter here. We are building the operating system for renewable energy and simplify the management of energy assets with Amperecloud Platform – for a world where green energy drives growth.

We're looking for a sharp, product-first fullstack engineer to build the platform that 300+ energy operators rely on every day: monitoring 8,000+ solar and wind plants with more than 10 GWp under management. This is real-time, mission critical infrastructure. Live plant telemetry around the clock, alerting that has to fire within minutes, and APIs that control-room teams depend on.

You've shipped real features in production and you own them end to end, from API design to the last pixel in the browser. You'd rather fix the root cause than patch the symptom, and you say so in code review. You treat AI tools as leverage in your daily workflow, and you care about results, not hours.

You'll own one clearly scoped area of the platform and ship features across the stack. Depending on where you start, that's external APIs and Virtual Power Plant connectivity, monitoring and alarms for battery storage (BESS), or the horizontal layer every customer touches: authentication, roles and permissions, whitelabelling. Your first PR ships in week one.

Team Lead: Omkar Pimple (Head of Engineering)
Recruiter: Victor Pels-Leusden
Contract type: Full-time, permanent
Location: Berlin

# What you will do

  • Build: You design and implement new features across frontend and backend — Node.js, React, microservices on Kubernetes

  • APIs: You develop and maintain the external APIs that connect inverters, data loggers, and third-party systems to one platform, including Virtual Power Plant connectivity

  • Real-Time Data: You work on ingestion, processing, and alerting for live telemetry from thousands of plants

  • Quality: You troubleshoot and resolve bugs before customers notice them, supported by Grafana and Prometheus

  • Collaborate: You work in a small cross-functional team where engineering, product, and the person who talks to the customer sit together. Decisions happen where you sit, not three levels up

  • Ramp-up: In your first 6 months, you master our stack, ship platform features, and own your own platform areas

# What we offer

  • Ownership: Your features, your decisions, your responsibility. From day one, not after a probation year

  • Mission Critical Impact: Your code runs real renewable energy infrastructure. When your deploy improves alerting, an operator somewhere catches a failure hours earlier. No feature flags, no three approval rounds

  • Direct Access: Short paths, small team, no alignment theater. Architecture discussions happen in the team, with you at the table

  • Growth: The platform is scaling fast, and engineers who grow with it move into architecture decisions, not into management by default

  • AI with Purpose: AI tooling in the daily engineering workflow as standard: licenses for everyone, used where it creates real leverage, not hype

  • Environment: Office first in Berlin with limited home office flexibility, because we build faster in person

# What you bring

  • Fullstack: ~5 years of professional experience shipping production software with Node.js and React, ideally a SaaS platform real users depend on

  • Track record: You've shipped at a high-growth startup or top-tier tech company and know what production quality at pace looks like

  • Backend: You have designed, built, and maintained APIs that others depend on

  • Infrastructure: You're comfortable working in a Kubernetes/microservices environment

  • Debugging: You track down issues systematically instead of guessing

  • English: Fluent (our working language). German is not required

  • Nice to have: Grafana/Prometheus, time-series data, or a background in the energy sector

# Who you are

  • Entrepreneurial: You act like an owner: you spot problems nobody assigned you and fix them without waiting for permission

  • Team player: You make the people around you better through honest code reviews and shared context. No lone-wolf heroics

  • Thinker: You question the ticket before you build it. Tech serves the product, not the other way around

  • Ambitious: You aim high, ship, learn from what breaks, and go again with a better approach

Not for you if: you’re bureaucratic, conflict-avoidant, risk-averse, 9-to-5, anti-AI, a poor communicator, or a hardcore introvert.

We evaluate based on ability and potential, independent of age, gender identity, origin, sexual orientation, disability, or religion.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Grip is shifting enterprise content production from manual, tool-driven workflows to programmable systems that generate high-quality visual output at scale. As a Senior AI Engineer, you build the control layer behind that shift: AI Controllers, reusable templates, and workflow primitives that translate brand intent into deterministic, production-ready outputs.

This is not prompt engineering. This is designing systems that constrain, guide, and scale generative models into reliable creative production pipelines used by global brands.

What You Will Do

Build AI-Controlled Content Systems

  • Architect and ship AI Controllers that encode visual logic (composition, layout, constraints) into reusable systems

  • Translate creative direction into structured pipelines (e.g., turning logo safe zones into enforceable spatial constraints)

  • Design templates that produce consistent outputs across thousands of variations

Develop and Scale AI Workflows

  • Build and optimize ComfyUI pipelines integrating multiple models, refiners, and control mechanisms

  • Combine segmentation, depth maps, and latent constraints to guide generation toward production-grade outputs

  • Iterate on workflows based on output quality, failure modes, and client requirements

Own Model Behavior and Output Quality

  • Work hands-on with diffusion models, encoders, and latent space manipulation

  • Define how prompts, conditioning, and control signals interact across the pipeline

  • Ensure outputs meet brand and visual standards—not just “good images,” but usable assets

Extend Platform Capabilities

  • Contribute to new node definitions and AI capabilities within Grip’s platform

  • Specify technical requirements for new features across Python/PyTorch systems

  • Collaborate with engineers and creative teams to push what’s possible in automated content generation

Who You Are

You build systems that make AI predictable, controllable, and production-ready—especially in visual domains.

You Have:

  • Strong experience with generative AI systems (diffusion models, conditioning, latent space control)

  • Hands-on work in ComfyUI or similar node-based pipelines

  • Solid programming skills (Python, PyTorch) with experience shipping working systems

  • Experience training or fine-tuning models and managing their lifecycle

  • Exposure to visual tools like Photoshop, Blender, or similar (not optional thinking—actual usage)

You Think:

  • In systems, not prompts—how components interact, fail, and scale

  • In constraints—how to guide models toward predictable outputs

  • In outputs—what makes something production-ready vs. visually interesting

  • Pragmatically—you ship working solutions and refine based on results

Your Skills Are:

  • Translating abstract creative direction into structured AI workflows

  • Debugging generation pipelines across multiple control layers

  • Balancing flexibility with control in template systems

  • Communicating across engineering and creative teams

Why Join Grip?

The Platform Position.
Grip is infrastructure for enterprise creative production—powering global brands to generate content at scale with control and consistency.

The Market Timing.
AI-generated content is moving from experimentation to production. The challenge is no longer generation—it’s control, reliability, and scale.

The Technical Moat.
You’ll work with ComfyUI-based workflows, multi-tenant architecture, and a stack spanning TypeScript, Python, Elixir, and C#—built for production, not demos.

The Work.
You will define how AI is actually used in real-world creative systems—turning unpredictable models into dependable pipelines.

The procedure

If you’re ready to bring your powers to a role where you can make a difference, we want to hear from you. Send your resume and portfolio in English via the link provided. If you have questions, contact our Recruitment Department at jobs@indg.com.

INDG Grip handles and uses personal data of job applicants in line with its Recruitment Privacy Policy.

title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior .NET Developer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role working from our Sofia office 2 days a week, offering you the perfect balance of collaborative in-person connection and focused remote flexibility.

Key Aspects of the Role

As a Senior .Net Developer, you’ll be a technical pillar within your squad, focusing on the design and delivery of end-to-end features and subsystems. We believe that great software is built through collaboration and high craft standards.

In this role, you won't just write code; you will help shape our technical direction, mentor aspiring developers, and ensure our solutions are modular, inclusive, and scalable. If you enjoy solving puzzles and empowering others to grow, you’ll fit right into the team!

Duties of this role include:

  • Technical Excellence: Designing and delivering end-to-end features while optimising for performance, accessibility, and responsiveness.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Leading specific workstreams and mentoring junior colleagues in both technical craft and professional processes.

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Translating complex technical trade-offs into plain language and confidently presenting demos to help shape tactical direction for our clients.

  • Community Building: Contributing to our Community of Practice and representing Waracle’s culture in recruitment and interview panels.

Research shows that women and underrepresented groups often apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Waracle, we hire for potential, passion, and a collaborative mindset just as much as current experience. If you share our values and believe you can excel in this role, we strongly encourage you to apply—even if you don't tick every single box.

What You'll Bring:

  • 3+ experience delivering complex digital products, with deep expertise in .NET and Angular, building scalable, secure, and maintainable full-stack solutions.

  • Strong experience designing and developing cloud-based applications using Azure, with an understanding of modern architecture patterns and best practices.

  • Strong understanding of solid principles, clean code practices, maintainability, and security standards.

  • A collaborative and supportive mentoring style, providing constructive feedback through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance.

The Recruitment Process

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner and an engineer from our technical panel who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!). It’s also a great opportunity for us to get a high-level overview of your technical background.

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Attraction Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

Healthcare and insurance:

  • Additional health insurance with dental treatment included

  • Wellbeing support

Entertainment and discounts:

  • Team parties and teambuildings

  • Multisport card

  • CoolFit card

Professional development:

  • Certification Courses

  • Learning Pathways and Transparent career paths

  • Udemy Business

  • Networking Opportunities

  • Public Speaking Opportunities

Others:

  • MacBook, peripherals, and other gadgets that are needed

  • Charity Committee

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Logopedist Amsterdam Noord
description:
Waar je écht dicht bij het kind staat en het verschil maakt in het dagelijks leven van gezinnen.

Functieomschrijving

Als Logopedist op onze locatie Amsterdam Noord werk je met jonge kinderen tot 7 jaar voor wie communiceren niet vanzelfsprekend is. Je onderzoekt en behandelt spraak‑ en taalproblemen en kijkt daarbij altijd verder dan alleen het kind: je betrekt ouders, de groep en de omgeving waarin het kind opgroeit. Je vertaalt jouw logopedische expertise naar praktische handvatten voor thuis, op de groep en op school.

Locatie Noord heeft meerdere behandelgroepen en een ambulant aanbod voor gezinnen uit Amsterdam en Zaanstreek-Waterland. Je werkt individueel én op de groep, sluit aan bij multidisciplinaire overleggen en puzzelt samen met collega’s op complexe ontwikkelingsvragen, zoals autismespectrumstoornissen en bredere ontwikkelingsproblematiek. Jij bent degene die logopedie inbrengt in het totaalbeeld.

Op deze locatie ben jij de enige Logopedist. Dat maakt dit een zelfstandige rol met veel ruimte om jouw vakgebied verder vorm te geven. Tegelijkertijd sta je er niet alleen voor: je werkt in een betrokken multidisciplinair team en kunt sparren met logopedisten van onze andere locaties. Via onze eigen Jonge Kind Academie kun je je verder verdiepen in het jonge kind en het volgen van bijvoorbeeld de PRT-opleiding is bespreekbaar, zodat je jouw expertise blijft ontwikkelen.

De functie is voor 16 uur per week, waarbij het aantal uur en de werkdagen bespreekbaar zijn.

Bij ’t Kabouterhuis hebben we allemaal dezelfde drijfveer: het jonge kind en hun ouders. Begeleiden in die eerste kwetsbare stappen maakt ons werk zo waardevol. Dat is waarom we dit doen.

Onze teams zijn bevlogen, multidisciplinair en staan altijd naast elkaar én naast ouders. Samenwerken is bij ons niet slechts een lege term, maar onderdeel van hoe we elke dag met elkaar werken. Dat maakt dat mensen jarenlang bij ’t Kabouterhuis blijven werken. Je komt terecht in een warme, betrokken groep professionals waar gelijkwaardigheid de standaard is en je altijd kunt terugvallen op collega’s.

Je hebt

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Logopedie en bij voorkeur enkele jaren werkervaring, al dan niet met jonge kinderen

  • Je bent 16 uur per week beschikbaar, dagen en uren zijn bespreekbaar

  • Je staat bij voorkeur geregistreerd in het Kwaliteitsregister Paramedici. Ben je nog niet kwaliteitsgeregistreerd? Dan kijken we graag met je mee wat nodig is om dit te behalen.

  • Affiniteit met de doelgroep jonge kinderen met complexe ontwikkelingsproblematiek, waaronder autismespectrumstoornissen

  • Het is een pre als je ervaring hebt met eet en drinkproblematiek bij jonge kinderen en/of kennis van sensorische integratie en PRT

  • Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal is voor deze functie vereist

Wat je bij ons krijgt

  • Een salaris volgens CAO Jeugdzorg schaal 9 (€ 3.191,69 - € 4.766,96 p/m bij 36 uur)

  • Een dienstverband 16 uur per wee (werkdagen en uren zijn bespreekbaar)

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%

  • Volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten en een fietsenplan

  • Leren en ontwikkelen in ons eigen opleidingsinstituut: De Jonge Kind Academie – met o.a. mogelijkheden om je te verdiepen in IMH en PRT

  • Een bevlogen team dat altijd naast je staat

  • Werken met een unieke én kwetsbare doelgroep binnen een multidisciplinair team

De doelgroep – wat ons werk het mooiste werk maakt!

Het hele jonge kind, daar moet je echt voor willen gaan. Je werkt met gezinnen die erg kwetsbaar zijn en veel meemaken. Met alle disciplines samen puzzel je aan het totaalbeeld: wat speelt er écht? En wat hebben dit jonge kind en de directe omgeving nodig? Dat maakt het werk uitdagend, verdiepend en ontzettend betekenisvol.

De Infant Mental Health (IMH) visie vormt het uitgangspunt van hoe wij werken, samenwerken en behandelen. Vanuit die visie blijven we leren en ons samen ontwikkelen. We zien het jonge kind altijd in de context waarin het opgroeit: de relatie met ouders, het netwerk en de omgeving. Dat vraagt om een systemische blik, een open houding en veel kennis van ontwikkeling, hechting en regulatie.

Klaar om samen het verschil te maken voor het jonge kind?

Stuur je sollicitatie in, we ontmoeten je graag.

Heb je vooraf nog vragen? Neem contact op met Arianne Rietdijk via a.rietdijk@kabouterhuis.nl.

Wat je kunt verwachten als je op de sollicitatie knop hebt gedrukt:

Je krijgt binnen een week reactie van ons team, daarna volgt een 1e gesprek en eventueel een 2e gesprek (bijvoorbeeld een meeloopdag). We checken je referentie (verplicht) en als we beiden enthousiast zijn doen we je een aanbod. We verwelkomen je graag in ons team.

As a Cloud Consultant/Architect with us, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with leading organizations and leverage cutting-edge technologies to optimize their data centers.

This is your chance: At ITQ, we offer you an environment where you can learn and grow—together with colleagues who maintain high standards of quality. We are passionate about our customers, but equally passionate about developing our people with new skills and ways of working.

Your Role at ITQ:

As a Cloud Consultant/Architect, you will support our clients in transforming their traditional data centers into modern, flexible, and efficient software-defined environments. Working closely with customers, you’ll understand their business requirements and develop tailored solutions using the latest technologies. You’ll be there to save the day—by simplifying complex data center infrastructures or cloud environments, reducing costs, and increasing overall performance.

The Benefits at ITQ:

Integration:

  • A comprehensive onboarding process, followed by an informal lunch or dinner with your “buddy.”

ITQ:

  • A friendly atmosphere with a strong corporate culture.

  • Regular team events (team building, after-work events, partner/publisher conferences).

  • Flexible working hours and the option for remote work.

Excellence:

  • Collaboration with top experts in their field, participation in regular trade fairs and events, as well as global networking opportunities.

  • Involvement in innovative and large-scale projects.

  • Continuous training programs and sponsored certifications.

  • A clear and ambitious vision for the future, with openness to your ideas and feedback.

What We Offer You:

  • Numerous opportunities for your personal and professional development.

  • A competitive salary package, a collective bonus, and an annual budget for training and certifications.

  • A company car or mobility budget.

  • A remote work budget to set up your workspace.

  • Social benefits such as retirement provisions and an employee savings plan.

  • The chance to be part of a warm and inclusive team—the ITQ family.

Your Tasks and Technologies:

You bring solid experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • VMware technologies (one or more) such as VMware vSphere, vSAN, Aria Operations, or NSX; experience in a Dell VxRail environment is a strong plus.

  • Design, implementation, and optimization of AWS architectures, including cloud migrations, security, and cost optimization.

  • Planning, implementation, and administration of Red Hat Enterprise Linux, as well as related technologies such as OpenShift, Ansible, and Satellite.

  • HashiCorp technologies, particularly Terraform for Infrastructure-as-Code and Vault for secret management.

You are hands-on experienced with Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI) solutions—experience in this area is an advantage.
You have architectural knowledge in the field of SDDC with a solid understanding of x86 virtualization, operating systems, advanced networking, and storage architectures.
You hold up-to-date industry-standard certifications and are willing to acquire further certifications.


What We Expect From You:

  • You are passionate about your work as a Consultant or Architect and can identify customer use cases and translate them into concrete solutions.

  • You are fluent in German and can communicate confidently in English.

  • You are curious about new technologies—because that’s exactly your thing.

  • You live in Germany.

Do you have stories from the field that could help others stay safe and prepared?

For our newest training center in Bremen, we are looking for a driven and passionate Instructor (m/f/d) who wants to help build, grow and shape a brand-new location. Here, you’re not just delivering training, you are laying the foundation, setting the standard and playing a key role in our international journey.

Who are we?

At FMTC Safety, everything revolves around people and safety. We are a fast-growing, global organization preparing professionals to work safely in some of the world’s most demanding environments: from offshore platforms and wind farms to ships and industrial sites.

What makes us different?

We go where our clients need us. With training centers strategically located around the world, we offer maximum flexibility: in timing, location and delivery. Our mindset is simple: we make it happen. Even if there’s only one participant, the training goes ahead.

This requires more than just knowledge, it requires passion, flexibility and a true customer-first mentality. And that’s exactly what defines our instructors.

As an Instructor (m/f/d) in Bremen, you are at the heart of our new training center. You don’t just deliver courses, you create impactful learning experiences that truly prepare people for real-life situations.

This role exists because of our rapid growth and ambitious expansion plans. That means you have a unique opportunity: to be there from day one and actively shape the future of this location.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Bij ITQ bouwen we hard aan onze positie in de Cloud Native-wereld. Ben jij daarom op zoek om écht impact te hebben én heb je ervaring met DevOps-thema’s zoals platformautomatisering, CI/CD, containers en Kubernetes? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Over ITQ en het Cloud Native team.

Wij bieden maatwerkoplossingen die klanten helpen hun IT-processen te optimaliseren. Binnen het Cloud Native team werk je samen met 13 getalenteerde en gedreven collega’s. We hebben allemaal onze eigen interesses en ervaring, maar delen graag kennis met elkaar tijdens een van onze kennissessies (zoals de Bits & Bytes sessies) of de teamdagen. Verder houden we ons op een dagelijkse basis bezig met:

  • Dev Enablement: Onze experts versterken de Dev-teams van onze klanten om moderne software ontwikkelmethoden te omarmen.

  • Strategie & Coaching: Samen succesvolle cloud-native strategieën en technologie-roadmaps ontwikkelen

  • Platform Engineering & implementatie: Bouwen, onderhouden en schalen van cloud-native platformen.

Jouw rol bij ITQ:

Als Cloud Engineer bij ITQ ben je een belangrijke schakel binnen ons Cloud Native team. Je helpt klanten met het ontwerpen, bouwen en beheren van moderne platformen op basis van cloud-native technologieën zoals Kubernetes en containers. Je zet CI/CD pipelines op, automatiseert deployments en zorgt dat platformen schaalbaar, veilig en betrouwbaar draaien.

Daarnaast blijf je op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in Cloud-native technologieën en DevOps-praktijken, zodat je voortdurend kan bijdragen aan verbetering en optimalisatie.

Dus heb jij ervaring met (een of meerdere van) deze technologieën:

  • Kubernetes, Docker en bij voorkeur CKA/CKAD (of bereid dit te behalen).

  • Red Hat en/of OpenShift.

  • Git en GitOps-principes.

  • VMware en/of hyperscale clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP) en tools als Terraform of CloudFormation

Kom dan gauw eens kennismaken!

Wat bieden we jou:

  • Je werkt samen met de besten uit het vak, bezoekt regelmatig beurzen en spreekt gelijkgestemden over de hele wereld.

  • Een competitief salarispakket, inclusief de mogelijkheid tot een leaseauto/mobiliteitsbudget, een collectieve bonus en jaarlijks budget voor training en certificering.

  • Aanzienlijke ruimte voor je eigen ontwikkelen – zowel professioneel als persoonlijk.

  • Bij ITQ werk je niet alleen aan technologie, maar ook aan het succes van de klant. Je krijgt de kans om mee te denken over strategische keuzes en werkt hybride: bij de klant, op kantoor of thuis.

  • Je krijgt een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarbij je jouw nieuwe collega’s goed leert kennen.

  • Een kans om deel uit te maken van een warme, inclusieve ITQ-familie.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (GCP)
description:

The role involves deploying a managed GenAI SaaS platform into regulated client environments. Deep Google Cloud Platform knowledge is required as you will work on client-side in GCP and deploy data-plane environments, landing zones, and policy guardrails, and connect them to the existing Azure control plane.

This is a remote-first contract position with a required overlap of Australian working hours (7-10 AM CET).

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy and initialize: Client-plane data environments in GCP and connect them to the existing Azure control plane.

  • Design and deploy: Landing zones and tenant onboarding patterns.

  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines that enable reliable, automated delivery across development, testing, staging, and production.

  • Take ownership of: Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) and GitOps (Flux).

  • Implement: Cross-cloud, cross-tenant management pattern & cross-cloud telemetry (Grafana / Telegraf)

  • Define: networking, security policies, landing-zone configuration

Work Conditions

  • Start Date: ASAP

  • Location: Remote (99%) in Europe; must be able to travel freely within Europe for workshops.

  • Australian Time Zone Overlap: Required (7 AM - 10 AM CET)

  • Contract with European LLC

  • Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer or Cloud Engineer, or Platform Engineer.

  • Strong expertise of GCP, especially resource hierarchy, Organization Policy Service, IAM, VPC Service Controls, GKE.

  • Experience with Azure cloud services and understanding Azure Lighthouse

  • Proven experience in multi-tenant solutions.

  • Knowledge of Multi-cloud / hybrid architecture

  • Strong hands-on expertise with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), observability, secrets management, and secure deployment practices.

  • Understanding of data residency / sovereignty requirements for regulated clients.

  • Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, security, and operational best practices.

  • Solid working knowledge of tools such as:

    • Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar

    • Terraform

    • Grafana (with Prometheus, Telegraf, … ), Datadog...

    • Flux, ArgoCD, …

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills, ability to work in a team environment, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with AWS

  • Experience with Customer-managed keys / encryption

  • Deploying deploying GenAI / RAG workloads

  • Exposure to data-intensive and AI-driven products with a focus on performance, scalability, and portability.

ABOUT MANUAL

MANUAL delivers healthcare at scale thanks to its comprehensive digital clinic. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lives for a large part of the population in the UK, Brazil, and beyond focusing on life-impeding conditions like hormonal imbalance, obesity and hair loss.

MANUAL has steadily grown since inception and is now serving 500k+ patients, across 2 geographies. We are centralising the diagnosis, custom medications, doctor specialist services, behavioural change and fully vertically integrated management of the treatment journey, under one roof and consumer brand.

We’re destigmatising how people approach their health by offering easy access to diagnostics, a holistic range of treatments, ongoing care and medical advice, as well as a community to help proactively improve one’s health and wellbeing. A place that didn't exist until now.

Innovating on healthcare delivery, MANUAL provides patients with engaging treatment plans generating superior clinical outcomes: 90%+ of patients see an improvement in their Quality of Life (QoL) within 6 months. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lifespan for a big part of the population in the UK, Brazil and beyond.

After a $30 million Series A round, we are on a mission to build one of the most impactful teams in the healthcare space. We are looking for incredibly ambitious, entrepreneurial, driven and fun people to join us as we accelerate our growth and expansion. This is an exciting time to join the UK’s fastest-growing healthtech and help supercharge our mission.

title: Azure Cloud Engineer
description:
About Deepdesk

Deepdesk powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands like Rabobank, Vodafone, and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Cloud Engineer to join the Deepdesk team and support our expansion into Microsoft Azure. Currently built on GCP, we need someone with the expertise to help us replicate, migrate, and bridge our existing infrastructure into the Azure ecosystem, while maintaining our current high standards for scalability and uptime.

This is a hands-on technical role at the heart of a significant infrastructure evolution. You will own the Azure setup, manage services across both cloud environments, and play a key part in shaping how Deepdesk scales globally.

Key Responsibilities

• Cloud Expansion: Lead the technical setup of Deepdesk resources within Azure, ensuring parity with our existing GCP environment.

• Hybrid Infrastructure: Manage and optimise services across both GCP and Azure, with a focus on cross-cloud connectivity and consistency.

• Infrastructure as Code: Use Terraform to maintain source-of-truth configurations for both cloud providers.

• CI/CD and Automation: Adapt existing deployment pipelines to support multi-cloud release cycles.

What We’re Looking For

Azure (Primary Focus)

• Deep experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure App Service, and Azure Networking including VNETs and ExpressRoute.

GCP (Secondary Focus)

• Strong working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform, specifically GKE, Cloud Storage, Cloud Build, and IAM.

Core Technical Skills

• Advanced proficiency in Terraform, essential for managing multi-cloud environments.

• Expertise in Docker and Kubernetes orchestration across different cloud environments.

• Experience managing DNS, load balancing, and security groups in a hybrid or multi-cloud setup.

Competencies We Value

• Bridge builder, the ability to translate GCP workflows into Azure best practices and bring clarity to a complex multi-cloud transition.

• Adaptability, comfortable working in a transition phase as we build out new infrastructure in parallel with an existing production environment.

• Strategic thinking, the ability to identify potential pitfalls such as cross-cloud latency or data egress costs, and to proactively design around them.

Why Join Us?

• Play a central role in a meaningful cloud infrastructure transformation at a fast-growing AI company.

• Work within a collaborative, technically strong engineering team that values ownership and initiative.

• Be part of a global group spanning 28 countries, with the backing of AnywhereNow’s wider platform and resources.

• No two days are the same in a fast-moving, innovation-led environment where your work directly shapes the product.

Additional Information

AnywhereNow is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We accept difference and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.

Please note that we have a background check policy. The background check differs per country and position. If you would like to know more, the Talent Acquisition team are happy to answer any questions.

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organization’s information security standards. This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures, and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer, and partner data from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices, and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches, or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

title: CG Art Director
description:
INDG is looking for a 3D Art Director to lead the visual direction of CGI stills, animations, and interactive product experiences for Global brands.

You will connect creative intent with CGI execution. The role sits between product storytelling, visual quality, and scalable digital twin production. You will define how products are lit, framed, rendered, animated, reviewed, and delivered across formats.

What You Will Do

Own the Creative Direction

  • Translate briefs into clear visual concepts.

  • Build mood boards, references, storyboards, sketches, and pitch direction.

  • Define the look and feel for stills, animations, and interactive outputs.

  • Shape product storytelling around realism, function, materiality, and brand intent.

Direct CGI Production

  • Lead virtual shoots across lighting, camera, composition, materials, and animation.

  • Review renders and identify issues in shaders, reflections, scene setup, comp, or product accuracy.

  • Give CGI teams precise feedback they can act on.

  • Keep the work visually strong without losing production control.

Protect Quality at Scale

  • Maintain consistency across product variants, channels, and deliverables.

  • Balance visual ambition with timelines, scope, render cost, and review cycles.

  • Work closely with Producers, Project Managers, creative technologists, and CGI teams.

  • Make sure the final output works as both image and system.

Who You Are

You sit between art direction, CGI production, and product storytelling.

You Have

  • 5+ years in art direction, ideally in CGI, product visualization, digital production, or agency environments.

  • A strong portfolio or reel showing product-focused CGI work.

  • Hands-on understanding of 3D pipelines, virtual production, digital lighting, materials, rendering, and compositing.

  • Experience working directly with brands, stakeholders, Producers, and CGI teams.

  • Healthcare or consumer electronics experience is a strong plus.

You Think

  • Visual quality comes from systems, not last-minute polish.

  • Strong product imagery needs realism, consistency, and technical control.

  • Good direction gives artists usable decisions, not vague taste feedback.

  • Scalable production matters as much as the hero frame.

Your Skills Are

  • CGI art direction

  • Virtual shoot direction

  • Product storytelling

  • Look development

  • Visual QA

  • Creative feedback

  • Client presentation

  • Production-aware decision making

Why Join INDG

  • INDG has 20+ years of experience in CGI, 3D, digital twins, and visual production systems.

  • Grip orchestrates AI-assisted workflows and production-grade visual output.

  • Global brands trust INDG to represent products with accuracy, consistency, and craft.

  • You will shape how healthcare and consumer electronics products become scalable digital assets.

The Procedure

Please send your resume/portfolio and cover letter in English via the link provided. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact our Recruitment Department at jobs@indg.com

title: Elektromonteur
description:
Welkom bij Wajer Yachts – waar luxe en vakmanschap samenkomen

Bij Wajer Yachts bouwen we niet zomaar jachten; we creëren luxe ervaringen over de hele wereld. Van Heeg tot Miami, overal trekken ze bewonderende blikken. Dat is geen toeval – bij Wajer ligt de focus op innovatie, kwaliteit en ultiem comfort. En dat alles begint in Friesland, met een team van gepassioneerde vakspecialisten zoals jij.

Elektriciteit is jouw domein. Van navigatie tot verlichting: alles werkt dankzij jouw precisie. Voor onze werf in Heeg zoeken we een elektromonteur die zorgt dat onze jachten (elektro)technisch perfect zijn. Klinkt dat als jouw uitdaging? Lees snel verder!


Dit wordt jouw werk

In Heeg bouwen we aan de Wajer 38, 44 en 55 – luxe jachten die stap voor stap, vanaf de romp, worden opgebouwd. Als elektromonteur werk je óf in de voormontage, óf direct aan boord van de jachten. Je hebt een belangrijke rol in monteren, installeren en aansluiten van elektrotechnische systemen, waarbij je je voornamelijk richt op drie belangrijke onderdelen: het dieselpaneel, het hoofdpaneel en het laadpaneel.

Daarbij voer je o.a. de volgende werkzaamheden uit:

🛠️ Je plaatst en sluit elektro(technische) systemen en installaties aan

🛠️ Je stelt en regelt de bijbehorende parameters in

🛠️ Je monteert en bedraadt verschillende licht technische componenten en verdeelinrichtingen
🛠️ Je houdt wijzigingen in werktekeningen en technische schema’s bij en verwerkt deze

🛠️ Je helpt het team van jachttechniek met de aansluiting van aircosystemen en leidingwerk

Wil je graag met eigen ogen zien hoe een dag als elektromonteur bij Wajer eruit ziet? Nico laat het je zien!

Dit krijg je van ons

Bij ons draait alles om kwaliteit, innovatie en passie. Dat geldt voor onze jachten én voor ons team. We dagen je dan ook uit om het beste uit jezelf te halen en beloven dat je daar elke dag plezier en gezelligheid voor terugkrijgt.

Wat je verder van ons kunt verwachten:

title: QA Engineer
description:
Location: Fully Remote (Global)

Classification: Full-time; 40 hours per week

Pay Range: €51,000-90,000

Experience: 2+ years as a QA engineer

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! Our K-8 platforms include Miacademy, Always Icecream, and Clever Dragons, and our 9-12 options include MiaPrep and MiaPrep Online High School. Our student base is rapidly growing, and we’re hiring for multiple positions across several departments! Our expansion stems from our commitment to providing exceptional educational content and our pursuit of new opportunities. 🚀

▶️ You can hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company’s values and future!

How you’ll make an impact (position summary):

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

The Role

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our current QA team. You'll take ownership of how we test, validate, and sign off on quality across our platform. We're actively investing in our QA practice: expanding automated test coverage, improving our release testing process, and moving toward a model where quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle.

You'll report to a technical Engineering Manager and work alongside engineers who value clear test documentation, reliable automation, and confident code releases.

As a mature company, we have legacy systems and established manual testing workflows, but we are transitioning to modern automated testing practices using Playwright and TypeScript. The split between manual and automated work varies, but you should be comfortable working across both, bringing automation where it adds the most value while pragmatically maintaining manual coverage where it's still the right tool.

A core goal of our QA evolution is to make testing faster, more reliable, and less dependent on last-minute changes before each release: replacing fragile manual regression cycles with stable automated suites, reducing flakiness, and building coverage that the whole team can rely on. Every testing investment is measured by whether it improves quality and reduces the team's burden at release time.

What You'll Do

  • Write and maintain automated regression tests; review automation MRs from peers

  • Execute manual testing across web UIs (functional, regression, cross-platform, responsive layouts on mobile/tablet)

  • Create and maintain test cases, checklists, and test documentation in TestRail

  • File clear, actionable bug reports with reproduction steps; collaborate with developers to triage and resolve

  • Own the release testing process to ensure only high-quality changes ship

  • Partner with PMs and designers on requirements review, edge cases, and acceptance criteria

  • Contribute to QA process improvements as we scale (currently a 2-person team growing to 4)

How We Work

We believe you should know what your days look like before you accept an offer.

We don't have much bureaucracy. Small team, direct communication, short decision loops. If you've worked at places where opening a Jira ticket to request a Jira ticket was normal, this isn't that. Here's the reality:

Meetings (yes, we keep them minimal):

  • Daily standup with your product team. Show up, share updates and unblock each other..

  • Sprint planning and retrospectives with your product team, once per sprint.

  • 1:1 with your Engineering Manager - Regular cadence, your agenda.

  • Monthly Engineering all-hands.

  • That's it. The rest of your time is yours to work.

Deployments:

  • Bi-monthly release cadence with a schedule published in advance. As a QA Engineer, you own the release testing window. Coordinating with developers, running regression suites, and signing off on quality before the release.

  • Infrequent ad-hoc hotfixes

Communication:

  • Async-friendly. Documentation-first.

  • Slack/ Jira/ GitLab MRs/ Notion

  • Google Workspace for email and documents.

  • Zoom for video calls.

Timezone:

  • We need significant overlap with typical CET (Central European Time) working hours to coordinate and collaborate synchronously. Additionally we have stakeholders and developers in US timezones that we occasionally need to meet.

What We're Looking For

Requirements (Requisite Skills):

  • 2+ years of QA engineering experience, including web UI testing

  • 2+ years of experience with Playwright or a similar test automation framework (e.g. Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer)

  • 2+ years of experience using TypeScript

  • Strong test design skills: comfortable writing and maintaining test cases, checklists, and test documentation

  • Familiarity with QA's role in the SDLC and how to collaborate with developers and PMs

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • Upper-intermediate English (B2+) for written and spoken communication

  • Strong experience in manual testing and writing manual test cases

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accessibility and/or security testing

How you’ll work with other teams:

Career Growth

We have a defined career ladder. Whether your path leads toward Senior/Staff QA Engineer or Engineering Management, there's room to grow - and we'll work with you to get there.

Onboarding

Every team member gets full support throughout onboarding, and no one expects you to figure out the ins and outs on your own. We'll pair with you, answer every question, and make sure you have the context you need. New hires typically feel very supported at Miaplaza.

What success looks like here: In the first couple of months, you're asking a lot of clarifying questions, reading documentation, exploring the product independently, and writing and running tests with confidence. By months 3-4, you're taking ownership of a specific area, building out test coverage, identifying gaps, and driving quality improvements. By month 5-6, you're contributing meaningfully to the testing strategy for migration and modernisation work and operating independently. The common thread: curiosity, initiative, and the habit of investigating before you ask, but always asking when you need to.

Interview Process

Our process is staged and designed to respect your time. Expect a mix of introductory conversation, technical discussion, and practical evaluation. We want to understand how you think about real problems and testing practices. As part of the process, we will ask for professional references and conduct a background check. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, let us know, we're happy to help.

Compensation

Competitive compensation, open to negotiation based on your experience and expertise. We'll discuss specifics early in the process so neither side wastes time. Since we’re remote-first, every arrangement is different; we tailor time off, benefits, and perks as part of your individual contract to ensure the overall package works for both sides.

Ready to apply?

Join our team at Miaplaza! Start by submitting your application and resume. Our hiring process involves a screening call, followed by a behavioral interview, and two technical interviews.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Are you ready to step onto the playing field of a fast growing US tech startup that's changing the game in the world of sports?

GoodRec is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own real product end to end and ship it to players in 80+ cities. You'll be the person who takes the hardest problems, decides how to solve them, and gets them live, working directly with our founders on what to build and why. This is a builder role first. You own features from the first line of code to the moment players are using them, and you do it with real ownership rather than a queue of tickets.

About us:

GoodRec started 4 years ago with a small community in Brooklyn, New York. Since then, we have grown into the largest pickup sports app in North America. With the GoodRec app, finding a pickup game, league, or tournament near you is fast and easy. All you have to do is tap the app, join a game, and show up ready to play!

Check out the GoodRec app here:

What you'll do

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

  • Own features end to end across our iOS and Android app, from the first line of code to the moment players in 80+ cities are using them.

  • Take the hardest technical problems and make the call on how to solve them. You set the approach, you make the tradeoffs, and you're accountable for what ships.

  • Build the internal tools and automations that keep GoodRec running, scripting away the manual work and wiring our systems together so the whole team moves faster.

  • Own the security and reliability of what you build, not as an afterthought but as part of shipping it right.

  • Raise the technical bar around you. Review code, share what you know, and help the engineers next to you do their best work, no management required.

  • Work directly with our founders on what to build and why, with real influence over the product and not just the implementation.

The ideal profile

  • You've shipped real products that real people used, owning them end to end, not just closing tickets someone else scoped.

  • Senior enough to move without waiting for permission. You frame the problem, pick the approach, ship it, and can name the tradeoffs you made and why.

  • Probably built your own thing at some point, a startup, a side project with users, a tool people actually rely on. Whether it flew or folded, that instinct to build is exactly what we want.

  • Bias to automation: you script away your own annoyances and build the tools nobody asked for.

  • Comfortable being the person others bring the hard problems to, and generous about sharing what you know.

  • Passion for sports, communities, and building things from the ground up.

  • Startup mindset: resourceful, adaptable, and eager to take ownership.

Some key requirements

  • Minimum of 5+ years building and shipping software, ideally within a fast paced or startup environment.

title: Art Director - CGI
description:
Can you turn bold ideas into visuals that feel almost inevitable and still surprise everyone in the room?

Grip is building the infrastructure for enterprise content production: a visual programming platform that turns brand systems into scalable, production-grade output. As an Art Director, you move beyond campaigns and static guidelines. You translate brand intent into systems that generate thousands of on-brand assets across channels, markets, and formats.

This role sits at the intersection of creative direction and system design. You will define how brands behave in automated environments—codifying visual rules, constraints, and patterns so they can be executed consistently through AI-driven workflows. The shift is from designing assets to designing how assets are produced.

What You Will Do

1. Define Visual Systems for Scale

  • Translate brand guidelines into structured, repeatable design systems that can operate inside Grip’s platform

  • Define rules such as layout behavior, logo usage, typography scaling, and image composition as constraints—not suggestions

  • Build modular frameworks that support thousands of variations without degrading visual quality

2. Direct Production-Grade Creative Output

  • Own the visual quality of automated outputs across campaigns, formats and regions

  • Review and refine outputs generated by AI workflows, ensuring they meet brand and creative standards

  • Collaborate with engineers and FDEs to improve how creative intent is executed in production systems

3. Turn Creative Intent into Logic

  • Work closely with technical teams to translate design decisions into system behavior (e.g., “safe zones” → layout constraints, “brand tone” → visual patterns)

  • Identify repeatable patterns in design workflows and convert them into scalable automation logic

  • Contribute to “Art Direction as Code”—where creative decisions are embedded into pipelines

4. Collaborate Across Enterprise Stakeholders

  • Partner with client creative teams, brand managers, and marketers to align on systemized creative approaches

  • Guide stakeholders from subjective feedback to structured, system-ready decisions

  • Balance creative ambition with production constraints, timelines,and scale requirements

Who You Are:

  • A strong background in CGI art direction, with hands-on understanding of 3D pipelines, virtual production, digital lighting and AI image generation.

  • A strong portfolio spanning campaigns, content, film, or immersive experiences that demonstrates taste, originality and craft.

  • Strong director of photography skills, with a deep understanding of cinematography principles including lighting design, framing, lens language, color science and visual mood, across both physical and digital environments.

  • Proven experience working with global brands or complex stakeholder environments.

  • A deep understanding of aesthetics, performance-driven content and visual communication.

  • The ability to turn abstract strategy into clear, compelling creative ideas that teams can execute.

  • Experience working with clients and brands based in Asia is a plus.

Why Join Grip?

The Platform Position

Grip is building infrastructure for enterprise creative production—where brand systems are executed through software, not manually recreated.

The Market Timing

Enterprise demand for high-volume, on-brand content is accelerating. AI enables generation, but without structured art direction, output breaks. This role defines that structure.

The Technical Moat

Grip combines visual programming, AI workflow orchestration, and multi-tenant architecture (TypeScript, Python, Elixir, C#) to deliver production-grade creative at scale.

The Work

You define how global brands scale visually—turning creative intent into systems that produce consistent, high-quality output across every touchpoint.

The procedure

If you’re ready to bring your project management powers to a role where you can make a difference, we want to hear from you. Send your resume and portfolio in English via the link provided. If you have questions, contact our Recruitment Department at jobs@indg.com.

title: IJmuiden - Instructor Banksman
description:
Do you thrive on inspiring others, sharing knowledge, and making a real impact through hands-on training? Are you someone who takes ownership, embraces variety, and feels at home in an international and fast-moving environment?

For our training center in IJmuiden, we are looking for a driven and passionate Banksman Instructor (OPITO & NOGEPA) (m/f/d) who wants to enable people to work safely and optimally prepare them for lifting and crane operations in offshore and industrial environments.

Who are we?

At FMTC Safety, everything revolves around people and safety. We are a fast-growing, global organization preparing professionals to work safely in some of the world’s most demanding environments: from offshore platforms and wind farms to ships and industrial sites.

What makes us different?
We go where our clients need us. With training centers strategically located around the world, we offer maximum flexibility: in timing, location and delivery. Our mindset is simple: we make it happen. Even if there’s only one participant, the training goes ahead. This requires more than just knowledge, it requires passion, flexibility and a true customer-first mentality. And that’s exactly what defines our instructors.

Your role as a Banksman Instructor

As a Banksman Instructor (OPITO & NOGEPA) in IJmuiden, you are at the heart of our training center. You don’t just deliver courses, you create impactful learning experiences that truly prepare people for real-life lifting and crane operations.

What will you do?

No two days are the same, and that’s exactly what excites you. You take full ownership of your trainings and:

  • Deliver OPITO Banksman & Slinger Initial Training (Stage 1, 3, or equivalent work experience)

  • Teach theoretical and practical aspects of lifting operations, crane signaling, and load assessment

  • Cover legislation, safety, risk assessment, hand signals, and radio communication

  • Guide participants through hands-on exercises, including supervising lifting operations (even out of the crane operator’s line of sight)

  • Ensure all trainings comply with OPITO and FMTC standards

  • Maintain training materials and practice setups

  • Report activities to the location coordinator

What do you bring?

  • Experience in lifting operations, crane supervision, or a similar role in the (offshore) industry

  • OPITO Banksman & Slinger certification (or willingness to obtain it)

  • Affinity for teaching or willingness to be trained as an instructor

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to motivate groups

  • Fluent in English

  • A proactive, safety-focused and professional attitude

  • Passion for training and working with people

  • Customer-oriented mindset and energy for delivering appreciated training

Why FMTC?

Because here, you don’t just join a company—you become part of a journey.

  • Work in a truly international and fast-growing environment

  • Take ownership and make a visible impact from day one

  • Grow with us through training, certifications, and development opportunities

  • Experience an open, informal culture with short communication lines and big ambitions

Not yet fully qualified? No problem! If you have the right attitude and a passion for safety, we’ll provide the training you need to succeed.

title: Application Administrator I & Enrollment Systems Specialist
description:
Current Employees: If you are currently employed at any of the Universities of Wisconsin, log in to Workday to apply through the internal application process.

Position Title:

Application Administrator I & Enrollment Systems Specialist

Job Category:

Academic Staff

Employment Type:

Regular

Job Profile:

Application Administrator I

Job Duties:

The Enrollment Systems Specialist supports the daily operation, maintenance, and improvement of the CRM system, currently Technolutions, Slate Admissions and Enrollment. The Enrollment Systems Specialist supports the administration, maintenance, and improvement of the Slate CRM. This position assists with system projects, completes assigned configuration and testing tasks, provides guidance and training to users, and communicates with campus stakeholders regarding system updates, issues, and process improvements. The specialist may also assist with vendor support requests and coordinate routine follow-up as needed. Additionally, the Enrollment Systems Specialist assists the Director of Admissions in implementing plans and initiatives to recruit the student body, administering the undergraduate admission policy.

Essential Job Functions

Some of the key responsibilities for this position will include:

  • Support the configuration, maintenance, and ongoing review of the institution’s CRM, application systems, forms, workflows, rules, communications, checklists, and integrations. Assist with system upgrades, patches, testing, documentation, implementation, and troubleshooting in coordination with Information Technology and system vendors.

  • Review application and enrollment processes to identify potential issues and recommend appropriate enhancements, workflow changes, or corrective actions.

  • Support data integrations and the movement of information between the CRM, student information system, document management system, application platforms, and other institutional systems.

  • Develop and maintain queries, reports, dashboards, and data exports to support enrollment operations, reporting, and decision-making.

  • Review enrollment data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency, and investigate discrepancies in reports, applications, student records, and system processes.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, training materials, process maps, flowcharts, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Creates and updates access permissions and maintains user accounts to maintain application security through user profile management
  • Coordinates system-wide updates and installs upgrades and patches
  • Monitors and maintains performance metrics for application features and recommends and takes corrective/preventive actions
  • Recommends application enhancements or changes that may involve custom design, optional, and third party products
  • Participates in the design, development, and implementation of test and production objects. Defines user requirements and performs configuration, change management, and testing activities
  • Troubleshoots hardware, software, and system problems

Department:

Admissions

Compensation:

$45,000-$52,000 commensurate with experience and qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.

  • Experience supporting enrollment services, admissions, student records, or another data intensive administrative operation.

  • Experience training or supporting users on technology systems and business processes.

  • Experience using data for reporting, assessment, analysis, or process improvement.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree with experience in Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related fields.

  • Experience using a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. Working knowledge of a student information database system, such as PeopleSoft.

  • Knowledge and experience using Slate. Experience in Admissions/student recruitment.

How to Apply:

For full consideration, please submit your resume and cover letter no later than August 16th, 2026. To be considered for this position, candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without university sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide visa sponsorship for this position, including H-1B, L-1, TN, or F-1 visa extensions (such as OPT or STEM OPT).

Contact Information:

If you have questions about the application process or the position, please reach out to Jackie Haas at 262-595-2495 or haasj@uwp.edu.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
At MANUAL, we’re looking for a talented Creative Strategist to lead the direction of our content strategy and elevate our creative output for social advertising. This role sits at the intersection of brand storytelling and growth marketing, playing a crucial part in driving brand awareness and customer engagement.

As Creative Strategist, you’ll partner with our production team and performance marketing lead to design and refine ad campaigns that embody MANUAL’s brand voice and deliver impactful, measurable results. You should bring a deep understanding of digital marketing, social platforms, and a knack for crafting narratives that captivate and motivate audiences, contributing directly to the growth of MANUAL and its sister brands.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Campaign Strategy Development: Collaborate with performance and production teams to develop and execute strategic content plans for social ads, focused on engaging target demographics and achieving conversion goals.

  • Audience Insight and Research: Leverage data-driven insights to understand audience preferences, needs, and behaviours on social platforms, shaping campaign direction accordingly.

  • Content Creation: Working closely with our in-house production team oversee the production of ad content, including copy, visuals, and video concepts, that aligns with our brand identity and speaks to our audience effectively.

  • Optimisation and Testing: Develop and implement A/B testing frameworks to optimise ad performance, continually refining messaging, visuals, and formats to improve reach, engagement, and conversion.

  • Performance Analysis: Regularly review and analyse performance metrics to gauge ad effectiveness and provide insights and recommendations for future campaigns.

  • Brand Alignment: Ensure all ad content is on-brand and aligns with MANUAL’s core messaging and values, helping to maintain a consistent voice across all Meta adverts.

  • Trend Monitoring: Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and social media innovations, leveraging insights to inform content strategy, execution and overall channel tracking.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with internal teams, including marketing, design, and copy, to ensure content alignment and coherence across all touchpoints.

  • Proven experience as a Content Strategist, ideally with a background in Meta ads or other social platforms.

  • Strong understanding of performance marketing principles and hands-on experience creating ad campaigns on Meta.

  • Excellent copywriting skills with a talent for concise, persuasive messaging.

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign performance data and refine creative thinking accordingly.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams in a fast-paced environment.

  • Familiarity with the health and wellness category is a plus.

SALARY & BENEFITS

  • Salary range of £50k - 60k, depending on experience

  • Generous stock option plan

  • A fun and friendly working environment with sharp and motivated co-workers

  • Hybrid role based in London Bridge with lunch once per week

  • £400 per year learning and development budget with Learnerbly

  • Wellness and gym benefit with Gympass

  • Annual company retreat

  • 25 days holidays and generous parental leave & flexible working policies

  • A growing team with plenty of opportunities for progression, ownership of goals and a direct impact to MANUAL

  • Private healthcare plan

  • Join in the early stages of one of the most promising scale-ups in the health & wellness space


ABOUT MANUAL
MANUAL delivers healthcare at scale thanks to its comprehensive digital clinic. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lives for a large part of the population in the UK, Brazil, and beyond focusing on life-impeding conditions like hormonal imbalance, obesity and hair loss.

MANUAL has steadily grown since inception and is now serving 500k+ patients, across 2 geographies. We are centralising the diagnosis, custom medications, doctor specialist services, behavioural change and fully vertically integrated management of the treatment journey, under one roof and consumer brand.

We’re destigmatising how people approach their health by offering easy access to diagnostics, a holistic range of treatments, ongoing care and medical advice, as well as a community to help proactively improve one’s health and wellbeing. A place that didn't exist until now.


Innovating on healthcare delivery, MANUAL provides patients with engaging treatment plans generating superior clinical outcomes: 90%+ of patients see an improvement in their Quality of Life (QoL) within 6 months. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lifespan for a big part of the population in the UK, Brazil and beyond,

After a $30 million Series A round, we are on a mission to build one of the most impactful teams in the healthcare space. We are looking for incredibly ambitious, entrepreneurial, driven and fun people to join us as we accelerate our growth and expansion. This is an exciting time to join the UK’s fastest-growing healthtech and help supercharge our mission.

Websites:

https://www.menopausecare.co.uk/


EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is essential to our success. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued and respected, regardless of their background, identity or beliefs. We believe that Inclusion, Diversity, Equity and Accessibility (IDEA) is essential to our ability to offer the best possible health outcomes to our patients and customers.

Working remotely is possible. In this role you will be contributing to the expansion of our Benelux office by providing your valuable expertise.


As a Senior Consultant in Material Flow Engineering your tasks will include:


  • Analyze material flow and inventory data to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies.

  • Develop Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to assess warehouse and logistics performance.

  • Lead and execute intralogistics projects from concept to implementation.
