title: Commercial Operations Director
description:
About AnywhereNow

Founded in 2010 in The Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued. With around 240 employees working from 22 different countries, we partner with over 2,000 leading enterprises, including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town, to deliver exceptional customer experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven insights.

Our commitment to innovation, customer focus, and accountability drives our success. Our portfolio includes Dialogue Cloud, Deepdesk (AI Agent Assist), and Tendfor, delivering cutting-edge capabilities across Microsoft Teams environments and enterprise CX platforms.

Position Summary

The Commercial Operations Director owns the commercial engine of the post-sale customer lifecycle, renewals, pricing, deal desk, invoicing, and order-to-cash for AnywhereNow’s SaaS portfolio. You’ll protect and grow contract value, safeguard margin, and convert earned revenue into cash, combining commercial leadership, negotiation strength, and operational rigour.

You’ll lead the renewals and revenue-operations function and personally manage and negotiate the most difficult, complex, and at-risk renewals, working across Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Legal to secure timely, profitable outcomes and a frictionless billing experience for customers. The role is deliberately designed to balance effectiveness, efficiency, and cost across the commercial operation.

Key Responsibilities

Renewals Management & Negotiation

• Own the end-to-end renewals process, forecasting, pipeline, administration, and on-time execution across the customer base

• Personally lead and negotiate difficult, complex, high-value, and at-risk renewals, including multi-year, escalated, and competitively contested deals

• Develop renewal playbooks, negotiation strategies, concession frameworks, and save plays to de-risk and retain at-risk accounts

• Partner with Customer Success and Sales to surface renewal risk early and maximise gross and net revenue retention

Pricing, Deal Desk & Commercial Governance

• Own pricing execution, discount governance, and the deal desk for non-standard and complex commercial terms

• Review and approve quotes, price uplifts, and contract terms to protect unit economics and gross margin

• Maintain price books, packaging, and approval matrices, and ensure compliance with commercial policy

• Provide commercial modelling and deal guidance on high-stakes negotiations

Billing, Invoicing & Order-to-Cash

• Own accurate, on-time sales invoicing and the full order-to-cash cycle

• Drive billing accuracy, revenue-recognition alignment with Finance, and clean contract-to-invoice hand-offs

• Reduce Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and accelerate cash collection in partnership with Finance

• Resolve billing and pricing queries quickly to protect the customer experience

Revenue Processes, Systems & Data

• Establish a single source of truth for renewals, contract, and commercial data

• Deliver renewal, retention, pricing, and cash forecasts and reporting to leadership

• Continuously improve process efficiency, cycle times, and cost-to-serve

Retention & Cross-functional Alignment

• Translate customer sentiment and account-health signals into proactive renewal and pricing action

• Align Sales (hand-offs, expansion), Customer Success (adoption, advocacy), Finance (rev-rec, DSO), and Legal (terms) around commercial outcomes

• Feed pricing, churn, and win/loss insight back into commercial and product strategy

Team Leadership & Operational Excellence

• Lead, coach, and scale the Commercial Operations and renewals team

• Establish and own KPIs (renewal rate, GRR / NRR, DSO, invoice accuracy, and cycle time)

• Instil a disciplined, data-driven operating rhythm balanced for effectiveness, efficiency, and cost

• Escalate only the largest strategic renewals to the COO with a clear recommendation

Core Competencies

Negotiation & Renewals Expertise

• Proven ability to manage and negotiate difficult, complex, and at-risk renewals, consistently delivering profitable outcomes.
• Skilled in objection handling, concession strategy, and multi-stakeholder negotiations in high-pressure environments.
• Strong track record of protecting and expanding contract value throughout the renewal lifecycle.

Commercial & Financial Acumen

• Strong understanding of key SaaS metrics, including ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, DSO, cost-to-serve, and gross margin.
• Expertise in pricing strategy, packaging, discounting, and deal economics.
• Ability to assess commercial decisions and clearly articulate their financial impact.

Revenue Operations & Systems

• Deep understanding of quote-to-cash and order-to-cash processes.
• Proficient in CRM, CPQ, billing, subscription management, and renewals platforms.
• Focused on process optimisation, automation, data integrity, and operational efficiency.

Customer-Centric Retention Mindset

• Balances commercial objectives with customer experience and long-term retention goals.
• Leverages customer health indicators and voice-of-customer insights to drive proactive commercial action.
• Champions a seamless billing and renewal experience as a core business objective.

Data-Driven Decision Making

• Uses forecasting, analytics, and reporting to inform renewal strategies, pricing decisions, and cash-flow optimisation.
• Comfortable with commercial modelling, business cases, and scenario analysis.

Stakeholder Management & Influencing Skills

• Communicates effectively with executive, commercial, finance, legal, and customer-facing

stakeholders.
• Builds alignment across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to achieve shared commercial outcomes.
• Confident and credible presence in customer-facing negotiations and strategic discussions.

Leadership & Execution

• Proven experience leading commercial operations, revenue operations, or renewals teams.
• Demonstrates a strong delivery mindset with accountability for revenue growth and cash performance.
• Equally comfortable operating at both strategic and hands-on execution levels.

Experience & Profile

• 8+ years in commercial operations, revenue operations, renewals, or senior account management within SaaS

• Demonstrable, hands-on track record negotiating difficult, high-value, and complex renewals and commercial terms

• Experience owning renewals, pricing / deal desk, and/or order-to-cash at scale

• Strong systems fluency (CRM, CPQ, billing / subscription platforms) and commercial modelling

• Experience leading and scaling teams in a mid-size (~€40m ARR) SaaS environment

• Commercially astute, numerate, and customer-oriented, with excellent negotiation and stakeholder skills

Success Indicators (First 12–24 Months)

• Renewal rate and gross / net revenue retention improved and predictable

• Difficult and at-risk renewals consistently secured or improved through structured negotiation

• Pricing and discount governance embedded, with margin protected on non-standard deals

• DSO reduced, and invoicing accuracy and timeliness improved

• Quote-to-cash automated, with commercial data trusted as a single source of truth

• A high-performing Commercial Operations function balanced for effectiveness, efficiency, and cost

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:

• Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures, and guidelines at all times

• Protecting company, customer, and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or loss

• Using company systems, devices, and networks in a secure and compliant manner

title: Growth Specialist
description:
As a leading online store in the world of spirituality, Mindful Souls has become the go-to for all things crystals and personal growth. Our mission? To demystify the world of mindfulness, making it accessible and easy-to-understand for everyone.

At the heart of our offerings is the viral Mindful Subscription Box - adored by more than 43,000 customers worldwide! Our boxes are all about intention and care, featuring only 100% natural crystals and ethically sourced items. That’s why we're the first pick for gemstone and mindfulness lovers who value authenticity and expert curation.


With a fully remote environment, our team is made up of 55 professionals spread across the world. On top of our shared passion for e-commerce projects that truly matter, we prioritize flexibility, autonomy, and creativity. We're lifelong learners, problem-solvers, and, above all, great team players.


And here's the exciting part: our team is growing! We are currently looking for a Growth Specialist.

Role overview:

Our main revenue stream comes from the recurring payments. You'll be responsible for helping execute the subscription strategy to acquire new customers and retain the current subscribers. You'll ensure we have well-converting funnels through regular iterations and experiments to increase our sales and limit churn rate. Your efforts will help us achieve business targets across all markets: the US, Canada, the EU + UK, and Australia.


In this role, your responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and implement strategies to drive subscriber acquisition, engagement, retention, and overall revenue growth.

  • Develop and execute a conversion optimisation roadmap aligned with business goals.

  • Establish strategies to reduce churn and enhance customer lifetime value.

  • Test and establish new offers and bundling options to maximise revenue and customer value.

  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to optimise the conversion funnel, from lead generation to customer retention.

  • Conduct A/B testing to refine messaging, CTAs, landing pages, and other touchpoints.

  • Implement upselling and cross-selling strategies for existing customers to increase average order value and repeat purchases.

  • Coordinate with data analysts to ensure consistent tracking and reporting of key metrics.

Must-haves:

  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in the e-Commerce space.

  • Strong understanding of subscription sales in the D2C company.

  • Experience in spotting bottlenecks and improving the conversion in marketing funnels.

  • Track record in implementing strategies elevating growth, especially in metrics like MRR, ROI, CLTV and AOV.

  • Proven analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

  • Experience in CRO, growth marketing, or performance optimisation, ideally in the subscription or e-Commerce brand.

  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment.

  • Effective communication skills with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and influence cross-functional teams.


What we will appreciate:

  • Documented examples of successful projects (portfolio).

  • Passion for enhancing customer experiences and driving business growth.

🌍 Work from Anywhere & Anytime: With a fully remote environment and flexible schedule, you can work while you travel and follow your passions.

⚖️ Find Balance: We care about your well-being and ensure an excellent work-life balance. It's about working smart, not hard.

🏹 Freedom to Grow: Say goodbye to micromanagement and hello to the autonomy you need to reach your full potential and advance your career.

💪 Teamwork Matters: Our flat team structure means we communicate easily, decisions happen quickly, and your ideas are heard.

🥳 We Celebrate Success: We're your biggest fans and want to see you succeed. That's why we provide the resources and support you need to keep learning and growing.

🎁 Great Benefits: Enjoy perks like an education budget annually, a sports card, a home office bonus, and access to the Mindletic app for self-care.


Ready to boost our growth and work alongside an international team of e-Comm passionates? Then this opportunity is for you!


Start your mindful career with us!

title: Principal Backend Developer
description:
Waracle are looking for a Principal Backend Developer to join our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious, and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation. We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design, and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office or on client site.

Shape the Future of Digital Innovation

As a Principal Backend Developer, you will act as a strategic technical leader, guiding and shaping robust architectures, data strategies, and cloud-native environments across multiple squads and collaborative programmes. In this role, you will champion technical excellence, making thoughtful choices that balance cost, security, performance, and user experience to help Waracle scale and deliver high-performance, world-class products.

If you are a collaborative leader who thrives on mentoring talent, fostering inclusive engineering communities, and navigating complex technical landscapes with empathy and pragmatism, we would love to welcome you to our team!

Duties of This Role

Reporting to the Head of Engineering, your role will cover:

  • Solving Complex Technical Challenges: Partner closely with client technical and business stakeholders at all levels, gaining a deep understanding of their technology estates to advise on impactful, world-class digital solutions.

  • Technical Excellence & Delivery: Shape architectures across multiple squads; select tools and frameworks to scale across clients while optimising for cost, security, performance, and scalability.

  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Act as a trusted advisor to clients on technical strategy and roadmaps, translating complex technical concepts into clear, accessible communication for senior stakeholders.

  • Leadership & Community Cultivation: Mentor Lead and Senior Engineers, foster and grow our engineering community of practice, and ensure cross-team alignment on technical standards.

  • Culture & Knowledge Sharing: Define and evolve Waracle’s technical standards while contributing to our shared body of knowledge through lessons learned, thought leadership, and good practices.

What You'll Bring
Research shows that women and underrepresented groups often apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Waracle, we hire for potential, passion, and a collaborative mindset just as much as current experience. If you share our values and believe you can excel in this role, we strongly encourage you to apply—even if you don't tick every single box.

  • Architectural Leadership: Proven experience designing, documenting, and scaling complex back-end architectures, distributed systems, microservices, and database designs (SQL and other technologies) within cloud-native environments—particularly Azure (with a focus on API management, maintenance, and scaling).

  • Technical Direction & Delivery Ownership: Strong leadership capability to set clear technical direction, maintain a dedicated ownership mindset, and foster high-standard outcomes across complex enterprise projects.

  • Consultative Communication: Excellent communication and influencing skills, with a demonstrated ability to navigate complex client organisations, support diverse stakeholders, and pragmatically balance commercial constraints with high technical standards.

  • Team Mentorship & Growth: A proven track record of mentoring, developing, and aligning senior engineers and technical leaders to foster a collaborative culture of continuous learning and psychological safety.

  • Modern SDLC Innovation: A pragmatic, forward-thinking approach with a strong interest and enthusiasm for applying AI across the Software Development Life Cycle to enhance engineering practices and advise clients on effective adoption.

The Recruitment Process

You can expect an initial call with your dedicated Talent Acquisition Partner, who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period, and benefits. After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you will have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will guide and support you through the whole process right up to your first day with us

title: Workspace Engineer
description:
Wil jij als Workspace Engineer werken aan moderne digitale werkplekken binnen complexe klantomgevingen? En zoek je een rol waarin beheer, optimalisatie, implementatie en verbetertrajecten samenkomen? Dan past deze functie binnen ITQ Managed Services goed bij jou.

Binnen ITQ werk je aan Workspace-omgevingen die dagelijks gebruikt worden door professionals die moeten kunnen vertrouwen op veilige, stabiele en goed ingerichte IT. Vooral binnen de zorg is dat essentieel. Artsen, verpleegkundigen, onderzoekers en ondersteunende teams moeten snel en veilig toegang hebben tot hun applicaties, data en werkplek. Jij zorgt ervoor dat die digitale werkplek werkt.

Jouw rol als Workspace Engineer

Als Workspace Engineer binnen ITQ Managed Services zorg jij dat moderne werkplekomgevingen niet alleen blijven draaien, maar elke dag slimmer, veiliger en beter worden. Samen met zo’n 20 specialisten werk je aan brede klantomgevingen waarin troubleshooting, optimalisatie en implementatie samenkomen.

Waar kan een werkplekomgeving slimmer worden ingericht? Hoe verbeteren we performance, security of gebruikerservaring? Welke endpoint management-oplossing past het beste? En hoe zorgen we ervoor dat veranderingen zorgvuldig worden doorgevoerd in omgevingen waar continuïteit belangrijk is? Dat is precies waar jij waarde toevoegt.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Workspace Engineer houd jij je onder andere bezig met:

  • Beheren en optimaliseren van digitale werkplekomgevingen binnen Managed Services.

  • Werken met technologieën zoals Omnissa Horizon, Workspace ONE, Microsoft Intune, Citrix Workspace, Microsoft 365 en Windows 11.

  • Implementeren en verbeteren van VDI-, endpoint management- en application delivery-oplossingen.

  • Meewerken aan implementatieprojecten en verbetertrajecten bij klanten.

  • Analyseren van klantomgevingen en vertalen van technische bevindingen naar concrete acties.

De omgeving waarin je werkt

Veel klanten bevinden zich binnen de zorg. Dat betekent dat jouw werk direct impact heeft op mensen die afhankelijk zijn van een betrouwbare digitale werkplek. Een applicatie die niet goed start, een trage virtuele werkplek of een device dat niet juist beheerd wordt, is daar meer dan een technisch probleem.

Het raakt direct de dagelijkse operatie. Daarom zoeken we iemand die techniek combineert met verantwoordelijkheid. Iemand die snapt dat stabiliteit, veiligheid en gebruiksgemak bij elkaar horen.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Ervaring met het beheren en verbeteren van digitale werkplekomgevingen.

  • Kennis van één of meerdere oplossingen zoals Omnissa Horizon, Omnissa Workspace ONE, Citrix Workspace, Microsoft 365, Windows 11 of SCCM.

  • Ervaring met VDI, endpoint management, application delivery of workspace management.

  • Een proactieve houding: je signaleert wat beter kan en pakt eigenaarschap.

Certificeringen zijn mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Ervaring, eigenaarschap en technische nieuwsgierigheid vinden we belangrijker.

Waarom ITQ?

Bij ITQ kom je terecht in een organisatie van specialisten. Mensen met passie voor technologie, kwaliteit en vooruitgang. Je werkt samen met collega’s die inhoudelijk sterk zijn, maar ook benaderbaar blijven. Kennis delen, elkaar helpen en samen beter worden zit diep in de manier van werken.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast een inhoudelijk sterke rol binnen een specialistisch team bieden we:

  • Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse collectieve ITQ-bonus.

  • De keuze uit een mobiliteitsbudget of leaseauto.

  • Een uitgebreid onboardingprogramma.

  • Interne kennissessies en toegang tot veel technische expertise.

  • Hybride werken en een thuiswerkbudget.

  • De mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen.

  • Een volledig betaalde lunch op kantoor.

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
Maybe you call yourself an AI Engineer, GenAI Lead, LLM wrangler, Senior "but it worked in the demo" Debunker, Chief Hallucination Reducer… or maybe you just call yourself Dario.

Whatever, you call yourself: you'll lead how All Your BI builds and ships AI. Not demos. Production systems that survive contact with real clients and keep running. The title? Yours to define. At AYBI, scope is shaped by impact, not org chart position.

What you get

  • A salary between €7,400–€9,200/gross monthly, based on the role, your experience, and your local market.

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then.

  • Fully remote, from anywhere in Europe, ideally within a couple of hours of CET, so the team overlaps.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

What the job looks like

  • Set the technical direction for AYBI's AI and GenAI work, the architecture, the build-vs-buy calls, and the honest judgment of when AI is the wrong tool.

  • Build and ship AI into our products and client solutions, LLM applications, RAG over messy real-world data, agents and tool-calling, and make them production-grade, not demo-grade.

  • Own reliability: evals as the unit tests of our AI (eval suites in CI, golden datasets), observability and tracing on every call, and guardrails against hallucination and prompt injection.

  • Keep AI affordable: track cost and latency per task, and use caching, routing, and the right model for the job rather than the biggest one.

  • Lead the productization push the team is starting, turn one-off work into repeatable, observable, dependable products, with the testing and monitoring to match.

  • Lift the engineers around you, through craft, clear direction, and the occasional workshop, and help the whole team adopt AI well. You lead through your roles and accountabilities, not a reporting line; we self-organise.

  • Translate AI capability into real client value and push back on anything that's AI for AI's sake.

  • Stay close to the frontier: read what's new, test what's promising, bring back what's worth it.

What you bring

  • Attitude: energy, curiosity. You bring positive energy to every call, and you'd rather ship something useful than polish something perfect.

  • Experience: ~3–5 years in software engineering, building and shipping AI/ML or GenAI systems in production.

  • AI/ML engineering, in production: you've built and shipped LLM/GenAI systems that real people use, RAG, agents, tool-calling, not notebooks and demos. Strong Python, and you know the modern AI stack (LLM APIs across providers like Anthropic / OpenAI / open models, vector databases, an orchestration framework) well enough to know where it breaks.

  • Reliability & LLMOps: you make AI dependable, evals, observability and tracing, guardrails, prompt and version control, cost and latency budgets.

  • Technical leadership: you set technical direction others buy into, make the architecture calls, and leave the engineers around you better than you found them, through influence and clarity, not authority.

  • Client & business sense: you can tell AI that creates client value from AI that's just hype and explain which is which to a non-technical client.

  • Self-management: you thrive without a manager. Distributed authority, owning your roles, raising and resolving tensions, reshaping your work as it changes, that reads as freedom to you, not chaos.

  • Communication: strong in English.

  • Nice to have: data or BI background or consultancy experience; cloud + deployment muscle (AWS / Azure / GCP, Docker, CI/CD); model distillation, structured outputs, and multimodal pipelines.

We're 60+ data heroes across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

title: Houma, Louisiana - Safety Training Instructor
description:
Safety Training Instructor

Escaping from a helicopter, surviving at sea or fighting a raging fire. We start every day full of positive energy, eager to teach everyone who participates in our training courses all there is to know about the potential dangers in the offshore industry. Does this sound perfect for you? Then we are looking for you to join our team in Gray, Louisiana!

About us

FMTC Safety is the safety training center for Offshore training (OPITO & NOGEPA), Wind training (GWO), Maritime training (STCW), and Industry training. Every day people are prepared to work and live safely on a drilling platform or a ship.

At FMTC, flexibility is our top priority! We reduce the burden of the customer entirely in the field of training. We do this through our customer-focused services, flexibility, knowledge, and extra services in addition to our training courses.
In addition to our Dordrecht location, we also have various locations worldwide; Schiphol Amsterdam(NL), Lage Zwaluwe(NL), IJmuiden(NL), Houma (USA), Dunkirk (FR) and Ras Tanura (KSA).

What does your day as an Offshore Training Course Instructor at FMTC look like?

Every day is a new challenge. You arrive at one of our unique locations and happily, you start your day. What course is planned for today? A Sea Survival? A HUET, where the participants need to escape from a helicopter simulator while it’s in the water? Or maybe something totally different. In any case, you teach all the courses in a good-natured and creative manner.

After teaching the theory, you support the participants of the course in putting the theory into practice. All courses are simulated in a realistic setting.

Who are we looking for?

  • You have offshore / maritime experience

  • You are proficient in the English language

  • You are creative, stress-resistant and bring your good mood with you to work

  • You are client-oriented; it gives you energy to know that the participants love your training course

What can you expect from us?

An awesome, varied job, where every day presents you with a new challenge. Never taught training courses before, but you have been active in the Offshore sector? Then your new colleagues would be happy to teach you all about this line of work.

This function can be perfectly combined with that of an Offshore employee or part-time employee. You will receive a salary in line with the job scale as well as attractive secondary benefits.

title: Project Manager (Automotive)
description:
We’re looking for a Project Manager with a genuine passion for the automotive world. Cars, motorbikes, powersports, everything on wheels gets you excited. In this role you will join our automotive and PTW vertical, managing complex projects end to end for some of the most respected brands in the industry.

You will be working on a truly global stage, helping to create some of the highest quality product assets in the market. You are eager to work with industry leaders, confident managing demanding stakeholders and motivated by the idea that the work you lead sets the visual benchmark for the automotive industry.

About us

At INDG, we develop technology that powers engaging, hyper realistic digital product experiences. Our mission is to make every product playable by combining the science of technology with the artistry of computer generated content. From our offices in Amsterdam, Bucharest and New York, we team up with global market leading brands.

We create high fidelity digital twins of our clients’ products and support these brands at scale, taking care of their full product portfolios year in, year out. Our teams work as long term partners, delivering consistent, high quality content pipelines that keep thousands of products up to date across markets and channels.

As a Project Manager, you own the planning and delivery of CG projects for our global automotive and powersports clients. You work closely with producers, CG supervisors, 3D artists, compositors and pipeline teams to keep shots and assets moving smoothly through the studio. This is a hands on, detail focused role at the heart of production. You make sure projects are structured, risks are managed and decisions are clear so the team can focus on the creative work.

You are the main point of contact for your clients. You build long term relationships, understand their business and translate their needs into clear roadmaps and deliverables. You will visit our clients in EMEA and the US on a regular basis to ensure effective project management from kick off to delivery. You are confident in steering conversations, managing expectations and us on a global podium.

You also play a key role inside the team, coaching junior project managers, sharing best practices and helping to improve how we plan and deliver projects across the automotive vertical.

What will you do?

Project coordination

  • Own the scoping of CG work based on client briefs and breakdowns

  • Build and maintain schedules, deliverable overviews and task plans for multiple parallel projects

  • Keep project trackers and databases up to date so status, priorities and dependencies are always clear

Production support

  • Lead day to day coordination with CG artists, compositors and other disciplines

  • Oversee feedback loops, versions and approvals for all deliveries

  • Define and maintain asset lists and delivery checklists, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks

Client and stakeholder communication

  • Act as primary point of contact for key automotive and powersports clients

  • Join and lead dailies, internal reviews and client calls, capturing decisions and follow ups

  • Share clear, structured status updates with clients, producers, supervisors and other stakeholders

  • Flag risks early, propose scenarios and trade-offs, and drive alignment on next steps

Budget and admin

  • Own tracking of hours and costs against estimates and bids

  • Support producers in building and refining estimates and scopes of work

  • Manage POs, timesheets and other project administration

  • Keep key project documents organised, accessible and up to date

Team and process

  • Coach and support junior project managers and coordinators on your projects

  • Contribute to improving tooling, workflows and reporting within the automotive vertical

  • Help embed best practices for planning, communication and risk management across the team

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience in project management, production or account management in CG, VFX, animation, post production or a similar digital production environment.

  • Proven experience managing complex, multi stakeholder projects end to end.

  • Strong client management skills with proven leadership and mentorship capabilities.

  • Able to work with multiple deadlines and stay calm in busy periods.

  • Confident in client facing situations, from day to day coordination to challenging conversations.

  • Strong affinity with the automotive and/or powersports industry.

  • Experience working in an international team or with distributed teams and clients.

  • Excellent communication skills and fluent in spoken and written English.

What we offer

This is a remote friendly role, so you can do your best work from where you are most productive. Most of us are based in Amsterdam, and if you are close to our office, we would love to welcome you in person from time to time.

The Procedure

title: Strategic Customer Advisor

At ITQ, we work with people who are deeply passionate about technology, and that passion drives both our success and our culture. We help organizations unlock the full potential of their IT infrastructure, from cloud and modern workplace solutions to virtualization, security, and digital transformation.

Being part of ITQ means more than working on cutting-edge technology: It means joining the ITQ-force, a collective of specialists who share knowledge, collaborate closely, and continuously learn. Here, your technical skills matter, your ideas are valued, and your passion is the fuel for growth, both for yourself and for our clients.

About the Role:

We’re currently looking for a Strategic Customer Advisor (m/f/d) who can translate customer requirements into solutions that are technically and commercially viable. You connect Sales and Delivery and make sure quality, feasibility, effort and risk are transparent and aligned before a contract is signed.

This role deliberately goes beyond traditional pre-sales. You advise CIOs, CTOs and IT decision-makers at strategic customers, develop IT and investment roadmaps and work with Delivery to create standardized, repeatable services.

In this Role you will:

· Translate customer needs into feasible, high-quality technical solutions and act as the bridge between Sales and Delivery.

· Lead technical discovery sessions, analyze customer environments, design solution architectures, and prepare estimates, proposals, and Statements of Work.

· Ensure solution quality, risk transparency, and alignment between customer expectations and delivery capabilities.

· Advise CIOs, CTOs, and other IT decision-makers as a trusted strategic partner, helping shape IT strategies and investment roadmaps.

· Support Sales with technical expertise, demos, PoCs, RFPs, and value propositions to strengthen customer engagements.

· Develop and standardize scalable service offerings, including solution blueprints, pricing models, and reusable architectures.

· Contribute to market positioning through technical thought leadership, such as events, webinars, and customer advisory sessions.

Who you are

· You have a technical degree, comparable qualification, or equivalent practical experience.

· You bring at least five years of experience in pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical consulting within enterprise, cloud, or infrastructure environments.

· You have experience advising CIOs, CTOs, and other senior stakeholders and are comfortable operating at executive level.

· You have strong knowledge of virtualization, cloud, and datacenter technologies, with experience in solution design, sizing, and effort estimation.

· You understand commercial aspects such as pricing models and business cases; experience with standardized or productized services is a plus.

· Experience within a partner or systems integrator environment, as well as knowledge of Broadcom/VMware technologies (e.g. VMware Cloud Foundation), is advantageous.

· You are structured, solution-oriented, entrepreneurial, and take ownership of delivering high-quality results.

· You are fluent in German and confident in English, and you are willing to travel across the DACH region.

Working at ITQ offers some awesome perks

description:

What you need to shoot for the stars:

  • Comfortable working with access control, network or building technology — you don't need to configure it, but you need to speak the language

  • Structured and reliable under pressure — you surface risks early and escalate with a clear ask, not just a problem

  • Fluent in German and English — you'll be working across DACH markets daily

title: Senior Product Designer (Fixed-Term Contract)
description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Product Designer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.


We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.


This is a 6-month fixed-term contract with a hybrid working arrangement, giving you the flexibility to balance your professional and personal commitments. You'll work 2 days per week from either our Glasgow or Dundee office, with the remaining days working remotely.

The Role

Are you a passionate design leader who loves turning complex challenges into seamless, human-centered digital experiences?

In this key role, you'll shape the future of our design systems, champion inclusive accessibility, and uplift fellow designers through thoughtful mentorship. If you thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your voice matters and your growth is championed, we’d love to welcome you to our team!

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Journey & Pattern Leadership: Leading interaction design for complex initiatives, identifying and shaping core interaction patterns across our design system.

  • Visual Evolution & Brand Direction: Evolving visual design languages to match the brand and align technical architecture, setting the creative direction.

  • Design System Governance: Comfortable in the technical nuances, as well as defining clear, intuitive guidelines and principles to ensure consistency across digital products.

  • Inclusive Design & Accessibility: Championing accessibility and embedding inclusive design practices into every stage of the product lifecycle.

  • Strategic Experimentation: Driving A/B testing and experimentation strategies that connect design to real user needs and business goals.

  • Mentorship & Support: Guiding, encouraging, and elevating junior team members to help them reach their full potential.

  • Collaborative Prototyping: Connecting user-centered concepts with technical feasibility to bring transformative digital ideas to life.

What you'll bring to the role

  • Proven expertise in leading complex interaction design, identifying and defining system-wide patterns.

  • Strong commitment to inclusive design and experience leading accessibility audits.

  • Hands-on experience with experimentation, A/B testing, and tracking outcomes that make a difference.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and active listening skills that foster open collaboration.

  • A passion for uplifting others through empathetic mentorship and constructive guidance.

The Recruitment Process

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!).

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Attraction Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

title: IAM Developer - Healthcare - REMOTE
description:
About the Role

Join a world-class academic healthcare organization as a Senior Identity & Access Management (IAM) Developer within the Information Security department. This is a fully remote opportunity and may be based outside of the greater Chicagoland area.

In this role, the Senior IAM Developer will take an active role in developing departmental policies and procedures as they relate to program usage. This position involves developing user manuals, participating in user demonstrations and focus groups, and maintaining up-to-date technical knowledge through various information sources.

Under the direction of IAM leadership, the Senior IAM Developer provides technical expertise, develops standards, guidelines, and processes for application systems, and translates business requirements into well-designed applicationsbalancing user needs, business objectives, and technical constraints.

This role also involves reviewing system designs and code development for key architectural components, contributing to infrastructure and technology decisions, and participating in regional and national IAM communities to share and expand knowledge.

The Senior IAM Developer will also formulate and define specifications for complex IAM installations, maintenance, and upgrades, while identifying and analyzing performance and capacity issues. The position leads installation and maintenance of major operating system components, multiple program products, and ancillary system components; serves as a technical authority on multiple operating system elements; and collaborates with users, analysts, and technical staff to resolve system issues.




  • Essential Job Functions

    • Architect, design, and develop IAM technical solutions that meet business needs.

    • Evaluate capacity and performance issues.

    • Document technical solutions including specifications, models, diagrams, and other documentation as requested or required.

    • Support production applications and environments 24/7.

    • Effectively collaborate with IAM team members to ensure quality and delivery of solutions.

    • Review and provide feedback on business requirements and proposed technical solutions.

    • Participate in regional and national IAM communities to expand and share knowledge while improving practices.

    • Brainstorm with team members to identify alternative solutions.

    • Serve as a technical expert for the IAM team.

    • Perform additional duties as assigned.


    Required Qualifications

    • BS or BA degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent education, training, or work experience (Master's degree preferred).

    • 5 years of experience as an IAM developer or engineer.

    • 3 years of hands-on SailPoint experience.

    • 3 years of hands-on CyberArk experience.

    • 5 or more years of programming experience developing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining applications with any of the following languages:

      • Java, Java EE

      • JavaScript, HTML, and CSS

      • SQL and Transact-SQL

      • Perl, PHP, Python, or Ruby

      • XML and JSON

    • Expert knowledge and multiple years of experience across:

      • Programming within UNIX/Linux using Unix Shell (bash)

      • Database systems such as MySQL, SQL Server, NoSQL, and Oracle

      • Programming LDAP using APIs such as OpenLDAP, JNDI, or Netscape

      • Web-service technologies such as SOAP or REST

      • Single Sign-On technologies (Shibboleth, OpenID Connect)

      • Open-source software and collaboration on open-source projects

      • Network authentication tools such as RADIUS or TACACS

      • Microsoft Active Directory

      • Version control software

    • 2 or more years working with IAM systems and technologies such as Azure, Okta, OneLogin, Oracle Identity Manager, or similar.

    • Prior experience mentoring junior team members.

    • Experience with HIPAA, NIST, FERPA, and SOX standards preferred.

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.

Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

We're looking for an Agent Factory Product Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments.

  • LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Information Security Responsibilities

At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information.

This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

description:

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)


What is UN Watch?

UN Watch is a non-governmental organization (NGO) in Geneva, Switzerland whose mission is to monitor the performance of the United Nations according to the yardstick of its Charter and to protect human rights for all. UN Watch believes in strengthening the role of democracies within the UN and in the Charter’s guarantee of equal treatment for all nations large and small. UN Watch is at the forefront in the struggle against anti-Semitism and anti-Israel bias at the UN. For more information, please visit .

Does UN Watch offer paid internships?

No, unfortunately, UN Watch cannot offer a salary to interns due to visa complications. The only internships we offer are on a volunteer basis. Interns must find their own funding for travel, health insurance, daily living, lodging and all other costs. Geneva is an expensive city.


Are scholarships available for UN Watch interns?
Yes, a limited number of scholarships are available to top internship applicants. More information will be provided to eligible applicants during the interview process.

When are UN Watch internships available, and for how long do they last?

UN Watch offers three main internship opportunities throughout the year, each of which encompasses one Human Rights Council Session:

1. Spring (February, March, April), Application Deadline: November 30th

2. Summer (May, June, July), Application Deadline: December 31st

3. Fall (September, October, November), Application Deadline: April 30th

Interviews of qualified candidates are typically conducted in the month following the application deadline.

Interns are expected to commit to a minimum of two months and up to three months.


Is it possible to intern remotely?

Yes, but only if you are within one timezone of UN Watch's office in Geneva (CET). This means that we unfortunately cannot take remote interns from the US or Canada. UN Watch accepts remote interns dependent either on the preference of the applicant or the availability of spaces in the Geneva office. Remote interns perform nearly all of the same tasks as those physically in Geneva given that many of the UN's activities can be followed online.


What are an intern’s activities and responsibilities?

The activities and responsibilities of an intern typically include a broad range of substantive and administrative research functions, and may depend on the skill set and background of the applicant. Substantive responsibilities can include research and writing of reports, drafting correspondence, monitoring and reporting on meetings at the UN, attending and reporting on meetings with diplomats and UN officials, fact-checking and taking notes. Interns also participate in all administrative responsibilities, which regularly include website maintenance, answering telephones, making photocopies and filing, events support and other office tasks.

Does UN Watch have offices outside Geneva?

The only office in which internships are offered is in Geneva, opposite the European headquarters of the United Nations.

To qualify, applicants must have:

  • at least one year of university studies;
  • a strong interest in international relations or human rights;
  • excellent English writing ability, preferably demonstrated by publications;
  • a demonstrable commitment to the UN Watch mission;
  • interest in combating antisemitism and anti-Israel bias;
  • ability to work in a small, team-oriented environment operating under strict deadlines, flexibility, patience, initiative, and intellectual curiosity.

title: Senior Hardware Technician
description:
Role Summary

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Hardware Engineering is seeking a Senior Hardware Technician to support hands-on lab execution, including PCB rework, server configuration and bring-up, system and component testing, and maintaining day-to-day lab readiness. This is a full-time, on-site position in an engineering lab environment supporting hardware sustaining, alternate component qualification, and hardware validation activities.

At the Senior level, the expectation is that you can independently execute complex lab activities, operate with minimal supervision, support multiple concurrent priorities, and proactively communicate status and issues while maintaining high standards for quality, repeatability, and lab readiness. You will contribute to improving lab operations, validation processes, and engineering throughput across multiple hardware programs.

Key Responsibilities

PCB Rework / Hardware Rework

  • Perform component-level rework on PCBs (e.g., remove/replace components) using standard lab equipment (soldering iron, hot air rework as applicable, microscope, and related tools).
  • Perform hardware modifications, board rework, and component replacement to support hardware sustaining and alternate component qualification activities.
  • Follow ESD, safety, and handling procedures; maintain rework tools and work area in ready condition.
  • Record rework actions performed and communicate results to the requesting engineer or technician.

System Configuration / Server Build & Bring-Up

  • Assemble, configure, tear down, and rebuild servers to documented requirements by installing CPUs, DIMMs, PCIe cards, NICs, storage devices, motherboards, power supplies, and associated cabling.
  • Update firmware (e.g., BIOS/BMC) using established procedures and verify versions and settings as directed.
  • Install operating systems and required baseline tools; perform initial validation (successful boot, device enumeration checks, and basic health checks).
  • Connect systems to the lab network and confirm basic connectivity and expected configuration.
  • Configure and maintain supporting lab infrastructure, including racks, PDUs, network switches, console servers, and associated cabling, to support validation activities.
  • Continuously reconfigure systems to support hardware qualification, sustaining activities, and engineering validation.

System and Component Testing

  • Execute documented test procedures and functional tests on systems under test (SUTs) reliably and repeatably.
  • Perform functional testing and basic hardware fault isolation using established diagnostic methods and standard laboratory equipment.
  • Capture logs and test results; summarize outcomes and escalate failures or anomalous behavior with sufficient detail for engineering investigation.
  • Maintain accuracy in following documented procedures, sequencing, traceability, and data collection requirements.

Lab Operations

  • Maintain an organized, clean, and safe lab environment that supports efficient engineering work.
  • Track and restock common supplies and consumables (cables, adapters, ESD items, fasteners, labels, etc.).
  • Coordinate routine equipment upkeep and support calibration activities to ensure laboratory equipment remains available and compliant.
  • Assist with inventory management, procurement support, shipping and receiving activities, asset tracking, storage organization, and general hardware logistics within the lab.
  • Support environmental chamber readiness and maintain overall lab infrastructure required for hardware validation activities.

Collaboration & Process Improvement

  • Work closely with hardware, firmware, validation, manufacturing, and sustaining engineers to prioritize daily tasks, manage work queues, and provide clear status updates.
  • Follow documented processes while contributing improvements that increase lab throughput, quality, repeatability, and operational efficiency.
  • Document work clearly and communicate findings to support engineering investigations and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Support standardization of lab methods, build processes, and validation practices to improve consistency across the team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience supporting electronics laboratories, hardware validation environments, or data center hardware.
  • Practical experience with soldering and PCB rework (through-hole and/or SMT) and comfort using common rework tools.
  • Experience assembling, configuring, troubleshooting, and validating server or high-performance computer hardware, including installing components and performing system bring-up.
  • Ability to follow established procedures for firmware updates, operating system installation, and hardware validation.
  • Experience performing functional testing, basic hardware fault isolation, and documenting test results in a clear, repeatable manner.
  • Experience configuring and supporting laboratory infrastructure, including racks, cabling, network connectivity, PDUs, or related validation equipment.
  • Demonstrated organizational skills and ability to maintain lab readiness, including inventory, equipment availability, procurement support, and calibration coordination.
  • Ability to work full-time on-site in a hardware engineering laboratory environment while following ESD and safety practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate degree, advanced trade training, military electronics training, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.
  • Experience with PCB-level debug and failure isolation to the component level.
  • Basic Linux command-line familiarity (e.g., checking device enumeration, collecting logs, and supporting hardware validation activities).
  • Experience using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, logic analyzers, power supplies, spectrum analyzers, or related laboratory equipment.
  • Experience using inventory management, asset tracking, or ticketing systems.
  • Experience supporting hardware validation, sustaining engineering, alternate component qualification, or environmental chamber testing.

Senior Level Characteristics

  • Independently executes complex lab activities with minimal supervision.
  • Applies established practices and procedures while contributing improvements to lab processes and operational efficiency.
  • Produces consistent, high-quality work across multiple concurrent hardware activities while maintaining traceability and repeatability.
  • Performs functional testing and hardware fault isolation using systematic troubleshooting methods.
  • Communicates clearly with engineers and technicians and documents work to support repeatable engineering execution.
  • Contributes to improving lab throughput, readiness, and overall engineering support.

title: Assemblagemonteur Jachtonderdelen
description:
Welkom bij Wajer Yachts – waar luxe en vakmanschap samenkomen

Bij Wajer Yachts bouwen we niet zomaar jachten; we creëren luxe ervaringen over de hele wereld. Van Heeg tot Miami, overal trekken ze bewonderende blikken. Dat is geen toeval – bij Wajer ligt de focus op innovatie, kwaliteit en ultiem comfort. En dat alles begint hier, in Friesland, met een team van gepassioneerde vakspecialisten zoals jij.

Techniek is jouw domein. Van dek tot tenderbakken: alles werkt en past dankzij jouw precisie. Voor onze werf in Heeg zoeken we een assemblagemonteur die zorgt dat alle losse jachtonderdelen in perfecte staat gemonteerd worden. Klinkt dat als jouw uitdaging? Lees snel verder!


Dit wordt jouw werk

In Heeg bouwen we aan de Wajer 38, 44 en 55 – luxe jachten die stap voor stap, vanaf de romp, worden opgebouwd. Als assemblagemonteur werk je in verschillende teams (voormontage, dekken, afmontage) die samen ervoor zorgen dat de jachtonderdelen (zoals achterkleppen, tenderbakken en hardtops) klaar worden gemaakt en geplaatst worden op de Wajer.

Daarbij voer je o.a. de volgende werkzaamheden uit:

🛠️ Je bewerkt composiet en voert diverse kitwerkzaamheden uit, zowel voor afdichting als esthetische afwerking

🛠️ Je monteert lichte en eenvoudige elektrische componenten
🛠️ ️Je meet bedrading, bekabeling en/of leidingwerk in en monteert deze

🛠️ Je houdt wijzigingen in werktekeningen en technische schema’s bij en verwerkt deze

Wil je graag met eigen ogen zien hoe een dag als elektromonteur bij Wajer eruit ziet? Martijn laat het je zien!

Dit krijg je van ons

Bij ons draait alles om kwaliteit, innovatie en passie. Dat geldt voor onze jachten én voor ons team. We dagen je dan ook uit om het beste uit jezelf te halen en beloven dat je daar elke dag plezier en gezelligheid voor terugkrijgt.

Wat je verder van ons kunt verwachten:
⭐ Een passend salaris tussen de €2.800 en €3.500 per maand

⭐ Vakantiegeld, 27 vakantiedagen en 6,5 ADV-dagen

⭐ Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per km

⭐ Een 39-urige werkweek, waarbij je op vrijdag om 15.15 uur het weekend in kunt stappen

⭐ Een jaarcontract met één maand proeftijd, die we na afloop graag verlengen

⭐ Een stabiele en eerlijke cao (Metalektro) en bijbehorend pensioenfonds (PME).

⭐ We betalen jouw vaarbewijzen (KVB 1 & 2) zodat je ook op het water uit de voeten kunt

⭐ Onbeperkt toegang tot de Wajer Academy zodat er genoeg ruimte is voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Dit ben jij

Interieur is jouw passie. Je werkt nauwkeurig, levert topkwaliteit en hebt oog voor de kleinste details. Je denkt altijd een stap verder en zoekt naar manieren om dingen nóg beter te maken.

✔️ Je hebt een mbo 3- of 4-opleiding in de richting van techniek
✔️ Je bent secuur en werkt graag met hoogwaardige technieken
✔️ Je wilt jezelf ontwikkelen en steeds beter worden in je vak

Zo stap je aan boord

Upload je cv en motivatie via onze website. Heb je nog vragen? Neem contact op met onze recruiter Lieseth Flisijn via 06-29805895. Zien we jou binnenkort op de werf voor een rondleiding?

title: Creative Strategist (Women's Health)
description:
Menopause Care is dedicated to providing exceptional care and support for women navigating menopause. We pride ourselves on supporting all women with our empathy and warmth. Our approach is completely personalised, and goes beyond just treatment and medication.


We’re a fast-growing team, on a mission to raise the standards of menopause care globally. We’re committed to creating a menopause service that goes beyond what is currently available, and supports all women to learn about this stage in life. Our mission is to empower women with expert-led information, compassion, and practical solutions to help women to live long, healthy and happy lives.

At Menopause Care, we’re looking for a talented Creative Strategist to lead the direction of our content strategy and elevate our creative output for social advertising and other touch points. This role sits at the intersection of brand storytelling and growth marketing, playing a crucial part in driving brand awareness and customer engagement.

As Creative Strategist, you’ll partner with our production team and performance marketing lead to design and refine ad campaigns that embody Menopause Care’s brand voice and deliver impactful, measurable results. You should bring a deep understanding of digital marketing, social platforms, and a knack for crafting narratives that captivate and motivate audiences, contributing directly to the growth of Menopause Care and it’s future development to cover all female health conditions.

Menopause Care is part of the MANUAL family, which also includes our men's health services and Voy, our weight loss brand.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Campaign Strategy Development: Collaborate with performance and production teams to develop and execute strategic content plans for social ads, focused on engaging target demographics and achieving conversion goals.

  • Audience Insight and Research: Leverage data-driven insights to understand audience preferences, needs, and behaviours on social platforms, shaping campaign direction accordingly.

  • Content Creation: Working closely with our in-house production team oversee the production of ad content, including copy, visuals, and video concepts, that aligns with our brand identity and speaks to our audience effectively.

  • Optimisation and Testing: Develop and implement A/B testing frameworks to optimise ad performance, continually refining messaging, visuals, and formats to improve reach, engagement, and conversion.

  • Performance Analysis: Regularly review and analyse performance metrics to gauge ad effectiveness and provide insights and recommendations for future campaigns.

  • Brand Alignment: Ensure all ad content is on-brand and aligns with MANUAL’s core messaging and values, helping to maintain a consistent voice across all Meta adverts.

  • Trend Monitoring: Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and social media innovations, leveraging insights to inform content strategy, execution and overall channel tracking.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with internal teams, including marketing, design, and copy, to ensure content alignment and coherence across all touchpoints.

  • Proven experience as a Content Strategist, ideally with a background in Meta ads or other social platforms.

  • Strong understanding of performance marketing principles and hands-on experience creating ad campaigns on Meta.

  • Excellent copywriting skills with a talent for concise, persuasive messaging.

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign performance data and refine creative thinking accordingly.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams in a fast-paced environment.

  • Familiarity with the health and wellness category is a plus.

SALARY & BENEFITS

  • Salary range of £50k - 60k, depending on experience

  • Generous stock option plan

  • A fun and friendly working environment with sharp and motivated co-workers

  • Hybrid role based in London Bridge with lunch once per week

  • £400 per year learning and development budget with Learnerbly

  • Wellness and gym benefit with Gympass

  • Annual company retreat

  • 25 days holidays and generous parental leave & flexible working policies

  • A growing team with plenty of opportunities for progression, ownership of goals and a direct impact to MANUAL

  • Private healthcare plan

  • Join in the early stages of one of the most promising scale-ups in the health & wellness space


ABOUT MANUAL
MANUAL delivers healthcare at scale thanks to its comprehensive digital clinic. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lives for a large part of the population in the UK, Brazil, and beyond focusing on life-impeding conditions like hormonal imbalance, obesity and hair loss.

MANUAL has steadily grown since inception and is now serving 500k+ patients, across 2 geographies. We are centralising the diagnosis, custom medications, doctor specialist services, behavioural change and fully vertically integrated management of the treatment journey, under one roof and consumer brand.

We’re destigmatising how people approach their health by offering easy access to diagnostics, a holistic range of treatments, ongoing care and medical advice, as well as a community to help proactively improve one’s health and wellbeing. A place that didn't exist until now.


Innovating on healthcare delivery, MANUAL provides patients with engaging treatment plans generating superior clinical outcomes: 90%+ of patients see an improvement in their Quality of Life (QoL) within 6 months. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lifespan for a big part of the population in the UK, Brazil and beyond,

After a $30 million Series A round, we are on a mission to build one of the most impactful teams in the healthcare space. We are looking for incredibly ambitious, entrepreneurial, driven and fun people to join us as we accelerate our growth and expansion. This is an exciting time to join the UK’s fastest-growing healthtech and help supercharge our mission.

Websites:

https://www.menopausecare.co.uk/


EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Menwell Limited, trading as MANUAL, is an Equal Opportunities Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of gender and gender reassignment, age, disability, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, marriage and civil partnership. We base all our employment decisions on merit, job requirements and business needs. This applies to all decisions related to hiring, training, remuneration, promotion and discipline.

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is essential to our success. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued and respected, regardless of their background, identity or beliefs. We believe that Inclusion, Diversity, Equity and Accessibility (IDEA) is essential to our ability to offer the best possible health outcomes to our patients and customers.

title: Presales Consultant - USA
description:
In order to assist our expanding clientele with our dialogue software, we seek a Presales Consultant based in the USA. This position holds significant importance within AnywhereNow's worldwide Sales Team. As a Presales Consultant, your primary responsibility will involve gathering client specifications and determining optimal technical solutions. Your role will encompass conducting pre-sales product demonstrations and evaluating proof of concepts for both potential and current customers.

We promise an exciting role for an ambitious tech professional, who is up for an international sales challenge!


So, - in short - what will you be doing? Below you'll find a summary of the responsibilities:

  • Identify and design solutions to clients’ technical requirements, e.g. by leading workshops to scope and design a fit-for-purpose solution.

  • Engage in pre-sales technical consultancy, providing technical assistance and guidance during all stages of the presales process.

  • Support with RFP responses.

  • Create and deliver technical and product presentations, both internally and externally.

  • Proactively identify ways of improving the presales processes and team documentation.

  • Support the Professional Services team by providing clear technical requirements for the designed solution.

Why we would like to have a dialogue with you

We pick competencies over skills and experience. Can you convince us that you possess the following competencies:

  • Customer centricity: The ability to provide high-quality service (to customers), including understanding their needs, solving problems, and responding to feedback;

  • Innovation: The ability to generate and implement new and innovative ideas to solve problems and create new business opportunities;

  • Systems thinking: The ability to understand the interdependencies and complexities of a business or project and to develop integrated solutions that are scalable and adaptable to future changes;

  • Proactiveness: The ability to anticipate and take initiative in addressing potential challenges or opportunities before they arise, demonstrating foresight and proactive problem-solving;

  • Adaptability: The ability to adjust to changing situations and work effectively in environments that may be uncertain or unpredictable;

  • Collaboration: The ability to work effectively with others and to build strong relationships based on trust and mutual respect, recognizing that everyone has something to contribute;

  • Communication: The ability to communicate clearly and effectively with individuals across the organization, and to be responsive to their needs and concerns.


Competencies are key, but to be successful in this role you need to bring a few essentials to kickstart the conversation:

  • Preferably 4+ years in a customer-facing role;

  • Fields of job expertise: Microsoft Voice Technologies and Microsoft 365;

  • Awareness of HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and related web technologies and integrating third-party APIs;

  • Implementing and supporting technology solutions based on Microsoft Voice technologies.

  • Commitment to staying up to date with new-to-market technologies to deliver industry best practice service offerings.


Some last notes

Is chaos a bit of a guilty pleasure for you? Then be prepared for some excitement because no day is the same at AnywhereNow and enjoy the ride. These difficult roads will substantially add value to your development and work experience because they often lead to beautiful destinations!

But the real reason to choose us? You get the opportunity to experience what it's like to work with proud, smart, devoted and cooperative colleagues who are passionate about our dialogue products and Microsoft technology. Just like you, they go the extra mile to deliver top-notch solutions. If this sounds like what you’re looking for to find in a team, then we definitely tick that box!

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organization’s information security standards. This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures, and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer, and partner data from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices, and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches, or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.
