title: CX Transformation Consultant (NICE CXone) (U.S Only - Remote)
description:
About Condado

Condado is a fast-growing Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) system integrator and customer experience consulting firm. We specialize in helping enterprises select, implement, integrate, and support cloud-based contact center solutions. Our mission is to build seamless, AI-powered CX ecosystems that drive exceptional customer engagement and long-term growth. We partner with leading CCaaS and CX technology vendors (e.g. NICE CXone, Genesys Cloud, Five9, Zoom Contact Center, and emerging AI providers) to deliver end-to-end solutions – from upfront advisory and vendor selection through implementation, integration with CRM/back-end systems, and ongoing managed support. We operate as a “super integrator,” combining the advisory insight of a technology agent with deep technical implementation capabilities.

With Condado’s vendor-agnostic approach and focus on innovation, we enable clients to reimagine their customer interactions – integrating voice, chat, social, and AI-driven channels into one intelligent platform. Our team’s background includes experience at top CCaaS vendors, consultancies, and enterprises, giving us unmatched expertise in contact center technology and customer experience (CX) strategy.

About the Role

Condado is hiring a client-facing NICE CXone specialist to take ownership of implementation and managed-service engagements currently run by our Director of Solutions Engineering. This is not a hands-on developer/build role — our offshore development team handles the heavy technical build work. Instead, this person is the trusted face of the project: the one who runs discovery, translates client needs into clear requirements, manages the offshore build team to deliver on time and correctly, and keeps the client confident and happy throughout.

We're looking for someone who can credibly answer "can NICE do this?" the majority of the time, knows when to say "I don't know, let me find out" rather than overpromising, and treats every engagement as an opportunity to deepen the relationship — not just check a box.

What You'll Do

  • Own client relationships for assigned implementation and managed-service accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and technical credibility for the client

  • Run discovery and requirements gathering: lead kickoff calls, document workbooks and call flows, and translate business needs into buildable specs

  • Direct and QA offshore development resources: hand off requirements to build teams, hold them accountable to timelines, and spot-check work before it goes to the client

  • Manage the implementation lifecycle end-to-end — from discovery through testing, client UAT, troubleshooting, and go-live

  • Provide managed services support for existing NICE CXone customers, handling day-to-day requests, enhancements, and issue resolution

  • Act as a technical buffer on client calls — present confidently, understand the platform deeply enough to speak to it live, and loop in specialists (developers, architects) as needed

  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities by staying closely engaged with the client and understanding their broader technology roadmap

  • Partner with internal build/engineering leads (platform engineers/architects) on more complex technical designs, while retaining ownership of the client relationship and delivery outcome

Location

This role is 100% remote for candidates located anywhere in the U.S., with the exception of the Salt Lake City and Kansas City areas. Occasional travel may be required for high priority team meetings or client meetings.

Candidates based in the Salt Lake City or Kansas City metropolitan areas should expect a more hybrid work arrangement, with periodic in person collaboration.

What You Bring

  • Deep, hands-on experience with NICE CXone / NICE CXone Studio — ideally including builds involving APIs, voice, SMS/text, email, digital channels, dialer, ASR/AI (e.g., Omilia), and related integrations

  • Prior experience in a project management, implementation, or consulting capacity within a CCaaS/UCaaS or CX platform environment

  • Comfortable being the "smart PM" — technical enough to be credible with engineers and clients, but focused on delivery, communication, and relationship management rather than writing code full-time

  • Native or near-native English fluency and strong client-facing communication skills (this is a front-facing, white-glove role by design)

  • Experience working with or managing offshore/distributed development teams

  • Familiarity with SQL, JavaScript, and HTML is a plus

  • Experience with additional CCaaS platforms (Five9, Genesys, Zoom CX) is a plus but not required — NICE CXone expertise is the priority

  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent implementations and managed-service accounts

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience specifically in a "Consulting Engineer," "Solutions Engineer," or "CX Transformation Consultant" type role

  • Experience with enterprise-level accounts and multi-year, multi-phase or international rollouts

  • API integration experience with platforms like Salesforce, ServiceNow, or Fiserv

Why This Role

  • ~70–80% of Condado's business is NICE-based — this is core, high-priority work, not a side function

  • Clear growth path: strong performers naturally move toward account growth, upsell ownership, and eventually people/team leadership

  • White-glove, relationship-first culture — you're empowered to own outcomes, not just execute tickets

title: Processpecialist
description:
*Dutch speaking only*

Bij KCD betekent klantondersteuning óók dat we er zijn voor onze interne collega’s. In deze tijdelijke rol van 7 maanden maak jij het verschil door processen slimmer, consistenter en gebruiksvriendelijker te maken, zodat medewerkers hun werk soepel en met plezier kunnen doen.

Wat houdt de functie in? Als Processpecialist ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen onze stafcollega’s en de operatie. Je werkt intensief samen met onder andere IT, Communicatie, HR en Recruitment en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete verbeteringen in de medewerkersreis: van instroom tot uitstroom en alles daartussen.

Wat ga je doen in deze rol?

In deze rol zul je:

  • Medewerkersprocessen in kaart brengen, verbeteren en borgen;

  • Procesdata verzamelen, analyseren en vertalen naar praktisch en onderbouwd advies;

  • Kansen signaleren en omzetten naar acties die de beleving versterken;

  • Staf en operatie verbinden door prioriteiten af te stemmen en concreet advies te geven;

  • Zorgen dat nieuwe werkwijzen en (eventueel) systemen goed landen in de organisatie;

  • Een cultuur van continu verbeteren stimuleren door collega’s mee te nemen, te inspireren en de organisatie hierin mee te nemen.

Dit is wat wij jou bieden

Een tijdelijke functie van 7 maanden waarin je écht impact hebt op hoe onze medewerkersreis is ingericht. Je werkt in een enthousiast team (afdeling Learning & Development) waar plezier, verbinding en ontwikkeling centraal staan. Samen maken we onze dienstverlening voor medewerkers elke dag een beetje beter. Het is een functie waarin je echt impact hebt op hoe onze medewerkersreis is ingericht:

  • Veel ruimte voor initiatief, innovatie en eigen ideeën;

  • Een organisatie in ontwikkeling die vakmanschap, kwaliteit en groei centraal stelt;

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3.700,- en € 4.250,- op basis van 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Deze functie is voor 32 uur per week.

Wanneer past deze functie bij jou?

Je neemt eigenaarschap, je bent innovatief en organisatiesensitief en hebt een scherp oog voor de behoeftes van medewerkers. Dankzij jouw overtuigingskracht weet je mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen en maak je verbeteringen zichtbaar én voelbaar.

Wat breng je mee?

Voor deze functie beschik je over:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau;

  • Bij voorkeur twee jaar ervaring met proces- en systeemoptimalisatie, bij voorkeur binnen een klantenservice- of operationele omgeving;

  • Ervaring met Lean (of andere procesmethodiek) is een pre;

  • De drive om je vakgebied snel eigen te maken.

Verder neem je initiatief, ben je analytisch sterk en krijg je energie van verbeterprocessen

Solliciteren

Wil je jezelf verder ontwikkelen en in aanmerking komen voor deze functie? Stuur, vóór 7 augustus 2026, een sollicitatiebrief en cv naar Miranda Brinkmans (Operationeel Manager), miranda.brinkmans@klantcontactdiensten.nl en Leah Bijlsma (Operationeel Manager), leah.bijlsma@klantcontactdiensten.nl.

Meer informatie

Wil je eerst meer informatie? Neem dan contact op met Leah Bijlsma (Operationeel Manager), leah.bijlsma@klantcontactdiensten.nl of Wendy Hildebrand (HR Business Partner), wendy.hildebrand@klantcontactdiensten.nl.

title: Senior QA Engineer (Web)
description:
Waracle is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join our world-class digital technology consultancy. We are home to a diverse, smart, curious, and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation. We partner with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. Together, we innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design, and delivery to operations.


This role is available on Fixed-Term Contract for 7 months initially to help drive quality and scalability in our latest projects. If you love collaborating with multi-disciplinary teams, designing smart automation strategies, and mentoring others in a supportive, growth-oriented environment, we would love to hear from you!

We champion modern, balanced working and offer a hybrid setup, asking you to collaborate in person 2 days a week from either our Glasgow or Dundee offices.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

As a Senior QA Engineer, you will play a vital role in defining our quality approaches, building scalable automation frameworks, and championing best practices across the development lifecycle. This role isn't just about finding bugs; it’s about collaborating with cross-functional teams, driving continuous innovation, and acting as a trusted mentor to help others grow. If you thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your voice is heard and your technical leadership can make a tangible impact, we would love to meet you.

  • Strategy & Collaboration: Shaping testing approaches for complex features, embedding risk analysis into the workflow, and guiding exploratory testing efforts.

  • Framework Architecture: Building and evolving modular, reusable, and scalable automation components, and seamlessly integrating quality checks into CI/CD pipelines.

  • NFR Integration: Designing and automating tests for performance, security, and accessibility to ensure quality is built-in from the very start.

  • Mentorship & Growth: Supporting and mentoring other QAs to help them grow their skills, and providing encouraging, constructive feedback through peer code reviews.

  • Community & Inclusion: Leading QA knowledge-sharing sessions and owning community initiatives such as accessibility or regression standards.

What you'll bring:

We know that excellent QA professionals come from all backgrounds, and no one matches a job description 100%. If you meet the core requirements below and are excited about the role, please apply—we value potential, adaptability, and diverse perspectives just as much as checkboxes!

  • QA Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of QA best practices, methodologies (SDLC, Agile), and a strategic mindset for ensuring deep test coverage.

  • Automation Mastery: Advanced automation skills using Playwright, with the confidence to build, extend, and maintain scalable testing frameworks while focusing on high code quality.

  • Programming Skills: Practical, hands-on experience using C# to interact with and test web applications.

  • Technical Mastery: Well-rounded experience across functional, non-functional, white-box, and security testing fundamentals.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Proactive defect management, strong triage leadership skills, and the ability to anticipate risks before they arise.

  • Communication & Domain Adaptability: Excellent collaboration skills, with an ability to explain complex technical ideas simply to both teams and clients, alongside a natural curiosity to learn new project domains quickly.

The Recruitment Process

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Acquisition Partner who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!).

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Full Stack Developer (Ongoing)
description:
Jumpseller is a SaaS solution for small business to manage their online business. We focus on making e-commerce easier for everyone, so businesses can focus on what they do best: building and selling their products. Today, merchants use the Jumpseller platform to manage every aspect of their online business — from products to orders to customers, selling with an online store, on mobile, on social networks and through different e-commerce channels.


At Jumpseller you will find a startup environment in which your contributions matter and you are enabled to grow professionally. We have 2 offices, one in Porto, Portugal, and another in Santiago, Chile, and our working culture is international. We all work fully remote.


The role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our growing team. We look for skilled & dedicated people who share our passion for building a product that millions of people use.


You will

  • Work in an informal environment, for a global market;

  • Strive to write clean, modular, flawless and scalable code responsible to handle millions of records;

  • Design new features from ground-up, from a given set of specs;

  • Build automated tests for your code while help improving and maintaining our current test set;

  • Be in contact with our Customer Support Team, resolving technical issues and understand how to improve our service;

  • Take responsibility, autonomy and ownership of your work.

Your Day

Some projects and activities that we have been recently working on to give you a sense of what you’ll be doing day-to-day.

  • Work along a team of developers, designers and product owners to build a Multi-location Inventory;

  • Help complete one of our recurrent Meta Security Assessments;

  • Create an Import / Export tool, in CSV, to quickly manage stock;

  • Implement a bar code scan in React Native, for our Mobile App;

  • Work closely with our Design Team and set up the infrastructure for our UI Design System;

  • Spend a day working directly with our client-based and Support Team, triaging and fixing production issues;

  • Model in UML a new database structure for our upcoming Gift Cards feature.


The Recruitment Process

  • We will review all the CVs & Cover Letters received;

  • First interviews - lasting 30 minutes. This is an introductory meeting with our People Department, so that you get to know Jumpseller and present yourself;

  • Top candidates will be invited to participate in a Case Study, which will be done at their own pace and should not take over 4hs. Not more than 4 to 6 invitations will be sent.

  • Finally, a last interview - lasting 45 to 60 minutes - to review the resolution Case Study & focus deeper on your main professional project/achievement;

  • We expect to send you an offer by July.

All candidates will be notified from us once the process is concluded. Those on the last interview stage can request brief feedback about their application.

You are

  • A bachelor/master in Informatics (or related);

  • Proven professional experience in OO programming and web development;

  • Attentive to details, delivering quality code which is maintainable, efficient and reliable;

  • Experienced in MySQL, or other relational databases;

  • Familiar with version-control and automated testing tools;

  • Used to work in JSON/XML/CSV formats and have no issues with HTML/CSS;

  • Experienced in Ruby or Ruby and Rails (the right candidate will be considered without this experience);

  • Good in English communication and teamwork.

title: Drupal Software Engineer | U.S. Based | Federal Background Check Required
description:
Location: Remote (US-based)
Employment Type: Full-time (1099 Consultant)

About Viderity

Viderity is a HUBZone-certified and Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) delivering award-winning IT, digital, and creative solutions across federal and commercial markets. Our services span application development, creative services, cybersecurity, data analytics, strategic communications, event management, training, and program management. With over 15 years of proven success and exceptional past performance, we empower clients with innovative, measurable results.

Position Overview

The Drupal Software Engineer will be a developer working across the Drupal portals, with particular focus on the UI and backend features supporting the Applicant Portal and Reviewer Portal. The person will also contribute across the broader SAP ecosystem. The primary responsibility is to build, enhance, and maintain the Applicant Portal and Reviewer Portal, while also contributing to adjacent Drupal-based systems and the broader SAP ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Frontend Responsibilities

• Build and maintain the Applicant Portal, Reviewer Portal, Metadata Manager Portal, and Administrator Portal front end components
• Implement a user centered UI aligned with NSF’s design standards and consistent with USWDS patterns where used
• Ensure complete Section 508 compliance including keyboard navigation, semantic structure, ARIA patterns, and screen reader compatibility
• Implement role-based access control in the UI so users see only the data and actions appropriate for their role
• Work closely with UX, product, and NSF teams to implement wireframes and requirements accurately

Backend Responsibilities

• Build and maintain Drupal backend logic including custom modules, hooks, forms, and custom Form API implementations
• Implement workflows for application intake, review processes, scoring, metadata validations, and program configuration
• Build and maintain RESTful APIs and integration points
• Support metadata ingestion pipelines and validation rules
• Implement user and role management consistent with RBAC requirements
• Collaborate with database engineers on data modeling, queries, and performance tuning
• Contribute to monitoring, logging, and error handling to support production stability

General Software Engineering Responsibilities

• Perform end to end analysis, design, and development
• Code, debug, test, and troubleshoot during the full development lifecycle
• Conduct and participate in peer code reviews
• Participate in UI and UX discussions and provide engineering input
• Mentor and support junior engineers as needed

Qualifications

Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent years of experience
• At least 5 years of professional engineering experience

Technical Skills Required

•Experience with Sass for CSS preprocessing and Twig for templating

• Demonstrated experience with Drupal development, including Drupal 10 module development, Drupal 10 Form APIs, custom forms, templates, theming, hooks, and custom workflows
• Experience building complex, accessible web applications
• Experience implementing Section 508 and WCAG accessibility
• Experience with role-based access control in both frontend and backend contexts
• Strong backend experience with APIs, workflow logic, and metadata driven systems
• Strong relational database skills
• Familiarity with cloud or hybrid hosting environments
• Experience with CI and CD pipelines, Docker, and modern DevOps practices is a plus

Soft skills

• Strong communication and comfort working with teams
• Client facing professionalism
• Strong attention to detail

• U.S. Citizenship required (due to Federal contract restrictions)

title: Customer Experience Specialist (Hybrid)
description:
This is a rare opportunity to join our dynamic and fast growing Patient Experience team, working across multiple treatment categories (Weight Loss, Hair Loss).

We are looking for customer obsessed and resourceful individuals to join us to reinvent how we do customer care here at Manual.

Your goal is to create an experience so good our patients have to tell their friends about us. You'll be the first person our patients speak to and you'll advocate their voice throughout the company. You’ll also help us reinvent our patient experience tools and processes to drive efficiency and better care.

You’re someone who makes things happen despite ambiguity and can calmly handle periods of breakneck scaling and moments of chaos. You have a passion for solving real patient problems.


What you'll be doing

  • Helping solve our patient problems with world class service when they get in touch

  • Being the voice of MANUAL and working with patients to help guide them through their journey across multiple channels (phones, email, live chat)

  • Working closely with various teams to make sure we’re unblocking any potential barriers patients may face

  • Creating and improving processes that allow us to help patients in the most effective way possible

  • You're good at explaining things to people and you are thoughtful in all of your interactions

  • You have some experience working in a customer support role within a scaling tech startup environment.

  • You see feedback as a gift, and constantly look for ways to improve your work and grow as a person

  • You're super organised, live by your calendar and know how to develop processes to make sure you never miss a beat!

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication

  • You have a "roll up your sleeves" mentality where you're willing to learn and jump into unknown situations

  • You are excited about healthcare and what we're building at MANUAL

  • You can work from our London Bridge HQ 3 days per week (Tuesday-Thursday)

How you operate

  • Think big - you're inspired by frighteningly ambitious solutions to big patient problems, you approach them from first principles and you have the determination to clear hurdles to get there.

  • Move fast - you set just the right pace, you collaborate well and you're a clear communicator that can quickly understand people's needs and help them find a solution.

  • Make it better - you think about the bigger picture, you have a growth mindset with yourself and others (including a healthy relationship with feedback), you're hard on problems not people and do whatever you can to help our patients.

Our hiring process

  • If we think you could be a great fit, we will be in touch within a few days for an initial phone call with our talent team to understand your motivation and experience

  • You will then be invited to an on-site group assessment where you will do brainstorming sessions, a role play task and an interview

  • We will get back to you with an outcome within the following 2 working days

Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary is up to £30,000 depending on experience

  • 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays

  • Hybrid role based in London Bridge 3 days a week with lunch once a week

  • Private medical insurance

  • £400 annual Learning & Development budget

  • Gym & Wellness benefit with Wellhub

  • Annual company retreat

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Electric car scheme

  • Healthy snacks & drinks in the office

ABOUT MANUAL

MANUAL delivers healthcare at scale thanks to its comprehensive digital clinic. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lives for a large part of the population in the UK, Brazil, and beyond focusing on life-impeding conditions like hormonal imbalance, obesity and hair loss.

MANUAL has steadily grown since inception and is now serving 500k+ patients, across 2 geographies. We are centralising the diagnosis, custom medications, doctor specialist services, behavioural change and fully vertically integrated management of the treatment journey, under one roof and consumer brand.

We’re destigmatising how people approach their health by offering easy access to diagnostics, a holistic range of treatments, ongoing care and medical advice, as well as a community to help proactively improve one’s health and wellbeing. A place that didn't exist until now.

Innovating on healthcare delivery, MANUAL provides patients with engaging treatment plans generating superior clinical outcomes: 90%+ of patients see an improvement in their Quality of Life (QoL) within 6 months. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lifespan for a big part of the population in the UK, Brazil and beyond.

After a $30 million Series A round, we are on a mission to build one of the most impactful teams in the healthcare space. We are looking for incredibly ambitious, entrepreneurial, driven and fun people to join us as we accelerate our growth and expansion. This is an exciting time to join the UK’s fastest-growing healthtech and help supercharge our mission.

title: Mobile QA Engineer (Mid Level)
description:
Waracle are looking for a QA Engineer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation. We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

We champion modern, balanced working and offer a hybrid setup, asking you to collaborate in person 2 days a week from either our Glasgow or Dundee offices.


The Opportunity

Are you a detail-oriented problem solver who loves collaborating to build high-quality digital experiences? As a QA Engineer at Waracle, you’ll play a vital role in ensuring our products are seamless and user-friendly. You’ll be a key collaborator who connects technical defects to real-world business value, tailoring your communication to ensure everyone—from developers to stakeholders—is on the same page. We value growth and support, and in this role, you’ll have the opportunity to not only manage your own workflows but also help welcome and onboard new team members into our QA community.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Collaborative Test Design: Designing and running tests independently while using product personas to advocate for the end-user journey.

  • Automation Engineering: Building and maintaining regression automation packs and integrating them into CI pipelines for rapid feedback.

  • System Health & Observability: Using logs and dashboards to investigate issues and validate system health throughout the testing lifecycle.

  • Inclusive Testing (NFR): Executing tests across non-functional areas such as Accessibility, Security, and Performance to ensure our products work for everyone.

  • Clear Communication: Providing concise updates in stand-ups and translating complex technical issues into accessible language for non-technical audiences.

What you'll bring

We are looking for a curious and technically-minded individual who enjoys working in a supportive, fast-paced environment. You’ll bring:

  • Mobile Testing Experience: Solid experience testing mobile applications on iOS and Android.

  • Automation Toolkit: Hands-on experience working with mobile automation frameworks. Appium, Detox or Maestro experience would be a bonus!

  • CI/CD Integration: Experience using GitHub Actions or similar tools to support automated test execution within the delivery pipeline.

  • Agile & SDLC Methodologies: A solid understanding of Agile and SDLC methodologies, functional and non-functional testing, and white-box and security testing fundamentals.

  • Non-Functional Testing: Familiarity with non-functional testing tools and checklists for performance, security, and accessibility.

The Recruitment Process

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Acquisition Partner who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!).

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

Als Full Stack Developer werk je aan digitale oplossingen voor verschillende klanten. Je schakelt tussen front-end en back-end. Je bouwt applicaties als klantportalen en websites met diverse tools, maar denkt ook mee over technische oplossingen en deelt jouw vakkennis met collega’s. Je werkt samen met collega-developers, maar ook projectmanagers en product owners.

Dit is digital agency, een bedrijf dat digitale oplossingen bedenkt, vormgeeft, ontwikkelt, meet en onderhoudt. Het bedrijf biedt de combinatie van strategische, technische en creatieve ontwikkeling van digitale producten en diensten. Binnen het bedrijf heerst een informele werksfeer. Er zijn flexibele werktijden en -dagen, verschillende faciliteiten op en rond kantoor en ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Jij bent een ervaren IT-professional die nieuwsgierig is en blijft leren. Jouw nieuwe kennis deel je graag met collega’s. Je kunt goed schakelen tussen de verschillende partijen met wie je communiceert. Je denkt mee over de architectuur. Je bent een teamspeler die niet bang is om zijn/haar mening te delen. Daarnaast heb je:

  • Vijf jaar ervaring in het ontwikkelen van PHP/Front-end webapplicaties;

  • Kennis van Laravel en/of Statamic;

  • Kennis van NPM/Webpack;

  • Ervaring met Tailwind en Alpine.js;

  • Ervaring met versiebeheer en unit testing;

  • Ervaring met Wordpress is pre.

In deze rol is het essentieel dat je vloeiend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft vanwege de communicatie met klanten en collega’s. Ook is de voorkeur dat je in de omgeving van de werkgever woont, in verband met (deels) werken op kantoor.

Kun jij je (deels) herkennen in deze vacature? Reageer dan vooral! We gaan graag met jou in gesprek om jou beter te leren kennen. Neem contact met ons op!

title: Senior Microsoft Systems Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior MS Systems Engineer L3

Primary Location: Chicago IL, near O'Hare / Northwest Suburbs

Position Type: Full-Time Direct Hire or Contract to Hire

⭐️ Help Save Lives, Inspire Change, and Make an Impact!

Come join a mission-driven health organization that improves hundreds of thousands of lives.

OverviewTalentFish is casting a line for a Senior MS Systems Engineer L3 in Chicago's near west suburbs. This is a hybrid role as needed (approx. 1-2 days per week or less). This position will be primarily focused on managing/maintaining on-premises infrastructure, with some interaction with cloud-based tools such as Azure AD (Entra ID) and Intune.

  • In this role, you will be designing, implementing, managing, and maintaining the organization's Information Technology Systems.

  • Y

    ou will be working with the architecture team to evaluate and ensure the efficient and secure operation of IT and business systems.

  • The ideal candidate will have in-depth skills in Windows System Administration, Active Directory management, a strong understanding and management of FSMO roles, Group Policy Management, Event Viewer and Event Log analysis, and GPO configuration and maintenance.

What You Bring to the Role / Required Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in systems administration, IT infrastructure management, and

  • Experience supporting Microsoft technologies, including MS Windows Server, Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), MS Office 0365, MS Intune, Active Directory, and Azure AD (Entra ID).

  • Proven experience supporting and managing on-premises infrastructure, including Active Directory, Windows Server, storage systems, and virtualization platforms (e.g., Hyper-V).

  • Comfortable operating in on-premises IT environments, while possessing working knowledge/experience in cloud technologies like Azure AD and Intune.

  • Strong expertise in Active Directory operations, including FSMO role management, Group Policy Objects (GPO), and Event Viewer/Event Log analysis for system diagnostics and auditing.

  • Proven experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining server and storage infrastructures.

  • Experience working with complex IT environments, including Active Directory configurations, Azure AD (Entra ID), VMs, and Hyper-V.

  • Experience working with multiple operating systems, servers, and storage systems management.

  • Experience managing system security, IAM, compliance, and endpoint security using tools like Okta, SentinelOne, or similar.



What You'll Do. (Skills Used in this Position)

Server Management:

  • Take ownership of on-premises system infrastructure, ensuring stability, performance, and security across physical and virtual environments.

  • Administer and maintain server infrastructure, including installation, configuration, and monitoring.

  • Perform proactive monitoring and diagnostics using Event Viewer and other native tools to ensure server health and system integrity.

  • Perform regular system updates, backups, and ensure high availability of servers.

  • Troubleshoot server-related issues and optimize server performance.

Storage Management:

  • Design, implement, and maintain the storage infrastructure ecosystem.

  • Design, implement, and maintain data backup environment, including off-site disaster recovery.

  • Responsible for applying patches, upgrading software, and making sure that data is secure.

  • Maintain the fiber channel switches, cloud storage, and SAN arrangements.

Active Directory:

  • Design, implementation, and maintenance of on-premises Active Directory, including group policies, domains, and authentication. Familiarity with Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) in a hybrid capacity is beneficial.

  • Responsibilities include managing domains, troubleshooting Active Directory authentication issues, performing FSMO role placement and maintenance, and using Event Logs for diagnostics and security auditing.

  • Ensure that the Active Directory environment is secure, efficient, and scalable.

  • Manage certificate authority servers, certificate lifecycle, and secure PKI infrastructure.

  • Provide management and support of DNS systems.

  • Develop strategies for disaster recovery and ensure compliance with regulations and policies.

System Design, Implementation & Configuration:

  • Design, implement, and maintain IT systems and infrastructure.

  • Ensure the seamless integration of innovative technologies into existing systems.

  • Assist in the recommendation of hardware and software solutions to meet organizational requirements.

Security and Compliance:

  • Develop, implement, and enforce security policies, procedures, and best practices.

  • Assist during regular security audits and vulnerability assessments.

  • Ensure compliance with industry regulations and standards.

  • Monitor and address issues related to device endpoint security and configuration deployment.

Technical Support:

  • Collaborate with the service desk team to resolve escalated technical problems.

  • Develop and maintain documentation for troubleshooting and system configurations.

  • Provide technical support to end-users, addressing hardware and software issues.

  • Perform incident root cause analysis and remediation of system outages.

  • Participate in on-call rotation to provide off-hours support and maintenance.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements.

  • Collaborate with peers, system architects, and other stakeholders to develop effective IT solutions.

  • Communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Maintain infrastructure diagrams, configurations, and operating procedures.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Stay informed about industry trends and emerging technologies.

  • Propose and implement improvements to enhance system performance and efficiency.

  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with relevant certifications and skills.

title: Partnerships Associate
description:
Are you ready to step onto the playing field of a fast-growing US tech startup that's changing the game in the world of sports?

GoodRec is looking for a Partnerships Associate to join our team and take full ownership of a portfolio of venue partners across key U.S. markets. You'll be the person who goes back to the same partners week after week, pushes for more slots, negotiates better terms, and turns a one-game relationship into five. This is a commercial role first — the ops comes with it, but the growth is what you own.

About us:

GoodRec started 4 years ago with a small community in Brooklyn, New York. Since then, we have grown into the largest pickup sports app in North America. With the GoodRec app, finding a one-off pickup game, league, or tournament near you is fast and easy. All you have to do is tap the app, join a game, and show up ready to play!

Check out the GoodRec app here:

What you’ll do

As a Partnerships Associate, you will:

  • Go back to your venue partners week after week and negotiate more time slots, a new Thursday night game, an extra Sunday morning, a better rate on prime hours, even when they're already happy with what they have.

  • Own your market's revenue growth. You set the direction, you make the calls, and you're accountable to the numbers every week.

  • Review your market's fill rates and cancellation data every week and make decisions. Cut the Saturday slot that never fills, double down on the Tuesday night that always sells out, push a venue for better terms when you know the data is on your side.

  • Manage the full relationship with each venue including contracts, billing, scheduling, and the ongoing commercial conversation about how to grow together.

  • Coordinate with internal teams to make sure every game you add goes live smoothly, but the commercial decisions are yours to make.

The ideal profile

  • Experience growing existing partnerships by going back to the same clients or partners and negotiating more: more volume, better terms, expanded scope, not just maintaining what was already there.

  • Knows when to push back on a partner and does it confidently. This role requires advocating for GoodRec's interests, not just accommodating whatever the venue wants.

  • Experience growing existing partnerships by identifying and negotiating new opportunities within current relationships. Not cold outreach, but the persistent commercial conversation that turns a one-slot venue into a five-slot partner.

  • Passion for sports, communities, and building things from the ground up.

  • Startup mindset: resourceful, adaptable, and eager to take ownership.

Some key requirements

  • Minimum of 1 to 3 years of experience in sales, partnerships, or business development, ideally within a fast-paced or startup environment.

  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, International Business, or related field.

  • Native or near-native English level: fluent verbal and written communication.

  • Full-time availability.

Some perks you’ll enjoy

  • Competitive salary with startup growth opportunities

  • Work remotely from your city

  • Join an international team spread across the US, Canada, and Colombia

  • Paid time off + US holidays

  • Monthly in-person team meetups to connect with the full GoodRec crew

🚀 This is your chance to be part of an international team that is shaping the future of sports worldwide!

title: Head of Presales
description:
About AnywhereNow

AnywhereNow is a Microsoft Teams-native Contact Centre as a Service (CCaaS) provider, backed by Bregal private equity. We enable enterprises to deliver customer engagement directly within the Microsoft ecosystem, spanning our omnichannel contact centre platforms (Dialogue Cloud and Dialogue Cloud Neo), our native attendant console and contact centre solution (Tendfor), and our AI-powered agent assist capability (Deepdesk). We sell globally through a partner-led model alongside direct enterprise engagement, competing against the likes of Genesys, NICE, Five9, and Luware.

The Role

The Head of Pre-Sales owns the global solutions consulting function and is accountable for the technical quality, credibility, and velocity of every deal in the pipeline. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will lead and develop a distributed team of pre-sales consultants while personally engaging on strategic and complex opportunities, partner enablement, and executive-level technical evangelism.

You will be a core member of the commercial leadership team, working directly with the CSO, regional sales leaders, product management, and engineering to translate customer and partner needs into winning solutions — and to feed structured field intelligence back into the product roadmap, particularly across AI and agent-assist capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and scale the global pre-sales team, setting standards for discovery, demonstrations, proof-of-concept execution, and RFP/RFI responses across all regions.

  • Own technical win strategy on strategic opportunities across the full portfolio (Dialogue Cloud, Neo, Tendfor, Deepdesk), including personal engagement on lighthouse and competitive deals.

  • Build and maintain world-class demonstration environments, demo narratives, and value-based presentation assets aligned to enterprise buyer personas.

  • Drive partner technical enablement: certification pathways, demo capability, and solution architecture support for channel partners, distributors, and technology services distributors (TSDs).

  • Embed rigour into the sales process, ensuring technical qualification aligns to MEDDPICC methodology and CRM stage-gate criteria, and that technical risk is surfaced early and honestly in forecast reviews.

  • Develop competitive differentiation in the field, equipping the team to win against Genesys, NICE, Five9, Luware, and Microsoft-native alternatives, with particular focus on Teams-native architecture and AI-driven agent assist.

  • Act as the voice of the field to Product, providing structured feedback on roadmap priorities, gaps, and win/loss drivers — including AI, recording, and integration capabilities.

  • Support Microsoft ecosystem alignment, including co-sell readiness, marketplace positioning, and joint solution plays with Microsoft field teams.

  • Own pre-sales operational metrics: technical win rate, PoC conversion, cycle-time contribution, demo-to-close ratios, and team utilisation.

  • Recruit and develop talent, building a bench of solutions consultants capable of supporting growth across Europe, North America, and beyond.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

  • A high-performing, well-led pre-sales team with clear coverage across regions and products, and measurably improved technical win rates.

  • A repeatable, portfolio-wide demonstration and PoC framework that partners and internal sellers can execute consistently.

  • Partner technical enablement programme launched, with priority partners certified and self-sufficient on demos for Tendfor and Neo.

  • Technical qualification embedded in forecast discipline, with pre-sales input trusted as a leading indicator of deal health.

  • A credible, differentiated AI/agent-assist story in the field, co-developed with Product, that wins against larger competitors.

Experience & Skills

  • 10+ years in pre-sales/solutions consulting within CCaaS, UCaaS, CX, or enterprise SaaS, with 5+ years leading pre-sales teams, ideally internationally.

  • Deep domain knowledge of contact centre technology: omnichannel routing, workforce engagement, quality management, CRM integrations, and conversational/agentic AI.

  • Strong understanding of the Microsoft ecosystem — Teams, Azure, Dynamics, and Microsoft co-sell motions — is a significant advantage.

  • Proven success in partner-led go-to-market models, enabling channel partners and system integrators to sell and demonstrate independently.

  • Experience competing against major CCaaS vendors (e.g. Genesys, NICE, Five9) and articulating differentiation to both technical and executive audiences.

  • Fluency in structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC or equivalent) and comfort operating within a metrics-driven, PE-backed environment.

  • Exceptional communication and executive presence: equally credible whiteboarding architecture with engineers and presenting to C-level buyers.

  • Willingness to travel regularly across Europe and periodically to North America.

Personal Attributes

• Player-coach mindset: leads from the front and is energised by hands-on deal work as well as team development.

• Intellectually honest: surfaces risks and gaps early rather than softening difficult realities.

• Builder temperament: comfortable creating structure, assets, and process where little exists today.

• Commercially minded: understands that pre-sales exists to win business, not simply to demonstrate technology.

What We Offer

  • A senior leadership role with genuine influence over commercial strategy, product direction, and company trajectory during a pivotal growth phase.

  • Competitive base salary, performance-related bonus, and participation in the company incentive scheme.

  • Flexible, remote-friendly working with a collaborative international leadership team.

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organization’s information security standards. This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures, and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer, and partner data from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices, and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches, or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

Your goal is to create an experience so good our patients have to tell their friends about us. You'll be the first person our patients speak to and you'll advocate their voice throughout the company.

  • Move fast - you set just the right pace, you collaborate well and you're a clear communicator that can quickly understand people's needs and help them find a solution.

  • Private medical insurance

  • £400 annual Learning & Development budget

title: Jeugdzorgwerker C Amsterdam-Zuidoost
description:
Waar je écht dicht bij het kind staat en het verschil maakt in het dagelijks leven van gezinnen.

Functieomschrijving

Als Jeugdzorgwerker C op onze Kinderopvangzorggroepen (KZG’s) werk je met kinderen in de leeftijd van 2 tot 5 jaar voor wie een reguliere kinderopvang niet vanzelfsprekend is. Deze groepen bevinden zich beide in Amsterdam Zuidoost. Als jeugdzorgwerker C werk je op een bijzondere plek waar zorg en kinderopvang samenkomen. Samen met een Pedagogisch Medewerker van de kinderopvang begeleid je een groep van maximaal 8 kinderen.

Je werkt met kinderen die nog volop in ontwikkeling zijn. Soms is er nog geen diagnose bekend en zijn ouders en professionals samen op zoek naar wat een kind nodig heeft. Daar ligt jouw kracht. Jij kijkt verder dan alleen gedrag en ziet het kind erachter. Met jouw kennis, geduld en creativiteit help je kinderen stap voor stap groeien richting een passende vervolgplek.

Je werkt in een klein, hecht team samen met collega’s uit de kinderopvang. Samen bieden jullie een gestructureerd dagprogramma, waarin spel, ontdekken, observeren en zich veilig voelen samenkomen. Je volgt de ontwikkeling van de kinderen nauwgezet, signaleert wat ze nodig hebben en vertaalt dit naar concrete doelen in het begeleidingsplan. Je hebt regelmatig contact met ouders en denkt mee over wat zij thuis kunnen doen om hun kind te ondersteunen.

Naast de begeleiding op de groep kom je ook bij de kinderen thuis en kijk je wat ouders nodig hebben om hun kind verder tot ontwikkeling te laten komen. Daarnaast werk je samen met collega’s van ’t Kabouterhuis, zoals orthopedagogen, gezinsbegeleiders en andere jeugdzorgwerkers.

Waar ga je werken?

Je gaat werken op twee Kinderopvangzorggroepen Zuidoost van Zonova en MOC ’t Kabouterhuis. De ene is gevestigd aan het Leksmondplein in de wijk Gaasperdam en de andere op de grens van Amsterdam Zuidoost en Diemen. Op beide locaties is 1 groep met maximaal 8 kinderen in de leeftijd 2 tot 5 jaar. Je werkt hier nauw samen met collega’s van Zonova. Samen delen jullie kennis en stemmen jullie de begeleiding goed op elkaar af. Op de groep begeleid je kinderen die niet goed mee kunnen komen in de reguliere kinderopvang. Samen zorgen jullie voor een warme en veilige omgeving waarin kinderen zich kunnen ontwikkelen en zichzelf mogen zijn.

Bij ’t Kabouterhuis hebben we allemaal dezelfde drijfveer: het jonge kind en hun ouders. Begeleiden in die eerste kwetsbare stappen maakt ons werk zo waardevol. Dat is waarom we dit doen.

Onze teams zijn bevlogen, multidisciplinair en staan altijd naast elkaar én naast ouders. Samenwerken is bij ons niet slechts een lege term, maar onderdeel van hoe we elke dag met elkaar werken. Dat maakt dat mensen jarenlang bij ’t Kabouterhuis blijven werken. Je komt terecht in een warme, betrokken groep professionals waar gelijkwaardigheid de standaard is en je altijd kunt terugvallen op collega’s.

Je hebt:

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Social Work of Pedagogiek

  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie (of je kunt die voor start weer activeren)

  • Ervaring met het jonge kind (0–7 jaar) binnen de jeugdzorg of jeugd-ggz

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met werken in een behandel- of begeleidingsgroep

  • Affiniteit met schoolvoorbereiding en het samenwerken met ouders én onderwijs

Wat je bij ons krijgt:

  • Jaarcontract voor 24 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband bij goed functioneren.

  • Een salaris volgens CAO Jeugdzorg schaal 8 (€ 3.124,28 - € 4.375,20 p/m bij fulltime)

  • Een vakantietoeslag én eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%

  • Volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten en een fietsenplan

  • Leren en ontwikkelen in ons eigen opleidingsinstituut: De Jonge Kind Academie

  • Een bevlogen team dat altijd naast je staat

  • Werken met een unieke én kwetsbare doelgroep binnen een multidisciplinair team

De doelgroep – wat ons werk het mooiste werk maakt!

Het hele jonge kind, daar moet je echt voor willen gaan. Je werkt met gezinnen die erg kwetsbaar zijn en veel meemaken. Met alle disciplines samen puzzel je aan het totaalbeeld: wat speelt er écht? En wat hebben dit jonge kind en de directe omgeving nodig? Dat maakt het werk uitdagend, verdiepend en ontzettend betekenisvol.

De Infant Mental Health (IMH) visie vormt het uitgangspunt van hoe wij werken, samenwerken en behandelen. Vanuit die visie blijven we leren en ons samen ontwikkelen. gravity9 is a boutique IT consulting company headquartered in the UK with offices in the US, Canada, Poland, and Colombia. Our team has deep experience in engineering, experience design and product management. We enjoy a challenge and pride ourselves on working with our clients on their most complex problems, finding elegant and flexible solutions that help them transform their businesses.

Join Our Growing Team - Future Opportunities Await!


We are excited to share that our company is experiencing significant growth and expansion, and as a result, we're on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

We want to be upfront about our hiring process. At this moment, we are in the process of securing projects that align with our business goals and objectives. If you're open to the idea of potentially joining our team in the future, we encourage you to continue with our interview process. We value your time and effort and believe that getting to know you better will help us make an informed decision.

Once you have effectively concluded the entire recruitment procedure, we will retain your profile and reach out to you once a suitable opportunity emerges. Additional interviews will not be necessary at this stage, and we anticipate being able to extend an offer to you promptly.

What does the recruitment process look like?

  1. Recruiter Screen

In the first call, our recruiter will learn more about you and your story to check a potential fit for gravity9. This is also an opportunity to ask your questions about the role and company. This step might take around 60 mins.

2. Tech 1 Interview with our software consultants

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.

This step will take around 90 mins.

3. Tech 2 Interview with our tech leads

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.

This step will take around 90 mins.

4. Final Interview

You made it to the very last stage! Here we already strive to cooperate with you and give you an opportunity to meet our leadership team during this informal talk. This step will take around 30 mins.

Role Description

We are in search of an individual capable of spearheading interactions with our clients. This position entails serving as the primary contact with the accountability for delivery, fostering client relationships, and supervising the team responsible for the tasks. The responsibilities also include technical leadership, getting your hands dirty with code, and effective stakeholder management through close collaboration with clients. Throughout the engagement, the role requires working closely with the client's internal staff and product teams, serving as their strategic delivery partner and trusted advisor.

We believe small, multi-disciplinary teams are most effective in delivering complex change of this nature. As such, this is a crucial role and will require flexibility and the ability to take on different responsibilities over the lifetime of the engagement.

Nice-to-have requirements:

  • Experience in Kafka (or similar technology)

Role requirements - soft skills

Key attributes and behaviours to succeed in this role will be:

  • Delivery focus - strong analysis and problem-solving skills. Ability to evaluate, design and implement effective solutions. Flexibility to adapt skills to a spectrum of client engagements, use cases and modes of change delivery

  • Strong consultant - good at listening and asking questions. Ability to see issues from different perspectives and communicate well

  • Exemplary standards of personal integrity and respect for others – professional approach to all aspects of client engagement and collaborative team working, able to quickly build relationships based on trust and transparency. Strong presentation and written and verbal communication are essential given the client facing nature of the role

title: CG Art Director - Talent Pool
description:
The Mission

INDG is building a talent pool of 3D Art Directors for future creative leadership needs across our CGI, digital twin, animation, interactive, and automated content production work.

INDG has spent more than 20 years building CGI and 3D production systems for global brands. Our work turns physical products into high-quality digital twins that can generate still imagery, animations, interactive experiences, and production-grade content across channels. Grip extends that heritage into AI-powered content orchestration, where creative direction, rendering pipelines, automation, and brand compliance need to work as one system.

This role exists for people who can own the image and understand the machine behind it. You can direct a hero render, challenge a material response, guide lighting choices, and still think about how the same visual system scales across hundreds or thousands of outputs. You care about product truth, visual consistency, and production reality.

What You Will Do

  1. Own Creative Direction Across CGI Outputs

  • You’ll shape visual direction for stills, animations, interactive experiences, and digital product content. You will interpret client briefs, identify the visual problem, and translate brand and business requirements into clear creative direction.

  • You’ll build concepts through references, mood boards, storyboards, sketches, style proposals, pitch decks, and direct render feedback.

  • Your work will give CGI teams enough clarity to execute without reducing the creative ambition.

2. Direct Scenes, Renders, and Visual Systems

  • You’ll guide CGI teams on composition, lighting, materials, camera behavior, realism, and look development. You can look at a render and identify whether the issue is lighting, material response, geometry, scale, camera, or compositing.

  • You’ll direct virtual shoots with the same attention a physical shoot requires: product truth, surface response, lens choice, framing, hierarchy, and storytelling. You’ll help teams make products feel tangible, desirable, and accurate.

3. Balance Craft With Scalable Production

  • You’ll work with producers, project managers, creative technologists, and pipeline teams to align creative ambition with scope, timelines, and production constraints.

  • You’ll know when to push for a better image and when to simplify the system so delivery stays reliable.

  • You’ll support workflows where one digital twin may need to produce many assets across markets, variants, channels, or formats.

  • You will help define creative rules that can be repeated, automated, and quality-checked without losing visual intent.

4. Lead Quality, Feedback, and Client Alignment

  • You’ll perform creative QA across renders, animations, and interactive outputs. Your feedback will be specific, visual, and actionable. Not “make it premium,” but “the edge highlight is flattening the silhouette,” or “the material needs a sharper specular response to match the product finish.”

  • You’ll act as a creative partner in client conversations, presenting concepts, explaining decisions, and evolving direction without losing the core visual idea. You’ll help international teams stay aligned on quality, ownership, and craft.

Who You Are

You live at the intersection of art direction, CGI production, and product visualization. You are not only judging images; you are shaping the system that creates them.

You Have

  • 5+ years of experience in art direction, ideally within CGI, product visualization, digital production, or agency-side visual content.

  • A strong background in CGI art direction, with practical understanding of 3D pipelines, virtual production, lighting, materials, cameras, rendering, animation, and post-production.

  • A portfolio or reel showing strong product storytelling, composition, realism, and visual decision-making.

  • Experience working directly with brands, producers, creative teams, CGI artists, and technical collaborators.

  • Comfort leading creative work under delivery pressure without lowering the bar for visual quality.

You Think

  • A render is never just an image. It is the output of a scene, a pipeline, a set of creative rules, and a production system.

  • You can balance visual ambition with constraints around timing, budget, automation, asset reuse, and client approvals.

  • You prefer clear creative direction over vague taste. You give feedback that artists can act on.

  • You are comfortable moving between categories and learning the visual language of different products, materials, audiences, and brand worlds.

Your Skills Are

  • CGI art direction, visual concepting, lighting direction, material evaluation, composition, camera direction, storytelling, creative QA, client presentation, and production-aware feedback.

  • You understand digital twins, product visualization, rendering pipelines, interactive content, and the growing role of AI-assisted production.

  • You can direct a high-end product image and also think about how that image language becomes repeatable across a larger content system.

Why Join INDG

INDG is not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build visual production systems that produce real assets for global brands.

You’ll work inside a company with deep CGI heritage, production-grade delivery standards, and a platform that connects AI workflows, digital twins, rendering pipelines, and brand-controlled content generation.

For a 3D Art Director, this means your work does not stop at a single campaign image. You help define how products are visualized, scaled, automated, and protected across entire content ecosystems.

The Procedure

Please send your resume and portfolio in English via the link provided. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact our Recruitment Department at jobs@indg.com

  • Workation: You have the chance to work twice per year for a duration of up to 4 weeks from a different country in the European Union. Our limehomies love traveling so we want to give them the chance to work from inspiring new locations regularly.

  • Sabbatical: After your 1.5 years with limehome we offer the possibility for a 3-month sabbatical. You can use it for whatever you want: may it be traveling, spending time with your besties or volunteering.

  • Everything for our limehomies: We focus on your physical wellbeing (Urban Sports Club), to your mental wellbeing (Nilo.health), or even staycations in one of our beautiful limehomes, and many more suite benefits. Join us and find out! ;)

Apply now to make an impact and bring the hospitality industry into the 21st century!

description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Developer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role, giving you the flexibility of working from home while spending 2 days a week connecting with the team in either our Glasgow or Dundee office.

Shape the Future of Digital Transformation

As a Senior Developer at Waracle, you will do so much more than just write code; you will be a key influencer, creator, and supportive guide within our engineering practice. Operating at an impactful level, you will design and deliver end-to-end backend features while acting as a trusted guardian of software quality and security.

If you are a collaborative problem-solver who enjoys technical design, sharing knowledge, and helping others thrive in a supportive, modern engineering environment, we would love to welcome your expertise.


Key aspects of the role include:

  • Architectural Delivery: Collaborating to design and deliver robust end-to-end backend subsystems, ensuring code is modular, maintainable, and built to scale.

  • Quality & Security: Championing high standards through constructive peer reviews, establishing defensive application security measures, and guiding thoughtful testing strategies across unit and service levels.

  • Consulting & Communication: Translating complex technical choices into clear, accessible language for clients and stakeholders, building strong, trusting relationships.

  • Mentorship & Practice Growth: Nurturing the growth of junior colleagues through encouraging feedback, while contributing fresh industry ideas to Waracle’s collective knowledge base.

  • Delivery Accountability: Balancing speed and quality thoughtfully to ensure the successful, sustainable delivery of features.

What you'll bring:

We know that excellent software engineering is built on diverse perspectives. We are looking for someone with a strong foundation in backend development who values collaboration just as much as technical excellence.

  • A proven track record of contributing to the delivery of complex digital products.

  • Deep, practical experience working with .NET C#.

  • Familiarity or experience with modern cloud tools and patterns, such as Azure, Durable Functions, Event sourcing, SQL, and Docker.

  • A strong understanding of SOLID principles, maintainability, and industry-standard security practices.

  • A supportive, encouraging communication style with a passion for mentoring team members and providing uplifting, constructive feedback.


Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often only apply to jobs if they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Waracle, we are looking for potential, passion, and collaborative spirit. If you meet many of these points and are excited about the role, please apply!


The Recruitment Process

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Acquisition Partner who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!).

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.


We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Engineer
description:
Welkom bij Wajer Super Yachts – waar luxe en vakmanschap samenkomen

Wajer Yachts is een Nederlands familiebedrijf in de luxe jachtbouw. Elk jaar bouwen we zo'n 60 jachten. In Heeg bouwen we de 38, 44 en 55 ft jachten en in Lemmer de 77 en onze eerste Super Yacht, ruim 100ft. Er werken inmiddels 400 mensen bij Wajer. Naast onze productielocaties hebben we servicehubs verspreid over meerdere internationale locaties zoals Zuid-Frankrijk, Ibiza, Mallorca en Miami. Ons sales- en marketingteam werkt vanuit Amsterdam.

Bij Wajer draait alles om vakmanschap, design en kwaliteit. Dat zie je terug in elk jacht dat onze werf verlaat. Om dat waar te blijven maken, zoeken we een Engineer die technische vraagstukken concreet maakt en dit koppelt aan de designfilosofiën van Wajer.

Wat ga je doen?
Als Engineer maak je deel uit van het team Design & Development. Dit is de groep die bij Wajer verantwoordelijk is voor ontwikkelingsprojecten en specials. Aan de voorkant zitten de Design Engineers, die de grote lijnen en het esthetisch ontwerp bepalen. De Project Engineer leidt de technische uitwerking. Jij vertaalt dat vervolgens naar de volledige details: maakbare oplossingen, uitgewerkt tot op het laatste onderdeel.

Dat betekent veel 3D-tekenwerk. Je maakt 2D- en 3D-tekeningen, lamineertekeningen, principeoverzichten en schema's. Je begeleidt mallenbouw, werkt detailontwerpen uit en zorgt dat alles klopt voordat het de productievloer bereikt. Je stemt af met productie, inkoop en waar nodig externe leveranciers en je draagt zorg voor de juiste certificering, zoals CE en MCA.

Tegelijkertijd word je als team ook ingezet op specials: klantspecifieke vragen, complexere verbeterpunten en kwaliteitsvraagstukken. Soms gaat het om iets wat Wajer nog nooit eerder heeft gemaakt. Een klant wil een zij-instap die niet op de plank ligt, een combinatie van werktuigbouw, composiet en stoffering. Dan ben jij degene die meedenkt, een risico-inschatting maakt en zorgt dat het eerste exemplaar meteen goed is.

Je werkt constant in het spanningsveld tussen wat maakbaar is op de vloer en wat beschikbaar is in de markt. Daarbij verlies je nooit uit het oog wat Wajer als eindresultaat wil neerzetten.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde MBO-4 opleiding in werktuigbouwkunde, scheepsbouw of een vergelijkbare richting

  • 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring als engineer, bij voorkeur in de maritieme sector of maakindustrie

  • Goede kennis van 2D- en 3D-tekensoftware

  • Composietkennis is een pre

  • Affiniteit met jachtbouw is een serieus pluspunt

  • Je bent nauwkeurig, resultaatgericht en werkt graag samen

  • Je schakelt makkelijk tussen disciplines en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar niet alles al uitgedacht is

Waar kom je te werken?
Je standplaats is Wajer Super Yachts in Lemmer, waar je samenwerkt met een team van vakspecialisten, co-makers en leveranciers. Het kan ook voorkomen dat je aan projecten voor Wajer Yachts werkt en dan werk je vanuit onze locatie in Heeg.

Wat kun je verwachten?
Je komt terecht in een ambitieus, snelgroeiend en steeds internationaler wordend bedrijf met de persoonlijke sfeer van een familiebedrijf. De lijnen zijn kort en de betrokkenheid is groot. Je merkt overal dat we erg trots zijn op wat we maken.

Je krijgt alle uitleg over de designfilosofieën van Wajer, werkt met collega's die dezelfde lat hoog leggen en ziet dagelijks het resultaat van je werk terug in de jachten die worden gebouwd.

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een salaris tussen €3.636 en €4.845

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 6,5 ADV-dagen bij een 39-urige werkweek

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per km

  • Een jaarcontract met één maand proeftijd, die we na afloop graag verlengen

  • Een stabiele en eerlijke cao (Metalektro) en bijbehorend pensioenfonds (PME)

  • Ondersteuning bij het behalen van vaarbewijzen (KVB 1 & 2)

  • En toegang tot de Wajer Academy voor verdere ontwikkeling

Zo stap je aan boord
Geïnteresseerd in deze rol? Upload je cv en motivatie via onze website.

Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter, Laurens ten Cate Hoedemaker via 06-34849125
