title: Technical Project Manager - Product Delivery (f/m/d)
description:
At Instagrid, you're helping replace fossil-fuel generators with clean, portable battery systems that transform how professionals work.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building, solving technical challenges and taking ownership in a fast-moving environment. Someone who loves turning great engineering into great products.

Your mission

You'll own the successful transition of our battery systems from product development into scalable manufacturing while supporting continuous improvements of products already in the field.

Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain and external manufacturing partners, you'll help ensure our products can be built efficiently, reliably and at the highest quality.

You'll spend time where it matters - whether that's collaborating with engineers and working alongside suppliers to solve challenges first-hand. Your experience in manufacturing or sourcing complex electronic products helps you constructively challenge and support our manufacturing partners to jointly achieve the best possible results.

Why this role matters

  • Play a key role in accelerating the transition to clean energy.

  • Bring innovative battery technology from engineering into the real world.

  • Work at the intersection of hardware development, manufacturing and supplier collaboration.

  • Join a fast-growing CleanTech company where ownership is encouraged and ideas quickly become reality.

  • Help shape products that thousands of professionals rely on every day.

Your Impact

Bring new products to life

  • Lead the transition of new hardware products from development into scalable manufacturing.

  • Work closely with Engineering and manufacturing partners to ensure products are ready for production.

  • Identify technical, operational and supply chain risks early and proactively drive solutions.

  • Support product launches and production ramp-ups together with cross-functional teams.

  • Build trusted relationships with suppliers and manufacturing partners.

Improve products throughout their lifecycle

  • Coordinate technical product changes across Engineering, Operations, Quality and Supply Chain.

  • Drive continuous improvements for products already in production.

  • Resolve technical issues together with internal teams and external partners.

  • Support structured decision-making around product changes and prioritisation.

Drive projects that make a difference

  • Coordinate timelines, stakeholders and technical dependencies across multiple teams.

  • Keep projects moving by removing obstacles and creating alignment.

  • Contribute to more efficient processes and smarter ways of working.

  • An engineering background in Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Experience managing product development projects advancing complex hardware products from prototype stage into serial production.

  • A strong understanding of hardware development, supplier collaboration and manufacturing processes.

  • Experience working with technically sophisticated products in environments such as CleanTech, Battery Technology, Consumer Electronics, Robotics, Industrial Equipment, Medical Devices or similar industries.

  • A hands-on mindset - you enjoy solving problems yourself rather than waiting for someone else to do it.

  • High ownership and the ability to move projects forward, even when things are ambiguous.

  • A collaborative working style and excellent communication across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to manufacturing partners.

  • Fluent English; German is a plus.

What will make you successful

  • You don't wait for perfect conditions and like to stretch your comfort zone.

  • You don´t need an established playbook to guide your work. Instead, you excel at applying your practical and methodical experience to new situations, where processes don´t yet exist.

  • You enjoy being close to the product, understanding technical details and working directly with the people building it.

  • You're pragmatic, curious and comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment.

  • Most importantly, you're excited by the opportunity to help accelerate the transition towards clean energy.

Your benefits

  • 30 vacation days plus 5 special leave days and 5 baby leave days

  • Urban Sports Club membership subsidy

  • Discounts on sustainable online shops

  • Join a company at the forefront of innovation

  • Free choice of operating system (MacOS or Windows)

This is Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact. Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning.

At Instagrid, we are deeply committed to equal employment opportunities as we believe in the power of diverse teams. We do not just accept diversity but actively search for the best talent regardless of gender, ethnical origin, age, religion, sexual orientation or place of origin. Working as a team, we treat each other with respect and value each other’s opinions to achieve our common goals.

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

You will take an active lead in team discussions and code reviews and work collaboratively with your colleagues to identify, prioritise and deliver features which bring value to our clients. Role requirements – soft skills

  • Customer Focus – passion for understanding the problem we are trying to solve with software and to advocate solutions to your client.

  • Delivery focus - strong analysis and problem-solving skills. Ability to evaluate, design and implement effective solutions. Flexibility to adapt skills to a spectrum of client engagements, use cases and modes of change delivery.

  • Exemplary standards of personal integrity and respect for others – professional approach to all aspects of client engagement and collaborative team working, able to quickly build relationships based on trust and transparency. Strong presentation and written and verbal communication are essential given the client facing nature of the role.

title: QA Engineer (Mid Level)
description:
Waracle are looking for a mid level QA Engineer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

We champion modern, balanced working and offer a hybrid setup, asking you to collaborate in person 2 days a week from either our Glasgow or Dundee offices.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

As a QA Engineer at Waracle, you will play a vital role in ensuring the quality and care behind the digital products we build. Operating at an independent, impactful level, you will design and run thoughtful test journeys based on project requirements. If you enjoy collaborating across teams, building out automated testing frameworks, and helping welcome and support new team members, you will thrive in this role.

  • User-Centric Test Design: Design and run tests independently, using product personas to guide user journeys and thoughtfully assessing the risk of code and configuration changes.

  • Automation Engineering: Build and maintain regression automation packs, integrating them into CI pipelines to ensure our teams receive swift, helpful feedback.

  • System Observability: Dive into logs and dashboards to investigate issues and proactively validate system health throughout the testing lifecycle.

  • Non-Functional Testing (NFR): Execute scripted and manual tests across crucial areas including Security, Performance, and Accessibility using industry-standard tools.

  • Inclusive Communication: Provide clear, concise status updates in stand-ups and bridge the gap by explaining complex QA issues in warm, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Process Care & Improvement: Suggest and implement local process enhancements, evaluating new tools or techniques that can help the team work smarter and more efficiently.

  • Team Collaboration: Manage your own tasks independently while warmly supporting the onboarding of new team members into the squad’s QA workflows.

What you'll bring:

We know that excellent QA professionals come from all backgrounds, and no one matches a job description 100%. If you meet the core requirements below and are excited about the role, please apply—we value potential, adaptability, and diverse perspectives just as much as checkboxes!

  • Proven experience as a QA Engineer, ideally within a fast-paced digital consultancy or a client-facing environment.

  • Automation skills using Playwright, with the ability to write clean code, maintain existing testing frameworks, and craft new automated test scripts.

  • Hands-on experience using C# with Playwright (or similar frameworks like Selenium or Cypress) to interact with and test web applications.

  • A solid understanding of Agile/SDLC methodologies and functional/non-functional testing, with a healthy awareness of white-box and security testing fundamentals.

  • Experience analysing requirements, defining comprehensive test coverage, and a proactive approach to identifying, tracking, and triaging defects.

  • The ability to work independently with minimal supervision while actively contributing to technical discussions, sharing knowledge, and learning efficiently across new project domains.

The Recruitment Process

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Acquisition Partner who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!).

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Academic Counselor for MiaPrep Online High School (MOHS)
description:
Location: 100% remote within the U.S. (any U.S. time zone)

Classification: Full-time, non-exempt employee

Salary: $24.95 - $35.07 per hour

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! MiaPrep Online High School (MOHS) is our online high school for students in grades 7-12. Formed in 2022 and accredited in 2023, we’ve grown from 80 students in our first year to over 530 in 2025! Miaplaza’s leadership aims to continue this high-growth trajectory, with a goal of serving 10,000+ students in the next 5-10 years! 🚀

Role Summary

The Academic Counselor partners with students and families in grades 7-12 to support academic success, graduation completion, and postsecondary readiness. The Academic Counselor acts as a case manager providing proactive academic planning, targeted intervention, and relationship-based support to ensure students remain engaged, on track, and progressing toward their goals.

Academic Counselors focus on high-impact, student-facing work, academic decision-making, graduation oversight, postsecondary planning, and whole-child academic support - while collaborating closely with Advisors, Student Support Specialists, Teachers, and the Registrar.

Academic Counselors are expected to spend approximately 45–50% of their work week (18–20 hours per week) in direct and indirect student-facing activities, including student and family meetings, academic planning conversations, proactive outreach, and intervention.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Academic Planning & Graduation Oversight

  • Develop and maintain individualized academic plans aligned to graduation requirements and student goals

  • Monitor academic progress toward graduation and intervene when students fall off track

  • Lead student-specific graduation pathway planning and course sequencing decisions

  • Ensure students meet graduation eligibility requirements

  • Read and interpret incoming transcripts, including from nontraditional, out-of-state, or international systems, and translate them accurately into MOHS courses, credit, and SAP

Student Intervention & Case Management

  • Serve as the primary Tier 2 intervention point for students escalated by Advisors

  • Conduct targeted counseling conversations to identify barriers to academic progress

  • Develop and implement short-term academic intervention plans

  • Coordinate support across Advisors, Student Support Specialists, Teachers, and administrative teams

  • Monitor intervention outcomes and adjust plans as needed

  • Hold firm boundaries around academic policy and eligibility requirements when needed, while keeping the conversation supportive and counselor-forward

Student & Family Engagement

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with students and families

  • Facilitate proactive and responsive parent–student–counselor meetings

  • Serve as a consistent point of contact for complex academic planning conversations

  • Communicate clearly and collaboratively to support student persistence

Postsecondary Planning & Curriculum Alignment

  • Guide students and families in postsecondary planning, including college, career, and alternative pathways

  • Ensure academic coursework, pacing, and graduation plans align with postsecondary goals

  • Provide accurate guidance on graduation requirements and future readiness

Onboarding & Enrollment

  • Lead new family academic onboarding conversations

  • Partner with the Registrar to ensure accurate records review, course placement and scheduling execution

  • Support students through key transitions, including entry, re-entry, and graduation

Whole-Child Academic Perspective

  • Apply a whole-child lens to academic planning, recognizing external factors that impact learning and engagement

  • Integrate wellness considerations into academic decision-making without providing clinical mental health treatment

  • Support students in developing self-advocacy, goal-setting, and executive functioning skills

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for mental health-related concerns escalated by staff: assess academic impact, develop a support plan, and refer to internal or external resources as needed — while holding a firm boundary against providing therapy, ongoing counseling, or diagnosis

Student Safety & Compliance

  • Provide consultation and academic follow-up after safety protocols are enacted

  • Maintain appropriate documentation and professional boundaries

  • All MOHS staff are considered mandated reporters and are required to respond to student safety and mental health concerns in accordance with the MOHS Crisis Response SOP. This includes participating in required training and, when appropriate, administering the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS) and following all documentation and escalation procedures.

Collaboration & Systems Work

  • Collaborate closely with Advisors to clarify escalation pathways and intervention roles

  • Partner with Student Support Specialists on Tier 3 referrals and transitions

  • Work with the Registrar to ensure accurate records and smooth operational handoffs

  • Contribute to the development, documentation, and refinement of counseling SOPs

  • Support consistent implementation of counseling processes while maintaining flexibility for student needs

Comprehensive Counseling Program & Pathway Development

  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of a comprehensive academic counseling program

  • Develop and refine graduation pathways, including traditional, accelerated, credit recovery, dual enrollment, and alternative educational opportunities

  • Support college, career, and postsecondary planning frameworks at the program level

  • Identify gaps in student access to educational opportunities and recommend programmatic solutions

  • Use student data and outcomes to inform counseling program improvements and priorities

Schedule

  • MOHS Academic Counselors are expected to have an average of 40 hours of availability each week on a year-round basis.

  • Availability during school hours, Monday through Friday between 8 am and 4 pm in a U.S. timezone (ET, CT, MT, or PT) is required.

THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY OCTOBER 1ST, 2026.

Requirements

  • Master’s degree in School Counseling, Counseling, or a related field

  • 2 years of experience in a school-based counseling or academic counseling role at the high school level

  • Strong background in academic planning, graduation requirements, and course sequencing

  • Experience supporting students through MTSS intervention, case management, and academic escalation

  • Proven ability to engage students and families in meaningful, solution-focused conversations

  • Experience guiding postsecondary planning, including college, career, and alternative pathways

  • Ability to apply a whole-child academic lens while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries

  • Experience using student data to inform academic decisions and improve counseling practices

  • Comfortable collaborating across teams in a fast-paced, evolving environment

  • Experience in virtual, hybrid, or nontraditional school settings strongly preferred

  • Ability to read and interpret academic transcripts from a wide range of school systems and apply them accurately to MOHS courses and SAP, including in unusual or ambiguous cases

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a full caseload with consistent reliability, meeting deadlines and maintaining accurate, up-to-date records for each student

  • Ability to execute defined processes precisely and completely, including detailed or repetitive administrative tasks (SAP audits, transcript review, etc.)

The ideal candidate brings:

  • Experience with classroom and/or online teaching

  • State certification or licensure as a school counselor (or eligibility)

  • Experience or certification in mental health counseling for schools

  • Experience in other areas of education, such as content creation, assessment design, or assessment administration

  • Experience with caseloads of 200 or more students

Compensation & Benefits

  • The expected starting pay range is $24.95 - $35.07 per hour. Student Advisors at MiaPrep Online High School work an average of 40 hours per week. When working year-round, this can equate to an annual pay range of $51,896 - $72,945.

  • Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering the regional differences in living and labor costs. Specific rates will be provided during the hiring process and are aligned with market data and internal equity.

  • Compensation is evaluated twice per year, based on performance.

  • Full-time employees are eligible for health, dental, and vision insurance, inclusive of specialty care options like fertility benefits, mental health services, and chiropractic care, FSA, HSA, and more.

  • All employees are eligible for a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match.

  • PTO is all-purpose time off, and combines traditional vacation and paid sick leave plans into one flexible, inclusive policy. Eligible employees can use PTO for all kinds of absences including: vacation, holidays, illness, injury, family leave, and other personal business. Full-time employees receive 16 hours of floating holiday PTO per quarter and accumulate additional PTO at the rate of 1 hour per every 17 hours worked. Annually, this amounts to approximately 122 hours per year or 15 eight-hour days on average.

  • Parental leave, and other perks and benefits are also available.

  • We invite your family and friends to join our journey! All employees receive free site memberships and discounted MOHS tuition for the children in their household, plus two additional memberships for other children in their lives.

title: Program Partner (Schools and Education)
description:
CAMELBACK VENTURES

Camelback Ventures (Camelback) increases access to opportunity for entrepreneurs of color and women by investing in their ventures and leadership while advocating for fairness in their funding.


Camelback’s flagship program is the Camelback Fellowship. Since 2015, Camelback has raised over $50M and supported 200+ social entrepreneurs – 95% identified as people of color and 55% as women. Our Fellows have raised over $365M dollars, have been named as Forbes 30 under 30, and made an impact nationwide in communities from Eastern North Carolina to Seattle.

THE ROLE

This Program Partner role will support Camelback Venture’s ongoing commitment to support founders launching charter schools, as well as those developing education programs and products. They will mentor and coach a portfolio of founders as they strengthen their business plans, map out a sustainable fundraising strategy, and provide ongoing support and connections beyond their Fellowship experience as they progress along the long arc of social entrepreneurship (0-10+ years) and meet hard goals (e.g., follow-on funding) while evolving into a durable venture.

As a part of the Program team, the Program Partner will leverage their experience with education venture and charter school founders throughout selection processes, program facilitation, and implementation of Camelback Ventures strategic priorities. Program partners will also collaborate to develop and curate new experiences and programs for founders engaged in the Camelback Ventures network.

They will also cultivate partnerships and with the investor community to help our fellows build the networks and relationships they need to secure follow-on funding for their ventures. In addition, they will assist the team in continuing to improve the design and development of a high-quality curriculum and scope and sequence that supports the growth of the founders and ventures in our program.

All Program team members will support, collaborate on, and facilitate the following bodies of work:

  • Facilitate conversations and build relationships with Camelback Fellows, Alumni, current and potential funders, and external stakeholders to provide deeper support for the Camelback Alumni via in-person and virtual engagement, as well as relevant conferences and event participation

  • Work with Program and other Camelback team members to plan, facilitate, and execute impactful learning experiences for founders throughout the year, including virtual and in person events, webinars and workshops, and the Camelback’s annual conference, the Guardian Summit

  • Co-Lead planning and implementation for ongoing alumni engagement

  • Support Programs team members to plan for and facilitate the Fellowship application and selection processes, including strategic sourcing of aligned founders

  • Partner with Data & Strategy team to collect, document, and analyze data to inform assigned workstreams and programs; explore and stay up-to-date on current research related to entrepreneurial equity and support for social entrepreneurs of color and women

  • Facilitate site visits and regional convenings between Camelback founders and aligned, area stakeholders

  • Engage in thought leadership activities, including conference presentations, panels, and writing to amplify the Camelback Ventures brand and impact

Education and Schools Program Partner Specific Workstreams:

  • Partner with Chief Program Officer as subject-matter expert to identify and engage external partners to provide targeted support and resources for education ventures and charter school founders

  • Build deep knowledge of founders and ventures in your assigned portfolio as a primary point of contact, connection-maker, and thought partner for your portfolio’s founders

  • Engage and make connections between Camelback Alumni, Fellows, organizational partners, and investors and funders of early-growth-stage ventures

  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential funders; support Camelback’s efforts to expand their network of funders that invest and fund education ventures and charter schools

title: Jeugdzorgwerker C Amsterdam Zuid
description:
Waar je écht dicht bij het kind staat en het verschil maakt in het dagelijks leven van gezinnen.

Functieomschrijving

Als Jeugdzorgwerker C op onze schoolvoorbereidende groep in Amsterdam Zuid werk je met kinderen in de leeftijd van 3 tot 5 jaar, voor wie de stap naar school niet vanzelfsprekend is. Je begeleidt kinderen met ontwikkelings-, gedrags- of sociaal-emotionele problemen en helpt hen om vaardigheden te ontwikkelen die nodig zijn om straks zo veilig en stevig mogelijk in te stromen in het onderwijs.

Je werkt op dinsdag, woensdag en vrijdag in een klein, hecht team op de groep. Samen bieden jullie een gestructureerd dagprogramma, waarin je spel, observatie en behandeling met elkaar verbindt. Je volgt de ontwikkeling van de kinderen nauwgezet, signaleert wat ze nodig hebben en vertaalt dit naar concrete doelen in het behandelplan. Je hebt regelmatig contact met ouders en denkt mee over wat zij thuis kunnen doen om hun kind te ondersteunen.

Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega’s zoals orthopedagogen, gezinsbegeleiders en andere jeugdzorgwerkers. In multidisciplinaire overleggen breng jij jouw observaties en inzichten in en draag je bij aan een gedeelde aanpak rondom het kind en het gezin.

Bij ’t Kabouterhuis hebben we allemaal dezelfde drijfveer: het jonge kind en hun ouders. Begeleiden in die eerste kwetsbare stappen maakt ons werk zo waardevol. Dat is waarom we dit doen.

Onze teams zijn bevlogen, multidisciplinair en staan altijd naast elkaar én naast ouders. Samenwerken is bij ons niet slechts een lege term, maar onderdeel van hoe we elke dag met elkaar werken. Dat maakt dat mensen jarenlang bij ’t Kabouterhuis blijven werken. Je komt terecht in een warme, betrokken groep professionals waar gelijkwaardigheid de standaard is en je altijd kunt terugvallen op collega’s.

Je hebt

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Social Work of Pedagogiek

  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie (of je kunt die voor start weer activeren)

  • Ervaring met het jonge kind (0–7 jaar) binnen de jeugdzorg of jeugd-ggz

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met werken in een behandel- of begeleidingsgroep

  • Affiniteit met schoolvoorbereiding en het samenwerken met ouders én onderwijs

Wat je bij ons krijgt

  • Een salaris volgens CAO Jeugdzorg schaal 8 (€ 3.124,28 - € 4.375,20 p/m bij fulltime)

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%

  • Volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten en een fietsplan.

  • Leren en ontwikkelen in ons eigen opleidingsinstituut: De Jonge Kind Academie

  • Een bevlogen team dat altijd naast je staat

  • Werken met een unieke en kwetsbare doelgroep binnen een multidisciplinair team

De doelgroep - wat ons werk het mooiste werk maakt!

Het hele jonge kind, daar moet je echt voor willen gaan. Je werkt met gezinnen die erg kwetsbaar zijn en veel meemaken. Met alle disciplines samen puzzel je aan het totaalbeeld: wat speelt er écht? En wat hebben dit jonge kind en de directe omgeving nodig? Dat maakt het werk uitdagend, verdiepend en ontzettend betekenisvol.

De Infant Mental Health (IMH) visie vormt het uitgangspunt van hoe wij werken, samenwerken en behandelen. Vanuit die visie blijven we leren en ons samen ontwikkelen. We zien het jonge kind altijd in de context waarin het opgroeit: de relatie met ouders, het netwerk en de omgeving. Dat vraagt om een systemische blik, een open houding en veel kennis van ontwikkeling, hechting en regulatie.

Klaar om samen het verschil te maken voor het jonge kind?

Stuur je sollicitatie in, we ontmoeten je graag.


Heb je vragen? Neem contact op met Ruth Tolhuijs (recruiter) via 0657646551 of recruitment@kabouterhuis.nl voor meer informatie.

Wat je kunt verwachten als je op de sollicitatie knop hebt gedrukt:

Je krijgt binnen 3 dagen reactie van ons team, daarna volgt een 1e gesprek en eventueel een 2e gesprek (bijvoorbeeld een meeloopdag). We checken je referentie (verplicht) en als we beiden enthousiast zijn doen we je een aanbod. We verwelkomen je graag in ons team.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Jouw rol bij ITQ

Als Solution Architect bij ITQ bepaal jij de technische koers voor onze managed services klanten met wie we bouwen aan langdurige samenwerkingen. Jij zet de doelarchitectuur neer voor onze proposities en dienstverlening binnen de context van de klantomgeving. Toekomstbestendig, logisch opgebouwd en schaalbaar ingericht.

Je vertaalt klantbehoeften en marktontwikkelingen naar heldere functionele kaders en doordachte ontwerpen. Waar nodig scherp je ook de technische uitgangspunten aan. In nauwe samenwerking met de Product Owner breng je strategie en executie samen. De Product Owner stuurt op klantwaarde en prioriteiten, jij bewaakt de technische richting, consistentie en stabiliteit. Samen vertalen jullie dit naar een concrete roadmap voor jouw klanten.

Je toetst wijzigingen en voorstellen aan de doelarchitectuur, maakt impact en risico’s inzichtelijk en zorgt voor draagvlak bij zowel klanten als interne teams. Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in pre sales door oplossingsrichtingen te toetsen op haalbaarheid en architectuurfit. Zo zorg je ervoor dat wat wordt verkocht niet alleen goed klinkt, maar ook solide en uitvoerbaar is.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je ontwerpt en bewaakt de doelarchitectuur binnen jouw klantportfolio, inclusief standaarden en platformsamenhang. Met Product Owners stel je roadmaps op voor upgrades en verbeteringen en begeleid je strategiesessies om koers te bepalen.

  • Je vertaalt wensen en marktontwikkelingen naar technische kaders en high level designs. Je toetst wijzigingen aan de architectuur, maakt risico’s en impact inzichtelijk en adviseert teams en klanten binnen de afspraken.

  • In pre sales trajecten ben je inhoudelijk expert bij offertes. Je beoordeelt haalbaarheid, scherpt aannames aan en bewaakt de balans tussen standaard dienstverlening en maatwerk. Intern draag je bij aan standaardisatie, kennisdeling en de doorontwikkeling van proposities.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt hbo werk en denkniveau en ruime ervaring als architect binnen IT omgevingen. Je overziet complexe architecturen, werkt gestructureerd volgens methodieken als TOGAF, BiSL, ASL of ITIL.

  • Je brengt aantoonbare expertise mee in minimaal één domein zoals software defined datacenters of cloud, werkplekarchitecturen, automation en desired state of complexe informatie en applicatielandschappen, bij voorkeur binnen healthcare.

  • Je schakelt tactisch, neemt onderbouwde beslissingen en maakt technische keuzes begrijpelijk. Met overtuigingskracht en sterk stakeholdermanagement creëer je draagvlak van engineers tot directie.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ITQ werk je aan complexe en inhoudelijk uitdagende architectuurvraagstukken binnen een organisatie waar innovatie, kennisdeling en ondernemerschap centraal staan. Je krijgt ruimte om richting te geven, impact te maken bij klanten en jezelf continu te ontwikkelen via trainingen en certificeringen.

Je ontvangt een marktconform salaris, een mobiliteitsregeling of leaseauto, een collectieve bonusregeling en flexibele mogelijkheden om hybride te werken. Daarnaast maak je deel uit van een hechte community van specialisten die elkaar inhoudelijk uitdagen en versterken.

Bij ’t Kabouterhuis hebben we allemaal dezelfde drijfveer: het jonge kind en hun ouders. Begeleiden in die eerste kwetsbare stappen maakt ons werk zo waardevol. Dat is waarom we dit doen.

Onze teams zijn bevlogen, multidisciplinair en staan altijd naast elkaar én naast ouders. Samenwerken is bij ons niet slechts een lege term, maar onderdeel van hoe we elke dag met elkaar werken. Dat maakt dat mensen jarenlang bij ’t Kabouterhuis blijven werken. Je komt terecht in een warme, betrokken groep professionals waar gelijkwaardigheid de standaard is en je altijd kunt terugvallen op collega’s.

Je hebt

  • HBO+/WO werk- en denkniveau bij voorkeur in de bedrijfskunde of management

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met project- en programmamanagement in de zorg

  • Het vermogen om strategische doelen te vertalen naar concrete uitvoering én andersom

  • Inzicht in bedrijfsvoering en organisatieprocessen

  • Focus op oplossing en resultaat

Wat je bij ons krijgt

  • Een salaris volgens CAO Jeugdzorg (€ 4537 - € 7140)

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%

  • Volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten en een fietsenplan

  • Leren en ontwikkelen in ons eigen opleidingsinstituut: De Jonge Kind Academie

  • Een bevlogen team dat altijd naast je staat

De doelgroep – wat ons werk het mooiste werk maakt!

Het heel jonge kind, daar moet je echt voor willen gaan. Je werkt met gezinnen die erg kwetsbaar zijn en veel meemaken. Met alle disciplines samen puzzel je aan het totaalbeeld: wat speelt er écht? En wat hebben dit jonge kind en de directe omgeving nodig? Dat maakt het werk uitdagend, verdiepend en ontzettend betekenisvol.

De Infant Mental Health (IMH) visie vormt het uitgangspunt van hoe wij werken, samenwerken en behandelen. Vanuit die visie blijven we leren en ons samen ontwikkelen. We zien het jonge kind altijd in de context waarin het opgroeit: de relatie met ouders, het netwerk en de omgeving. Dat vraagt om een systemische blik, een open houding en veel kennis van ontwikkeling, hechting en regulatie.

Klaar om samen het verschil te maken voor het jonge kind?

Stuur je sollicitatie in of neem contact op voor meer informatie.

We ontmoeten je graag.

Wat je kunt verwachten als je op de sollicitatie knop hebt gedrukt:

De sluitingsdatum voor de sollicitaties is vrijdag 14 augustus. De gesprekken vinden plaats op 19, 20, 24 en 26 augustus tussen 09:00 en 14:00 uur. Iedere kandidaat heeft op die dag twee gesprekken van 45 minuten.

We checken je referentie (verplicht) en als we beiden enthousiast zijn doen we je een aanbod. En verwelkomen je graag in ons team.

title: Projectmanager
description:
Je vindt hier een korte omschrijving van deze vacature. Nog vragen? Of benieuwd of dit een passende rol voor jou is? Neem contact met ons op!


Als Projectmanager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de volledige, multidisciplinaire projecten. Je bent vanaf het begin tot het eind betrokken en bent, voor zowel intern als extern, het aanspreekpunt. title: Automotive Retoucher - Talent pool
description:
Please note, this listing is not for an immediate open position but for our Talent Pool for Retoucher.

We are continuously looking to connect with talented and experienced Automotive Retouchers to join our talent pool. We’re interested in hearing from professionals who have a deep passion for creating high-end, photorealistic Automotive imagery - individuals who know how to make every curve, reflection, and surface of a vehicle look stunningly real and emotionally engaging.

About INDG

INDG is a technology company specializing in large-scale CGI content creation, digital twin production, and automated content generation at a global scale. Our clients span all consumer product industries: food and beverage, beauty and luxury, personal care, health and hygiene, automotive, healthcare, fashion, and consumer electronics.

INDG blends over two decades of industry expertise with proprietary tech to transform physical products into digital twins, rich content, and interactive experiences for any platform. INDG combines artistry with CGI expertise to virtualize content production.

About Grip

As INDG's software branch, Grip is an end-to-end content automation platform that generates infinite ad variations by combining CGI, rule-based generative AI, and post-production into an easy-to-use automated content generation platform that transforms master ad creatives into endless variations—empowering brands to scale content production globally without compromising on quality or brand consistency.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Retouch and enhance automotive imagery, ensuring vehicles look lifelike, polished, and consistent with client brand aesthetics.

  • Seamlessly integrate CGI renders with photographed backplates and environments to create cohesive, high-quality visuals.

  • Refine reflections, materials, and lighting - from bodywork highlights and chrome details to interior textures and glass surfaces.

  • Execute precise color grading, shadow work, and perspective matching to ensure accurate visual integration.

  • Collaborate closely with our CGI, lighting, and post-production teams to maintain a unified creative and technical vision.

  • Follow our standardized Photoshop file structure and naming conventions for efficient collaboration across projects.

Would be amazing if you have:

  • Proven experience as an Automotive Retoucher, ideally within advertising, CGI, or visualization studios.

  • Expert-level Photoshop skills, with an eye for realism and detail.

  • Deep understanding of lighting, reflections, materials, and automotive surfaces — from paint to metal, glass, and interiors.

  • Ability to balance artistic quality with production efficiency.

  • Excellent sense of composition, depth, and realism.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a creative production pipeline.

  • Fluency in English.

The Procedure

Please send your resume and portfolio in English via the link provided. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact our Recruitment Department at jobs@indg.com.

After reviewing your application, if there’s a potential fit, a member of our recruitment team will be in touch with you.

INDG Grip handles and uses personal data of job applicants in line with its Recruitment Privacy Policy.

title: Product Manager
description:
Role summary

The product manager is responsible for maximizing the value of the product by owning and managing the product vision, roadmap, backlog, and lifecycle activities. The role acts as the bridge between business stakeholders, customers, engineering, implementation teams, and sales teams to ensure successful product delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement. The product manager ensures that the product evolves according to customer needs, business priorities, and market demands while supporting internal teams through training, enablement, and product expertise.

Responsibilities

Product Vision Strategy

  • Contribute to product vision in light of company strategy, goals and priorities.

  • Translate business objectives and customer needs into actionable product initiative.

  • Contribute and track product roadmap planning and prioritization.

  • Ensure alignment between product strategy and company objectives.

  • Monitor market trends, customer feedback, and competitor developments to identify opportunities for product improvement.

Product Roadmap and Backlog Management

  • Own the intake, assessment, and triage process for product improvements and new feature requests.

  • Assess business impact, urgency, customer value, and technical feasibility.

  • Own and manage the product backlog and ensure backlog items are clearly defined and ready for development.

  • Collect and analyze business and customer requirements according to product goals.

  • Prioritize enhancements, bug fixes, technical improvements, and new features based on business value and impact. Maintain transparency regarding prioritization.

  • Create and maintain user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.

Development Collaboration

  • Act as the primary contact between business stakeholders and development teams.

  • Participate actively in sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Clarify requirements and provide functional guidance during development.

  • Validate delivered functionality and ensure acceptance criteria are met.

Product Lifecycle Ownership

  • Take ownership of the full product lifecycle from ideation through release, adoption, maintenance, and continuous improvement.

  • Coordinate cross-functional activities required for successful product releases.

  • Ensure product documentation, release notes, and communication materials are maintained.

  • Support product rollout and change management activities.

  • Monitor product performance, adoption, and operational effectiveness after release.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as a functional product expert for implementation teams. Provide guidance on product capabilities and business processes to both implementation and (pre)sales teams.

  • Participate in customer demonstrations, workshops, and solution discussions when needed.

  • Develop and deliver product training sessions for internal teams and customers.

  • Ensure internal stakeholders understand new features, releases, and product changes.

  • Create and maintain training materials, knowledge base articles, and user documentation.

  • Promote product knowledge sharing and best practices across teams.

  • Ensure sales teams are informed about product capabilities, roadmap updates, and key differentiators.

  • Support solution design discussions during customer implementations.

  • Collaborate with implementation teams to identify recurring customer challenges and improvement opportunities.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum product ownership practices.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to translate business needs into functional requirements.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Experience managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams.

  • Customer-focused mindset with strong business understanding.

  • Experience with product lifecycle management and backlog prioritization.

  • Strong presentation and training skills.

Success Measures

The product manager will be evaluated based on:

  • Product delivery quality and timeliness

  • Stakeholder and customer satisfaction

  • Backlog quality and prioritization effectiveness

  • Adoption and success of new product features

  • Support effectiveness for implementation and sales teams

  • Quality of product training and internal enablement

  • Continuous improvement and innovation contributions

Who you are and beyond:

  • Educational Background:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.

    • PMP, PRINCE2, or similar project management certification is highly desirable.

  • Professional Experience:

    • Minimum of 5 years of experience in project management, preferably within the SaaS or TMS industries.

    • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex software implementation projects on time and within budget.

    • Experience working in a product-driven environment, with a strong understanding of software development and integration best practices.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Strong understanding of TMS platforms and their applications in various industries.

    • Experience with API integration and standardization, particularly with systems such as WMS, ERP, Visibility Providers, and Customs Solutions.

    • Proficiency in project management tools (e.g. Jira, Asana, Rocketlane) and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).

  • Soft Skills:

    • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.

    • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively.

    • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment

Our hiring process

  1. Hit Apply button

  2. Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview

  3. Create a win-win: learn more about each other from multiple interviews

  4. Receive our job offer and prepare for your exciting journey with Bluerock TMS!


Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

Menopause is a new area of the business that we’re all incredibly excited about. Our Menopause category operates under the brand Menopause Care - led by the founder Dr Naomi Potter. Dr Potter has built a strong organic brand which we want to develop with this service.

We’re looking for a driven individual to join our female health team as Operations Associate in Patient Care. We are looking for someone passionate about the category and ready to tackle the toughest problems in patient services and operations to support women on their menopausal journey.

We want to provide the best service to women going through this journey - and we need a proactive individual ready to dive into the front line of patient care. The role has dual functionality - we need someone ready to switch between answering queries from patients to working on dedicated operational projects to enhance the patient experience. You’ll be on the front line speaking to our patients and working cross functionality with the rest of the menopause team to build operational improvements. You are someone excited to work in a fast-paced environment, can stay calm under pressure, and does not shy away from problem solving in ambiguous environments.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Taking a nimble approach to problem solving, ready to help patients and team members with a variety of questions when they get in touch

  • Identify key friction points in our processes and develop creative solutions to address them

  • Coordinate process improvements with other areas of the business and keep stakeholders informed on the impact

  • Skilled Communicator - You're good at explaining things to people in written or verbal communication and you are thoughtful in all of your interactions

  • Highly Organised - You know how to stay on top of moving parts and can jump from speaking with a patient on the phone to getting to the bottom of a missing order

title: GZ-psycholoog Jonge Kind
description:
Dé plek waar je nooit alleen voor een casus staat.

Functieomschrijving

Als GZ-psycholoog (of Orthopedagoog-generalist) bij ’t Kabouterhuis ben je de eindverantwoordelijke behandelaar in de casus. Dat betekent niet dat je alles zelf doet, maar wel dat jij degene bent die de grote lijn bewaakt.

Je bent aanwezig bij intakes, je doet deelonderzoeken en je voert behandelingen uit. Terwijl collega’s hun deelonderzoeken doen, breng jij alle puzzelstukjes samen tot één helder verhaal. Jij ziet wat er écht speelt, vertaalt dat naar een duidelijk advies en brengt het geheel terug tot één helder verhaal voor het gezin. De verhouding in je werk is ongeveer 50% regievoering en 50% cliëntcontact (zoals EMDR-behandelingen, ouder-kindbehandeling, Floorplay, PRT, systeembegeleiding of Theraplay, afhankelijk van jouw expertise).

Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor jouw team. Soms komt iemand uit een intens huisbezoek en heeft diegene jou gewoon even nodig om te sparren, te landen of richting te krijgen. Jij bent bereikbaar, toegankelijk en schakelt snel wanneer het moet.

Elke casus bij ’t Kabouterhuis valt of staat met een sterke regiebehandelaar. Je bent de ruggengraat van het behandelproces en met jouw overzicht weten collega’s precies wat te doen, waarom en hoe.

Wij zoeken op dit moment naar een GZ-psycholoog (of Orthopedagoog-Generalist) op de volgende locaties (klik op de links voor meer informatie over de locaties):

  • Amsterdam Noord

  • Amsterdam Zuid

  • Amsterdam Zuidoost

  • Amsterdam West

  • Hoofddorp


In het sollicitatieformulier geef je de locatie van jouw voorkeur aan. In het sollicitatieproces kijken we naar de locatie waar jij het beste tot je recht komt. Werken op meerdere locaties is ook bespreekbaar, we vinden het fijn als jij flexibel bent. Uren en werkdagen zijn in overleg.

Bij ’t Kabouterhuis hebben we allemaal dezelfde drijfveer: het jonge kind en hun ouders. Begeleiden in die eerste kwetsbare stappen maakt ons werk zo waardevol. Dat is waarom we dit doen.

Onze teams zijn bevlogen, multidisciplinair en staan altijd naast elkaar én naast ouders. Samenwerken is bij ons niet slechts een lege term, maar onderdeel van hoe we elke dag met elkaar werken. Dat maakt dat mensen jarenlang bij ’t Kabouterhuis blijven werken. Je komt terecht in een warme, betrokken groep professionals waar gelijkwaardigheid de standaard is en je altijd kunt terugvallen op collega’s.

Je hebt

  • Ervaring als GZ-psycholoog of Orthopedagoog-Generalist en bent BIG-geregistreerd

  • Ervaring met het jonge kind en complexe gezinssystemen

  • Een “can-do mentaliteit”: je houdt van puzzelen, zoeken en het soms niet weten

  • Een sterke motivatie voor de doelgroep, zelfreflectie en een oprechte interesse in jonge kinderen én hun ouders

  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren van EMDR-behandelingen (pre)

  • Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (verplicht)

Wat je bij ons krijgt

  • Een salaris volgens CAO Jeugdzorg schaal 12 (€4.375,20 - € 6.885,58 bruto p/m)

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%

  • Volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten en een fietsplan

  • Leren en ontwikkelen in ons eigen opleidingsinstituut: De Jonge Kind Academie

  • Een bevlogen team dat altijd naast je staat

  • Werken met een unieke en kwetsbare doelgroep binnen een multidisciplinair team

De doelgroep - wat ons werk het mooiste werk maakt!

Het hele jonge kind, daar moet je echt voor willen gaan. Je werkt met gezinnen die erg kwetsbaar zijn en veel meemaken. Met alle disciplines samen puzzel je aan het totaalbeeld: wat speelt er écht? En wat hebben dit jonge kind en de directe omgeving nodig? Dat maakt het werk uitdagend, verdiepend en ontzettend betekenisvol.

De Infant Mental Health (IMH) visie vormt het uitgangspunt van hoe wij werken, samenwerken en behandelen. Vanuit die visie blijven we leren en ons samen ontwikkelen. We zien het jonge kind altijd in de context waarin het opgroeit: de relatie met ouders, het netwerk en de omgeving. Dat vraagt om een systemische blik, een open houding en veel kennis van ontwikkeling, hechting en regulatie.

Klaar om samen het verschil te maken voor het jonge kind?

Stuur je sollicitatie in, we ontmoeten je graag.

Heb je vooraf nog vragen? Neem contact op met Ruth Tolhuijs (recruiter) via 0657646551 of mail naar recruitment@kabouterhuis.nl.

Wat je kunt verwachten als je op de sollicitatie knop hebt gedrukt:

Je krijgt binnen een week reactie van ons team, daarna volgt een 1e gesprek en eventueel een 2e gesprek (bijvoorbeeld een meeloopdag). We checken je referentie (verplicht) en als we beiden enthousiast zijn doen we je een aanbod. We verwelkomen je graag in ons team.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
Build the AI environments that organizations can actually use

Many AI roles stop at a model, an experiment, or a demo. At ITQ, the work actually begins after that. We build the environments in which AI can run securely, scalably, and manageably. Not isolated proof-of-concepts, but mature AI platforms for organizations that take their data, security, and continuity seriously. Think of environments for LLMs, model training, inference, and governance, designed for production.

Organization

At ITQ, we’re building an AI capability that’s growing rapidly and becoming increasingly sophisticated. We combine technologies like OpenShift AI, SUSE AI, and VMware Private AI Services into a single Private AI approach, with a focus on sovereignty, governance, and operational control.

You’re joining at a time when AI is still in full flux, so you’ll not only be contributing but also helping to shape how we move forward—in terms of content, technology, and as a team.

The Role

As an AI Platform Engineer, you’ll work on the technical foundation for serious AI applications. You won’t be working on a single model, use case, or internal product. Instead, you’ll build diverse AI environments across multiple sectors, each with unique requirements for security, compliance, scalability, and governance. You’ll ensure that AI doesn’t remain stuck at the idea stage but is implemented in environments ready for real-world use.

You design, build, and manage infrastructure for AI and machine learning workloads. You work on Kubernetes-based environments for training, deployment, runtime, and operations. In doing so, you use tools such as Kubeflow, MLflow, and ClearML, and work with platforms such as OpenShift AI, SUSE AI, and VMware Private AI Services.

You’ll work for clients in sectors including government, healthcare, telecom, transportation, and financial services. Sometimes you’ll build a new AI environment from the ground up. Sometimes you’ll improve an existing landscape. Sometimes you’ll ensure that AI tools can be used safely and in a controlled manner within the boundaries of a complex organization. The core remains the same: you make AI workable in production.

Examples of projects you can actually build:

  • For a leading satellite manufacturer in Belgium, we designed and implemented an enterprise Kubernetes platform on vSphere, built on the CNCF open-source stack as a governed foundation for GPU-accelerated AI and ML workloads. Using tools such as Harbor, FluxCD, OPA Gatekeeper, NVIDIA GPU Operator, and NVIDIA AI Enterprise, we made training and inference pipelines production-ready.

  • For a national public transportation organization, we built a sovereign AI platform on internal Kubernetes, featuring an Agent and MCP Gateway, JWT and CEL-based RBAC, an MCP Registry, and a custom governance UI. This allowed engineers to work with approved AI tools without taking data outside the organization.

What do you bring to the table?

You have a strong interest in AI and want to help build the environments where AI can actually be used. Perhaps you come from a background in platform engineering, Kubernetes, or cloud-native infrastructure and want to shift your focus more toward AI. Or maybe you already have experience with AI platforms or MLOps. It’s important that you have a solid grasp of the technical fundamentals:

  • Kubernetes and container orchestration, including deployment, troubleshooting, and day-2 operations

  • Linux and cloud-native fundamentals such as networking, storage, and security

  • An IaC mindset, with experience in Ansible, Terraform, and GitOps tooling

  • A genuine curiosity about how models are served, scaled, and monitored

  • The ability to work independently in client environments while contributing to a growing AI practice

Knowledge of ML or MLOps, experience with model training and fine-tuning, and experience with RAG, LLM serving, agentic frameworks, or GPU infrastructure are a plus.

What you’ll get

You’ll join a growing team where AI is truly a strategic focus. You’ll work on concrete AI projects across multiple sectors and have ample opportunity to develop your expertise.

You can count on a robust onboarding program, challenging projects, access to the AI Lab, a Claude subscription, opportunities for certification and professional development, a competitive salary, excellent benefits, and a hybrid work model based on ITQ.

Ready for What’s Next?

Do you want to build AI environments that not only sound smart, but are also truly usable, secure, and scalable?

Then we’d love to get to know you. And let’s show you what’s already up and running, what we’re building now, and where you’ll fit in.

title: Project Manager
description:
We like passionate people

At ITQ, we work with people who are deeply passionate about technology, and that passion drives both our success and our culture. We help organizations unlock the full potential of their IT infrastructure, from cloud and modern workplace solutions to virtualization, security, and digital transformation.

Being part of ITQ means more than working on cutting-edge technology: It means joining the ITQ-force, a collective of specialists who share knowledge, collaborate closely, and continuously learn. Here, your technical skills matter, your ideas are valued, and your passion is the fuel for growth, both for yourself and for our clients.

About the role:

As a Project Manager / Senior Project Manager (m/f/d) at ITQ, you will be responsible for challenging cloud and infrastructure projects. You will coordinate internal and external delivery teams, work closely with technology partners such as VMware, IBM, RedHat, AWS, and Microsoft, and ensure that projects are implemented in a structured, efficient, and high-quality manner.

Your core activities will include:

  • Management and control of customer projects in the areas of digitalization, automation, and process optimization.

  • Coordination of interdisciplinary teams (consulting, engineering, IT, partner companies) and close coordination with customers and stakeholders.

  • Structuring and monitoring of project processes, including schedule, budget, and quality control.

  • Communication with customers at the management and departmental level, ensuring transparency and goal orientation.

  • Risk management and reporting: Early identification of challenges, derivation of countermeasures, and preparation of status reports.

  • Support in the further development of project management methods and standards within the ITQ Group.

Who you are

  • You have a completed degree in engineering, computer science, business informatics, or comparable qualification.

  • Several years of professional experience in project management or consulting, ideally in technology-driven environments.

  • Structural, analytical, and solution-oriented approach to work with a high degree of personal responsibility.

  • Quick comprehension and ability to grasp complex issues rapidly and translate them into practical measures.

  • Confident manner and strong communication skills at all hierarchical levels.

  • Experience with classic and agile project management methods.

  • Certifications such as PRINCE2, ITIL4, PMI PMP, IPMA, Scrum Master, or comparable qualifications are desirable.

  • Very good written and spoken German and English skills.

Working at ITQ offers some awesome perks

  • Exciting consulting and implementation projects

  • Collaboration with leading industrial companies and innovative technology partners.

  • Flexible working, flat hierarchies, and an open, team-oriented corporate culture.

  • Individual development through training, certifications, and coaching programs.

  • A dynamic environment with the opportunity to actively shape the future of industrial digitalization.

Interested?

Then join ITQ and accompany our customers on their journey to digital transformation!

title: HBO Meewerkstage HRM
description:
Wat houdt de stageopdracht in?

Binnen KCD werken we vanuit onze kernwaarden: verbinden, werkplezier en dynamisch. Deze waarden vormen ook de basis van ons functiehuis, waarin functies helder en toekomstgericht zijn beschreven. Om dit functiehuis actueel en compleet te houden, is het belangrijk om nieuwe functies goed te documenteren en bestaande omschrijvingen te toetsen op relevantie. De functieomschrijvingen worden gekoppeld aan competenties welke een onderdeel zijn van onze beoordelingscyclus. Een functiehuis op orde houden is hierbij van groot belang. Daarnaast werk je mee op de HR afdeling met de HR Business Partners en HR administratie en mag je meekijken bij andere HR afdelingen zoals Recruitment, Verzuim en Learning & Development.

Hoe pak je de opdracht aan?

Stap 1: Inventarisatie van de huidige situatie

· Verzamel alle bestaande functieomschrijvingen binnen de organisatie.

· Analyseer in hoeverre deze aansluiten bij het functiehuis en de kernwaarden van KCD.

· Breng in kaart welke functies ontbreken of verouderd zijn.

Stap 2: Ontwikkeling van de gewenste situatie

· In overleg met HR en teamleiders inventariseer je welke nieuwe functies zijn ontstaan of gaan ontstaan.

· Voor functies zonder bestaande omschrijving stel je nieuwe functieomschrijvingen op, passend binnen het functiehuis en afgestemd op de KCD-kernwaarden.

· Je verwerkt input van betrokkenen en zorgt voor een gedragen eindversie.

Wat zien wij graag in jou?

· Meewerken op operationeel niveau binnen het HR werkveld.

· Een compleet overzicht van alle bestaande functieomschrijvingen en hun status.

· Een lijst van nieuwe of gewijzigde functies met actuele omschrijving.

· Donderdag is een vaste werkdag op kantoor met de HR afdeling.

Wat krijg je ervoor terug?

· Dynamische werkomgeving waarin je ruimte krijgt om te leren en te ontwikkelen.

· Een stagevergoeding van € 500,- bruto op basis van een 40 urige werkweek.

· Om een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé te behouden, kennen wij flexibele werktijden en flexibele werkplekken. Zo is er ook de mogelijkheid om vanuit huis te werken, waarbij jij een thuiswerkvergoeding krijgt.

· Bedrijfsmiddelen zoals laptop, scherm, toetsenbord, headset, muis e.d.

· Reiskostenvergoeding wanneer je naar kantoor komt

Waar kom je te werken?

Klant Contact Diensten (KCD) is dé specialist in klantcontact voor bekende labels zoals Centraal Beheer, FBTO, Interpolis, Independer en Zilveren Kruis. Wij zorgen ervoor dat klanten snel en goed geholpen worden met hun vragen over verzekeringen. Dat doen we samen met honderden klantenservicemedewerkers die wij begeleiden, ondersteunen en opleiden. Hoewel we onderdeel zijn van Achmea, hebben we bij KCD een eigen identiteit waar we trots op zijn. We zijn een hecht team met een informele sfeer, waar samenwerken en humor centraal staan. Je komt terecht in ons HR-team: een betrokken en professioneel team dat altijd voor elkaar klaarstaat. Hier krijg je de kans om écht mee te draaien, te leren van ervaren collega’s en bij te dragen aan projecten die impact maken.

Meer weten?

Ben jij enthousiast geworden over deze stage bij KCD? Solliciteer dan direct en stuur vóór 15 september 2026 een mail met jouw CV en motivatiebrief naar hr@klantcontactdiensten.nl. Mocht je vragen hebben, kan je contact opnemen met wellicht een van jouw toekomstige collega’s Marije Evertzen (marije.evertzen@klantcontactdiensten.nl), Wendy Hildebrand (wendy.hildebrand@klantcontactdiensten.nl) of Charell Vos (charell.vos@klantcontactdiensten.nl).

Primary Location: Remote (must reside in NY or WDC)
Position Type: Full Time

Overview

Our client, a leading law firm, is seeking a Senior IT Project Manager to join their Enterprise Content Management Systems team. This role is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive project plans for key technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives and successful project delivery. The Senior IT Project Manager will collaborate closely with both business and IT stakeholders to define goals, track progress, and deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

In this capacity, the Senior IT Project Manager will:

  • Manage projects in accordance with the firm’s established SDLC process, ensuring proper creation and delivery of SDLC deliverables and leading planning for SRB stage gate reviews.

  • Oversee a portfolio of projects across various business areas and systems, driving multiple workstreams concurrently.

  • Partner with IT leadership to understand project sequencing, identify dependencies, and ensure timely execution.

  • Develop project plans, manage sprints, and track tasks, budgets, status reports, and key project artifacts.

  • Deliver effective reporting for senior leadership on project status, risks, issues, and budget adherence.

  • Manage the intake, tracking, and prioritization of new work requests.

  • Collaborate with IT and business teams to coordinate work, remove blockers, and maintain consistent progress.

  • Demonstrate responsiveness and clear communication with leadership and stakeholders.

What You Bring to the Role

  • Advanced knowledge of project management tools such as Atlassian Confluence and JIRA.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to navigate challenges to drive consistent progress.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams effectively and efficiently.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.

  • Highly collaborative and customer-focused approach to project delivery.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (preferred).

  • Experience managing large, complex projects within a professional services or legal industry environment.

  • 10+ years of experience in a project management role (preferred).

  • 7+ years of executive-level engagement and customer service (required).

  • 7+ years of information technology experience (required).

title: Product Director
description:
About AnywhereNow

Founded in 2010 in The Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued. With around 240 employees working from 22 different countries, we partner with over 2,000 leading enterprises, including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town, to deliver exceptional customer experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven insights.

Our commitment to innovation, customer focus, and accountability drives our success. Our portfolio includes Dialogue Cloud, Deepdesk (AI Agent Assist), Tendfor and Deepdesk delivering cutting-edge capabilities across Microsoft Teams environments and enterprise CX platforms.

Position Summary

The Product Director - CCaaS owns the product vision, strategy, and execution for our cloud contact centre portfolio. You'll drive product innovation, revenue growth, and competitive differentiation in a rapidly evolving SaaS market by combining strategic leadership, deep domain expertise, and hands-on execution.

You'll lead cross-functional teams across engineering, commercial, and customer-facing functions to deliver scalable, AI-driven, omnichannel solutions that measurably impact customer outcomes across the full lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

• Define and own the CCaaS product vision, aligned with company strategy and market positioning

• Translate market trends (AI, omnichannel, Teams integration, automation) into product direction

• Drive portfolio-level decisions (build / buy / partner)

Market, Customer & Competitive Intelligence

• Conduct continuous market sensing to identify opportunities and threats

• Engage directly with enterprise customers, partners, and analysts

• Ensure roadmap reflects strong differentiation against key CCaaS competitors

Product Roadmap & Execution

• Own prioritisation across capabilities (routing, AI, reporting, integrations)

• Balance innovation with technical debt, scalability, and platform evolution

• Drive consistent delivery through agile models and cross-functional alignment

Commercialisation & Growth

• Define pricing, packaging, and monetisation strategy (e.g., seat vs usage-based models)

• Enable sales, partners, and marketing with positioning and enablement

• Drive product-led growth, expansion use cases, and customer adoption

Customer Value & Lifecycle Ownership

• Ensure products deliver measurable business outcomes (CX improvement, efficiency, AI adoption)

• Embed customer lifecycle thinking across onboarding, adoption, expansion, and retention

• Use product usage data to reduce churn and increase NRR

Cross-functional Leadership

• Lead and align Product Managers, UX, Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams

• Bridge technology and business stakeholders

• Influence executive-level decisions on portfolio direction

Operational Excellence

• Establish and own KPIs (ARR contribution, adoption, feature usage, NPS)

• Own product P&L or business case performance

• Drive data-driven decision-making across roadmap and investments

Core Competencies

SaaS & Commercial Acumen

• Strong grasp of SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, CAC, cost-to-serve)

• Ability to translate product investments into financial outcomes

• Expertise in pricing and packaging strategies

CCaaS & Domain Expertise

• Deep understanding of CCaaS architecture (routing, omnichannel, WEM, AI, integrations)

• Knowledge of enterprise customer service operations and workflows

• Awareness of ecosystem players (UCaaS, CRM, CPaaS, AI vendors)

Strategic Thinking & Leadership

• Ability to define long-term vision while delivering incremental value

• Strong prioritisation and trade-off decision-making

• Experience managing complex product portfolios

Customer-Centric Mindset

• Focus on delivering customer outcomes, not just features

• Strong voice-of-customer integration into product decisions

• Ability to translate customer needs into scalable solutions

Data-Driven Decision Making

• Uses qualitative and quantitative insights to guide product direction

• Comfortable with product analytics, usage data, and financial modelling

• Drives experimentation (pilots, A/B testing, feature validation)

Stakeholder & Influencing Skills

• Excellent communication across executive, technical, and commercial audiences

• Ability to align diverse stakeholders and manage competing priorities

• Strong external presence with customers, partners, and analysts

Leadership & Execution

• Proven leadership in cross-functional teams

• Strong delivery mindset with accountability for outcomes

• Ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels

Experience & Profile

• 10+ years in product management within SaaS or CCaaS

• Proven experience in a CCaaS vendor or closely related domain (critical for rapid impact)

• Experience leading teams and influencing large-scale product organisations

• Strong understanding of enterprise ecosystems (Microsoft, CRM, AI platforms preferred)

• Technical fluency (cloud platforms, APIs, integrations) combined with commercial mindset

Success Indicators (First 12-24 Months)

• Clear, differentiated CCaaS product strategy established

• Improved win rates and competitive positioning

• Strong product adoption and measurable NRR impact

• Accelerated delivery of key innovation areas (AI, omnichannel, automation)

• Improved cross-functional alignment and execution speed

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation's information security standards. This includes:

• Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures, and guidelines at all times

• Protecting company, customer, and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or loss

• Using company systems, devices, and networks in a secure and compliant manner

• Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches, or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team

• Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required

• Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

title: Digital Workspace Consultant
description:
Ben jij een gepassioneerde End-User Computing (EUC) Specialist en op zoek naar een uitdagende functie? Bij ITQ krijg je de kans om innovatieve digitale werkplekoplossingen te ontwikkelen voor onze klanten. Je werkt met technologieën zoals Omnissa Horizon, Workspace ONE, Microsoft Intune en AVD. In deze rol analyseer je klantbehoeften, vertaal je deze naar concrete adviezen en implementeer je effectieve EUC-oplossingen.

Bij ITQ geloven we dat passie de drijvende kracht is achter succes. Daarom zoeken we iemand zoals jij - iemand die gedreven is om te leren, te groeien, en die elke dag het verschil wil maken in de snel veranderende wereld van IT. Zoals de Team Manager goed zei; “Skills kan je leren maar mentaliteit maakt het verschil.”

Klinkt dat als een kans die je niet wil missen? Solliciteer dan nu!

Jouw rol bij ITQ:

Je zal nauw samen werken met onze klanten om hun unieke behoeften en uitdagingen te begrijpen en ontwerpt en implementeert vervolgens innovatieve oplossingen met behulp van de nieuwste technologieën.

Van virtuele desktops tot het beheer van mobiele apparaten, jij bent de expert bij uitstek voor alles wat met digitale werkplekken te maken heeft. Met een goed begrip van digitale werkruimtetechnologieën, uitstekende probleemoplossende vaardigheden en het vermogen om complexe technische concepten over te brengen aan niet-technische belanghebbenden, ben je perfect uitgerust voor deze rol.

Daarnaast biedt ITQ een dynamische omgeving waarin kennisdeling en continue ontwikkeling centraal staan. We ondersteunen je groei door het stimuleren van certificeringen en bieden een gezellige werksfeer waarin jouw bijdrage wordt gewaardeerd. Kom met ons in gesprek en ontdek jouw mogelijkheden bij ITQ!

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwerpen en implementeren: Je begeleidt klanten bij proof of concepts en bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en implementeren van digitale werkomgevingen.

  • Technische presales: Je ondersteunt onze salescollega’s in het technische presalestraject en helpt nieuwe klanten door hun wensen om te zetten in concrete oplossingen.

  • Community bijdrage: Of het nu vanuit huis is, op events of in onze eigen ITQ-studio, jij draagt bij aan de EUC-community.

  • Samenwerking: Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s die net zo gepassioneerd zijn over EUC als jij en zet samen de schouders onder uitdagende projecten.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een sterke basis in End-User Computing en ervaring met Omnissa Horizon, Workspace ONE, Microsoft Intune of AVD.

  • Het vermogen om inzichten uit oplossingen zoals Liquidware Stratusphere of Login Enterprise te vertalen naar concrete adviezen.

  • Een proactieve houding en de drive om continu te leren en te groeien.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een teamgerichte mentaliteit.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een warm welkom: Een uitgebreid onboardingprogramma, een welkomstpakket en een fijne start met je nieuwe collega’s.

  • Uitdagende projecten: Werk aan innovatieve projecten en ontwikkel jezelf met de technologieën die jou interesseren.

  • Certificeringsmogelijkheden: Volg en behaal specifieke cursussen en certificeringen met onze ondersteuning.

  • Kennisdeling: Neem deel aan interne en externe evenementen om kennis te delen en te leren van collega’s.

Over ITQ
Bij ITQ werken we samen, leren we van elkaar en staan we open voor een goed gesprek – soms gecombineerd met een barbecue en een goed glas wijn. We vertrouwen elkaar, bieden vrijheid en hechten waarde aan open en eerlijke communicatie. Of je nu thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant werkt, als ITQ’er voel je je altijd verbonden.

Klaar om deel uit te maken van ons team?
Ben jij enthousiast over deze functie? Wil je samenwerken aan betekenisvolle projecten en plezier hebben in je werk? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou!
