title: Gezinsbegeleider (Jeugdzorgwerker B, mobiel team)
description:
Altijd al willen werken op verschillende locaties, precies waar je nodig bent?

Functieomschrijving

Binnen ’t Kabouterhuis werken we op negen locaties met wisselende werkdruk. Om kinderen en ouders altijd passende zorg te bieden, werken we met een mobiel behandelteam dat wordt ingezet waar extra ondersteuning nodig is.

Als Jeugdzorgwerker B (gezinsbegeleider) werk je in dit team voor 24 uur per week en begeleid je gezinnen met jonge kinderen (-9 maanden tot 7 jaar) op verschillende locaties en in de thuissituatie. Je helpt ouders om beter om te gaan met de problematiek van hun kind en versterkt de relatie tussen ouder en kind.

Je observeert, analyseert en begeleidt gezinnen, zowel thuis als op locatie. Je kijkt wat er speelt binnen het gezin en vertaalt dit naar praktische handvatten waar ouders direct mee aan de slag kunnen.

Je wordt ingezet bij teams waar extra ondersteuning nodig is. Dat kan bijvoorbeeld zijn wanneer de werkdruk oploopt, wachtlijsten teruggebracht moeten worden of wanneer je tijdelijk een collega vervangt, zoals tijdens een zwangerschapsverlof. Je stapt in, kijkt naar wat er nodig is en helpt om de begeleiding weer goed neer te zetten, voor het gezin en voor het team.

Je hebt een belangrijk aandeel in de gezinsdiagnostiek en stemt in complexe situaties af met de regiebehandelaar, op wie je kunt terugvallen.

Je werkt steeds met andere gezinnen, collega’s en locaties. Dat vraagt dat je flexibel bent en je makkelijk aanpast. Juist daarin maak jij het verschil.

Bij ’t Kabouterhuis hebben we allemaal dezelfde drijfveer: het jonge kind en hun ouders. Begeleiden in die eerste kwetsbare stappen maakt ons werk zo waardevol. Dat is waarom we dit doen.

Onze teams zijn bevlogen, multidisciplinair en staan altijd naast elkaar én naast ouders. Samenwerken is bij ons niet slechts een lege term, maar onderdeel van hoe we elke dag met elkaar werken. Dat maakt dat mensen jarenlang bij ’t Kabouterhuis blijven werken. Je komt terecht in een warme, betrokken groep professionals waar gelijkwaardigheid de standaard is en je altijd kunt terugvallen op collega’s.

Je hebt:

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding (MWD, Social Work, Pedagogiek) of wo-opleiding

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met complexe gezinssituaties en/of psychiatrische problematiek

  • Ervaring met behandelingsgericht werken met ouders en jonge kinderen

  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie (of je kunt deze voor start regelen)

  • Kennis van ontwikkeling en psychopathologie bij jonge kinderen

  • Bereidheid om VHT-certificering te behalen (of in bezit)

Wat je bij ons krijgt

  • Salaris volgens CAO Jeugdzorg schaal 9 (€ 3.191,69 - € 4.766,96 p/m bij fulltime)

  • Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%

  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 24 uur per week voor een jaar met uitzicht op verlenging voor onbepaalde tijd.

  • Volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten en een fietsenplan

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden via De Jonge Kind Academie

  • Werken in een multidisciplinair team met een bijzondere doelgroep

  • Een dienstverband voor een jaar met mogelijkheid tot verlenging

De doelgroep – wat ons werk het mooiste werk maakt

Het hele jonge kind, daar moet je echt voor willen gaan. Je werkt met gezinnen die erg kwetsbaar zijn en veel meemaken. Met alle disciplines samen puzzel je aan het totaalbeeld: wat speelt er écht? En wat hebben dit jonge kind en de directe omgeving nodig? Dat maakt het werk uitdagend, verdiepend en ontzettend betekenisvol.

De Infant Mental Health (IMH) visie vormt het uitgangspunt van hoe wij werken, samenwerken en behandelen. Vanuit die visie blijven we leren en ons samen ontwikkelen. We zien het jonge kind altijd in de context waarin het opgroeit: de relatie met ouders, het netwerk en de omgeving. Dat vraagt om een systemische blik, een open houding en veel kennis van ontwikkeling, hechting en regulatie.

Klaar om samen het verschil te maken voor het jonge kind?

Stuur je sollicitatie in of neem contact op voor meer informatie.

We ontmoeten je graag.

Wat je kunt verwachten als je op de sollicitatie knop hebt gedrukt:

Je krijgt binnen 3 dagen reactie van ons team, daarna volgt een 1e gesprek en eventueel een 2e gesprek (bijvoorbeeld een meeloopdag). We checken je referentie (verplicht) en als we beiden enthousiast zijn doen we je een aanbod. We verwelkomen je graag in ons team.

title: Working Student - Logistics (f/m/d)
description:
At Instagrid, you are part of the clean-tech revolution by bringing pure energy into your region, helping professional workers transitioning away from combustion generators and making it possible for them to experience a safe, efficient, clean and silent energy solution.

Your Mission

Instagrid ships hardware — globally, at volume, to customers who expect their orders to arrive on time and on spec. As a Working Student in Logistics, you keep that promise. You are the operational backbone of our internal shipping area: handling incoming and outgoing goods, managing documentation, coordinating carriers, and serving as the link between physical goods movement and the Sales and Customer Management teams who need accurate, real-time information to do their jobs.

This is an on-site role in Ludwigsburg. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Operations team — expect to spend real time on the warehouse floor, not behind a screen.

Your Impact

  • Incoming goods: Receive and verify deliveries against purchase orders, create item receipts in NetSuite, and flag discrepancies without delay

  • Outgoing goods: Pick, pack, and dispatch finished goods and spare parts accurately and on time, in line with customer orders and internal shipping requests

  • Carrier management: Select the right carrier and service level for each shipment, book collections, and keep carrier accounts and documentation up to date

  • Order fulfilment: Coordinate daily with our external warehouse partner to ensure all market demands are serviced without gaps

  • Returns processing: Unpack, inspect, and document customer returns; hand over items to quality or repair workflows with full traceability

  • Shipping documentation: Produce commercial invoices, packing lists, and delivery notes accurately and in a timely manner

  • Tracking and visibility: Keep Sales and Customer Management proactively informed on shipment status, resolve carrier exceptions early, and escalate delays before they reach the customer

  • Warehouse housekeeping: Maintain clean, labelled, and accurately stocked storage locations in line with our ERP records

  • Currently enrolled in logistics, supply chain management, business administration, or a related degree program

  • Reliable and committed to showing up — this is a fixed on-site role that requires consistent coordination around your university timetable

  • Precise and structured in everything you do: in logistics, a documentation error is not a minor mistake — it has consequences, and you know that

  • A proactive communicator who raises issues and shares updates without needing to be prompted

  • Confident using digital tools: ERP systems, carrier portals, and spreadsheets are part of your daily workflow

  • Fluent in German and English — both are essential for working with carriers, partners, and customers

Your Benefits

  • Real responsibility from day one — not busywork, but genuine ownership of live shipping operations

  • End-to-end exposure: from goods receipt and carrier selection through order fulfilment to returns and customer visibility

  • A lean, hands-on team that gives direct feedback and expects you to speak up when something isn't right

  • An inside view of what it takes to scale a hardware company — across operations, supply chain, and beyond

  • Flexible working hours coordinated around your university schedule

  • Generous holiday entitlement plus additional special leave days, on a pro-rata basis

This is Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact. Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning.

At Instagrid, we are deeply committed to equal employment opportunities as we believe in the power of diverse teams. We do not just accept diversity but actively search for the best talent regardless of gender, ethnic origin, age, religion, sexual orientation or place of origin. Working as a team, we treat each other with respect and value each other’s opinions to achieve our common goals.

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

title: .NET Developer (Senior)
description:
Je vindt hier een korte omschrijving van deze vacature. Nog vragen? Of benieuwd of dit een passende rol voor jou is? Neem contact met ons op!


Als Senior .NET developer werk je voor en met klanten aan innovatieve projecten. Jij bent de strategische sparringspartner voor de klant en weet hun vraagstuk om te zetten in een technische oplossing. Jij leidt jouw team door het project heen. Met jouw ervaring en kennis ben je ook een vraagbaak en buddy voor minder ervaren collega's. Je deelt jouw kennis door handleidingen op te stellen of workshops te geven, om zo de kennis van het gehele bedrijf te optimaliseren. Ook help je bij het aannemen van nieuwe collega's.

Dit bedrijf creëert platforms, software en applicaties en helpen andere bedrijven daarmee in te spelen op de veranderende digitale wereld. Deze organisatie bestaat grotendeels uit jonge medewerkers. Ook organiseert het team geregeld momenten om samen te komen, voor lunch of gezellige avonden.

Met jouw ervaring en drive breng je een positieve sfeer in het team. Je weet hoe je mensen mee moet krijgen en bent niet bang om keuzes te maken. Daarnaast heb je:

  • Minstens zeven jaar ontwikkelervaring als .NET Developer;

  • Het is een grote pré als je ervaring hebt met het begeleiden van developers;

  • Kennis van het .NET platform op basis van C#;

  • Kennis om webapplicaties te schrijven met ASP.NET;

  • Kennis om applicaties te hosten op Azure;

  • Naast de stacks, ook kennis van TDD, CI/CD en het voorkomen van incidenten;

  • Je spreekt en schrijft Nederlands.


In deze rol is het essentieel dat je vloeiend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft vanwege de communicatie met klanten en collega’s. Ook is de voorkeur dat je in de omgeving van de werkgever woont, in verband met (deels) werken op kantoor.


Kun jij je (deels) herkennen in deze vacature? Reageer dan vooral! We gaan graag met jou in gesprek om jou beter te leren kennen. Neem contact met ons op!

title: Senior Art Director – Fashion
description:
At INDG, we’re looking for a Senior Art Director to join our Fashion vertical. This role takes creative ownership across high‑end CGI stills, animations, and interactive experiences for some of the world’s most recognisable sportswear, fashion, and luxury brands.

Building on INDG’s production‑driven, technology‑led approach, you will provide end‑to‑end creative leadership - from interpreting briefs and shaping visual concepts through to guiding teams and safeguarding quality at delivery. You will work closely with Project Managers/Producers, creative technologists, and CGI teams to ensure projects are not only visually exceptional, but also scalable, efficient, and aligned with client objectives.

CGI expertise is essential. You will be expected to direct virtual shoots and experiences both creatively and technically, with a strong understanding of lighting, composition, materials, and real‑world product representation.

About INDG

INDG is a technology company specialising in large‑scale CGI content creation, digital twin production, and automated content generation at global scale. We help brands turn physical products into hyper‑realistic digital twins that power still imagery, animation, interactive experiences, and content automation across B2B and B2C channels.

We combine over two decades of CGI expertise with proprietary technology to virtualise content production - blending creativity, technology, and process. Our teams operate across Amsterdam, Bucharest, and New York, supporting clients across fashion, sportswear, luxury, next to our other industry verticals such as automotive, consumer electronics, and more.

Our culture brings together creative, tech, and business talent. We value ownership, collaboration, and craft - and we’re driven by a shared ambition to make every product playable.

What you will do

  • Own the creative vision and execution quality across multiple projects, from concept to final delivery

  • Interpret client briefs and translate business and brand objectives into clear creative direction

  • Develop and communicate concepts using pitch decks, style proposals, mood boards, storyboards, sketches, and visual references

  • Direct CGI teams on composition, lighting, materials, camera, and overall look & feel

  • Ensure visual consistency, realism, and brand alignment across stills, animations, and interactive outputs

  • Perform ongoing creative QA, reviewing renders and animations, providing clear feedback, and helping teams troubleshoot scenes to reach the desired quality

  • Collaborate closely with Project Managers/Producers to align creative ambition with scope, timelines, and production realities

  • Act as a senior creative partner in client conversations—presenting, defending, and evolving concepts with confidence

  • Stay up to date with contemporary design, fashion visualisation, CGI, and real‑time/AI‑driven production trends

  • Support scalable ways of working by contributing to visual standards, best practices, and creative guidelines

  • Lead and inspire international teams of experienced CGI artists, fostering quality, ownership, and collaboration

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in a senior art direction or lead creative role, ideally within CGI, fashion, or agency environments

  • Strong background in CGI art direction, with hands‑on understanding of 3D pipelines, virtual production, and digital lighting

  • Proven ability to lead creative teams and maintain high quality under tight timelines

  • Excellent eye for detail, composition, and realism - supported by a strong portfolio or reel

  • Experience working directly with brands and stakeholders, with confidence in presenting and explaining creative decisions

  • Comfortable balancing creative ambition with production constraints, milestones, and delivery pressure

  • Hands‑on mindset: able to jump into production when needed and independently lead smaller projects end‑to‑end

  • Passion for product and product storytelling - fashion experience is a strong plus

  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English

Working at INDG

At INDG we develop technology that enables engaging, hyper-realistic digital product experiences. Our goal is to make "every product playable", by combining the science of technology with the artistry of computer-generated content. Our offices are in Amsterdam, Bucharest and New York. Clients include adidas, Honda, Yamaha, Ralph Lauren, Electrolux, and Philips. Our CG artists, interactive designers, and developers focus on creating virtual versions of our clients' products, so lifelike it feels like you could reach out and touch them.

Our culture brings together creative, tech and business individuals. It’s a heady cocktail that keeps us inspired, empowered and passionate. We’re committed to excellence, and we’re always looking for more people who want to focus their care and attention on making beauty scalable through technology.

The procedure

Please send your resume and portfolio in English via the link provided. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact our Recruitment Department at jobs@indg.com.

title: IT Networking & Radio Frequency Engineer
description:
Je vindt hier een korte omschrijving van deze vacature. Nog vragen? Of benieuwd of dit een passende rol voor jou is? Neem contact met ons op!

Als IT Networking & Radio Frequency Engineer houd jij je bezig met het ontwerpen, implementeren en onderhouden van draadloze communicatie- en netwerkoplossingen voor onbemande systemen en C5ISR-componenten. Je werkt aan tactische communicatie, RF-linkverbindingen, software gedefinieerde radio’s en high-performance netwerken die opereren in veeleisende omgevingen. Ook voer je frequentieplanningen, spectrumanalyses en storingsonderzoeken uit om sterke en veilige verbindingen te creëren.

Dit Nederlandse bedrijf is gespecialiseerd in netwerkgerichte lucht-, land- en zee robotica-oplossingen voor militaire en civiele toepassingen. Het bedrijf is internationaal actief. De werkwijze binnen het bedrijf is uitvinden of iets werkt door het gewoon te doen.

Jij bent een ‘problem solver’ en hebt een analytische blik. Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische, high-tech omgeving. Door de internationale klanten reis je wanneer nodig naar het buitenland. Daarnaast heb je:

  • Hbo/wo-diploma in Elektrotechniek, ICT, Netwerkengineering of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Drie jaar ervaring in IT-netwerken of RF-communicatie;

  • Kennis van netwerktechnologieën als Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Ubiquiti, SD=WAN, VPN, Vlan of QoS;

  • Ervaring met RF-technieken en radiofrequentiesystemen als VHF/UHF, SDR, LTE of SATCOM;

  • Kennis van netwerkbeveiliging en encryptietechnologieën;

  • Ervaring met Wireshark, MATLAB, SDR-software spectrum analyzers en RF testapparatuur;

  • Vloeiend in Nederlands en Engels, Duits en Frans is pre.

title: Senior Mobile QA
description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior QA for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation. We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.


This is a hybrid role working from any Waracle London office 2 days per week.

Are you a quality champion who thrives on collaboration and technical excellence? We are looking for a Senior QA who values a supportive environment where your expertise in mobile and backend testing will help shape the future of our digital products. At Waracle, we believe that diverse perspectives drive the best innovations, and we’re looking for a thoughtful mentor to help our teams grow while ensuring we deliver seamless, high-quality experiences for our users.

In this position, you will be a technical driver for quality, focusing on high-impact mobile delivery while ensuring backend integrity. You will:

  • Lead Mobile Strategy: Define QA approaches for complex features across iOS and Android, integrating risk analysis and leading exploratory testing efforts.

  • Architect Automation: Design and implement modular, reusable, and scalable automation components for mobile platforms, integrating quality checks directly into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Champion Quality & NFRs: Independently design and automate tests for performance, security, and accessibility (A11y) to ensure our products are inclusive and robust.

  • Collaborate & Influence: Work closely with developers to improve system testability through better logging and test hooks, and lead defect triage sessions to prioritise fixes based on business impact.

  • Drive Technical Standards: Own initiatives such as mobile regression standards and stay at the forefront of mobile testing trends to ensure world-class delivery.

What you'll bring:

  • Mobile Testing Mastery: Deep experience in mobile testing across iOS and Android, with experience setting up mobile automation frameworks from the ground up.

  • Automation Toolkit: Extensive experience with mobile automation frameworks such as Appium, Detox, or Maestro.

  • Programming Skills: Proficiency in either C#, Typescript or Python.

  • Feature Validation: Expert knowledge in validating A/B testing scenarios and feature flag logic to ensure seamless user journeys.

  • Infrastructure Knowledge: Proficiency with Git and experience defining and integrating automated quality gates into CI/CD pipelines

  • Communication: Proven ability to communicate quality risks clearly in terms of business and financial impact.

Desirable

  • Experience with React Native or Flutter and a focus on ensuring quality across different mobile platforms.

The Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Chat: You’ll have a call with your dedicated Talent Acquisition Partner to talk about Waracle, your career goals, and the “important stuff” like salary and benefits.

  2. Two-Stage Process: You’ll be invited to showcase your skills and find out more about the role.

  3. Supportive Onboarding: Your Talent Partner will guide you through the whole process right up to your first day.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays (35 days total).

  • Financial Future: Company-matched 5% pension contribution and Death in Service benefit (2 x annual salary).

  • Health & Wellness: Medicash Health Cash Plans, Employee Assistance Programme, and Group Sickness Cover.

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid working with a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable.

  • Learning & Development: Access to Udemy Business and a dedicated L&D budget for continuous growth.

  • Family First: Enhanced parental leave policies, including support for fertility journeys.

  • Community: Regular fun meet-ups, monthly office lunch, and the Spirit of Waracle charitable initiative.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Software-Defined Datacenter (SDDC) Consultant
description:
Join the Nordic Startup with a 25-Year Legacy

We are expanding the ITQ team across the Nordics, and we are operating with the agility and energy of a startup, but backed by the stability of a highly respected company that started 25 years ago in the Netherlands.

As a premier VMware Pinnacle Partner, ITQ maintains a laser focus on VMware technology. In a changing market, our exclusive specialization means we are the trusted, go-to partner for high-profile customers and the most complex engagements. If you are deeply passionate about technology and want to work with the absolute best in the industry, this is your safe harbor and your launchpad.

About the role

As an SDDC Consultant, you will dive straight into a massive, ready-to-go pipeline of technical projects. You will support our clients in transforming traditional datacenters into modern, flexible, and efficient software-defined environments. You jump in and save the day by simplifying complex datacenter infrastructures, reducing costs, and improving overall performance.

While you might be one of the first on the ground in your country, you will never be a "lone wolf." You will operate remotely with high autonomy, while being fully backed by our powerful virtual network of top-tier European experts.

Your responsibilities and technologies:

  • You have a solid background in technologies such as VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), VCF Operations, VMware NSX, and Red Hat OpenShift.

  • You are hands-on with Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI) solutions; practical experience here is essential.

  • You possess architectural skills related to SDDC and have a strong understanding of x86 virtualization, operating systems, and advanced networking/storage.

  • You are driven by a passion for technology. While current certifications are a plus, a proven track record is what matters most—along with a strong willingness to pursue further certifications once you join.

Who you are:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in IT consultancy, engineering, or architecture.

  • You are highly self-dependent, proactive, and excited about the "startup mentality" of building a local culture from the ground up.

  • You are fluent in English AND at least one Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, or Danish).

  • You’re passionate about technology; maybe even a bit obsessed (we like that).

Working at ITQ offers some awesome perks

We don’t just see you as an employee, but as a whole person. You’ll get the freedom, trust, and support to develop in the way that suits you best.

  • Ultimate Flexibility: Flexible working hours and location, work from where you are best, as long as customer requirements are fulfilled.

  • Solid Foundation: A highly competitive salary package, including a robust pension plan.

  • Continuous Growth: An annual training & certification budget, including fully funded certifications to keep you at the top of your game.

  • The ITQ Culture: Built on Passion, Authenticity, Ownership, and Quality. Comprehensive onboarding at our HQ in the Netherlands, followed by an informal lunch or dinner with your internal "buddy."

  • #ITQlife: Collaboration with top experts, regular knowledge sessions, global networking opportunities, and our legendary annual team weekend.

description:
About NutriSense

If you are a Senior Data Engineer with experience, please read on!


NutriSense is a 100% remote health-tech startup on a mission to optimize metabolic health and prevent chronic diseases through personalized nutrition for All. Our mobile application leverages continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) with access to virtual support from registered dieticians so that everyone, not just diabetics, can learn about their unique food responses, understand their glucose biomarkers, and reach health goals that lead to an optimized life.


We are VC-backed and tech-forward. Over the last 12 months we have experienced a 6x increase in revenue, currently experiencing 10% MoM increase in new customers. Our customers range from the ultra-healthy trying to take their life to new levels to the diabetic trying to manage their disease. Our platform focuses on bringing customized solutions for your metabolic health in the palm of your hands.


If you are a Senior Data Engineer interested in joining a mission-driven tech startup that is disrupting the health industry and cares about creating a dynamic and gamified working environment for its employees, apply immediately!

  • In This Role You Will Be:

    • Building the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL and AWS “big data” technologies

    • Designing, developing, and owning data pipelines and models that will power the internal analytics used for product and business teams

    • Leading project within the operations team to identify, design, and implement internal process improvements, automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, upgrading systems, re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability in the efforts to speed up business growth

    • Removing roadblocks, like old systems and old thinking, so that the organization as a whole can keep running at full speed

    • Identifying data needs for business and product teams by deeply understanding their specific requirements for data usage, like metrics and analysis, and building efficient and scalable solutions to enable effective data-driven decision making

    • Collaborating in a cross-functional distributed team environment where your self-starting, natural desire to learn personality will thrive

    To Thrive In This Role You Will Need:

    • BS in CS, or equivalent degree

    • 3+ years experience with:

      • Advanced working knowledge of SQL and experience working with relational databases, query authoring (SQL), and familiarity with a variety of databases

      • Proficient with programming languages JavaScript or Ruby

      • Prior experience building and optimizing AWS “big data” technology pipelines, architectures, and data sets

      • Prior experience answering specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement by performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes

    • Excellent communication and organizational skills

    Preferred Qualifications:

    • MS or PhD in CS, Data Science, or equivalent field

    • Strong analytical skills related to working with unstructured datasets

    • Driven to make a lasting impact on a startup organization

    Total Compensation Package For This Role Includes:

    • Gamified Compensation - Your Choice of Competitive Base Salary + Equity Options

    • 100% Remote Environment

    • Excellent Health Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision

    • Unlimited PTO - 1-week Minimum!

    • Work From Home Reimbursement

    • Health & Fitness Reimbursement

    • NutriSense Discounts

    • And Much Much More!

    So, if you are a Senior Data Engineer with experience, apply today!

description:
Safety Training Instructor

Escaping from a helicopter, surviving at sea or fighting a raging fire. We start every day full of positive energy, eager to teach everyone who participates in our training courses all there is to know about the potential dangers in the offshore industry. Does this sound perfect for you? Then we are looking for you to join our team in Gray, Louisiana!

About us

FMTC Safety is the safety training center for Offshore training (OPITO & NOGEPA), Wind training (GWO), Maritime training (STCW), and Industry training. Every day people are prepared to work and live safely on a drilling platform or a ship.

At FMTC, flexibility is our top priority! We reduce the burden of the customer entirely in the field of training. We do this through our customer-focused services, flexibility, knowledge, and extra services in addition to our training courses.
In addition to our Dordrecht location, we also have various locations worldwide; Schiphol Amsterdam(NL), Lage Zwaluwe(NL), IJmuiden(NL), Houma (USA), Dunkirk (FR) and Ras Tanura (KSA).

What does your day as an Offshore Training Course Instructor at FMTC look like?

Every day is a new challenge. You arrive at one of our unique locations and happily, you start your day. What course is planned for today? A Sea Survival? A HUET, where the participants need to escape from a helicopter simulator while it’s in the water? Or maybe something totally different. In any case, you teach all the courses in a good-natured and creative manner.

After teaching the theory, you support the participants of the course in putting the theory into practice. All courses are simulated in a realistic setting.

Who are we looking for?

  • You have industry experience - Forklift, Heavy Equipment Operating, Confined Space, Rigging

  • You are creative, stress-resistant and bring your good mood with you to work

  • You are client-oriented; it gives you energy to know that the participants love your training course

What can you expect from us?

An awesome, varied job, where every day presents you with a new challenge. Never taught training courses before, but you have been active in the Offshore sector? Then your new colleagues would be happy to teach you all about this line of work.

This function can be perfectly combined with that of an Offshore employee or part-time employee. You will receive a salary in line with the job scale as well as attractive secondary benefits.

title: Drømmer du om at bidrage til en flok dejlige børn og unges læring ved at ”fylde” dem med god mad?
description:
Skæring Skoles kantine søger en dygtig kok, ernæringsassistent e.l., der brænder for at lave mad til skolens ca. 850 elever.

Stillingen er en fast stilling, og du bliver en del af et engageret team, der med mange forskellige funktioner understøtter, at skolens elever får sund og ernæringsrigtig skolemad.

Skæring Skole har siden 2012 haft madordning for skolens elever, idet alle elever spiser et ”pædagogisk måltid” sammen med deres klasse, og vi serverer hver dag ca. 500 frokostmåltider.

Vi vægter fællesskab, maddannelse og bæredygtighed og derfor har vi også sølvmærket i økologi.

Køkkenteamet har – og du vil få – en meget vigtig opgave i at finde den gode balance mellem at tilbyde eleverne mad, de kan lide, dække deres ernæringsmæssige behov og at udfordre dem, så de også lærer og tør prøve nye ting. Vi har elever til at hjælpe med madlavningen. Ud over frokostmåltidet, står skolens køkken også for morgenmad, formiddags- og eftermiddagssnacks, mad til fritidsklubben og til diverse arrangementer samt dagligt disksalg.

Der arbejdes i øjeblikket med at afprøve forskellige modeller for madordninger på skoler i Aarhus Kommune, der er fokus herpå både fra det lokalpolitiske og landsdækkende politiske niveau. Når rådmanden for Børn og Unge taler om produktionskantiner, er Skæring Skoles kantine en af dem, der hentes erfaringer fra, da skolen i efterhånden mange år har haft madordning.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø på en stor skole, som er præget af skønne børn og voksne, hvor vi vægter en god tone blandt voksne såvel som børn
  • Arbejdstid kl. 6.00 til 14.3
  • Arbejdstid fordelt på hverdage i skoleuger samt sidste uge i skolernes sommerferie
  • Vi er et ambitiøst og samtidig uformelt køkkenteam, så der er store muligheder for at præge udviklingen på alle måder
  • Vi har en frisk uformel omgangstone, og selvom vi har travlt, har vi altid tid et godt grin

Din profil:
Vi søger en ansvarsbevidst og fleksibel uddannet kok eller ernæringsassistent med fokus på høj faglighed. Du bliver en af nøglemedarbejderne til at give børn og voksne en god madoplevelse og du:

  • Brænder for sund og lækker veltilberedt mad
  • Godt overblik over produktionen i stressede perioder
  • Lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, der er præget af børn og unge
  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og i team
  • Har godt humør, gode samarbejdsevner og er pligtopfyldende.
  • Er morgenfrisk og mødestabil.
  • Har fokus på renlighed og ryddelighed


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Stillingen er aflønnet på fuld tid 37 timer med tiltrædelse snarest muligt dog senest 1. oktober.

Arbejdstiden er fordelt på 41 skoleuger, dvs. at du arbejder ca. 40½ time/uge i de 41 uger.

Arbejdstiden vil som udgangspunkt ligge i tidsrummet mellem kl. 6.00 – 14.30

De endelige arbejdstider aftales nærmere.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer.

Ansættelse er til enhver tid betinget af en tilfredsstillende offentlig straffeattest og en anmærkningsfri børneattest.


Hvis du vil vide mere:
Ønsker du yderligere oplysninger omkring stillingen, kan du kontakte kantineleder Mette Tange på telefon 2053 3662 eller administrationsleder Jette Jul Nevado på telefon 25377553 .

Skulle du have lyst til at se arbejdspladsen inden du søger, er det muligt at lave en aftale med Mette for et uformelt besøg.

Ansøgning
Har dette vakt din interesse ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning. Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist: mandag den 24. august kl. 12.00. Samtaler forventes afholdt onsdag den 26. august fra kl. 13.00.

Om os
Du kan læse mere om os og vores madordning her

Formelt vil du blive ansat på Skæring Skole, men personaleledelsen udføres af det Administrative Fællesskab, som er en del af Administration og Rådgivning i Børn og Unge-forvaltningen. Din fysiske placering vil være på Skæring Skole. Det administrative fællesskab består af administrative medarbejdere og køkkenpersonale på Skæring Skole, Sølystskolen, Elsted skole og Lystrup skole – vi er i alt ca. 26 medarbejdere.

Med fast arbejdsplads i Skæring Skoles kantine bliver du en del af et positivt, dedikeret og ambitiøst personale med et stærkt sammenhold. Vores gode samarbejde med ledelse, lærere og pædagoger er medvirkende til, at vi er en stærk del af fællesskabet og de mange gode sociale arrangementer på skolen.

Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde. Vi værdsætter derfor og bidrager alle til en uformel omgangstone, men også et forpligtende samarbejde, hvor det gode arbejdsmiljø er i fokus.

Aarhus Kommune er Jyllands største arbejdsplads. 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer arbejder hver dag for, at vi er en god by for alle. Som ansat i Aarhus Kommune gør du visioner til virkelighed og skaber udvikling, fællesskab og trivsel. Her er der respekt for faglighed, plads til mangfoldighed og mulighed for udfoldelse. Vi har ambitioner for byen - og for dig. Kom og vær med!

Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. title: Security Engineer
description:
Are you ready to turn your passion for technology into concrete results? At ITQ, we make a difference for our clients by providing innovative IT platforms and advanced application management. As the Managed Service Provider (MSP) business unit within ITQ, we ensure a secure and up-to-date IT infrastructure and offer a wide range of services, from cloud solutions and data centers to end-user computing.

As a Security Engineer at ITQ, you will play a crucial role within our security team, helping to provide a secure platform for our clients. You will collaborate with colleagues who share your enthusiasm for technology. Currently, our security portfolio includes Trend Micro, MS Defender, and Carbon Black. We are looking for someone to strengthen our team with expertise in Trend Micro.

Job Description:
As a Security Engineer, you will ensure that our clients' environments are up-to-date and support various MSP departments (Digital Workspace and Hybrid Cloud) with their security-related needs. You will stay informed about developments at the client and assess their impact on the client’s data center. In this role, you will also be responsible for lifecycle management, incidents, and changes related to the Trend Micro portfolio. Additionally, you will be involved in projects where we roll out new environments and onboard clients, providing support as a project team member.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Implementing and maintaining the Trend Micro infrastructure. In the future, we will expand our portfolio to include MS Defender and Trend Micro’s cloud-based solutions.

  • Analyzing and resolving security-related incidents.

  • Performing standard changes in the client environment.

  • Advising on and establishing best practices for our security products.

  • Building our new security proposition together with the product owner and security team.

What we are looking for:

  • At least three years of relevant work experience. Experience with maintenance/implementation is a plus.

  • Knowledge and experience with Trend Micro products such as Apex One, Apex Central, etc.

  • Ambition to further enhance your security knowledge with MS Defender and Trend Vision One, etc.

  • A structured and systematic approach.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to provide service-oriented and customer-friendly support.

  • Passion for IT, ownership, and a willingness to further develop your technical knowledge and contribute to the team.

What we offer:

As an ITQ’er, you are part of a unique organization (if we may say so ourselves). We support each other, share knowledge, and are truly an ITQ family. We offer:

  • A challenging and varied role in a fast-growing organization.

  • Room for personal and professional development.

  • A competitive salary package, including the possibility of a mobility budget, collective bonus, and an annual budget for training and certification.

  • A home base with offices in Houten and Beverwijk, with the option to work remotely (hybrid).

  • The opportunity to work on exciting projects for leading clients.

  • An inspiring work environment with a collegial and informal culture.

About ITQ
ITQ has a strong and well-established position in all VMware competencies, with deep knowledge of related technologies such as Microsoft, Google, AWS, HashiCorp, and NVIDIA. Originally focused on consultancy services, ITQ has invested in managed services solutions for its clients in recent years.

With a team of talented and passionate professionals, we strive to help our clients achieve their goals through innovative and efficient IT solutions. Our culture is characterized by collaboration, continuous improvement, and a strong focus on customer satisfaction.

Interested?
We look forward to hearing from you!

Dit neem je mee

Je hebt minimaal drie jaar relevante werkervaring en een stevige technische basis binnen security. Je wilt niet alleen uitvoeren, maar ook invloed hebben op technische keuzes en dienstverlening.

We zoeken iemand met:

  • Minimaal drie jaar ervaring als Security Engineer, Security Consultant, SOC Engineer of in een vergelijkbare functie

  • Ervaring met het implementeren of verbeteren van technische securityoplossingen

  • Brede kennis van endpoints, infrastructuur, identity, netwerken, workloads en cloud

  • Ervaring met loganalyse, securityalerts, incidenten en detectie en respons

  • Een gestructureerde werkwijze, eigenaarschap en uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands

description:
gravity9 is a boutique IT consulting company headquartered in the UK with offices in the US, Canada, Poland, and Colombia. We enjoy a challenge and pride ourselves on working with our clients on their most complex problems, finding elegant and flexible solutions that help them transform their businesses.

Join Our Growing Team - Future Opportunities Await!

We are excited to share that our company is experiencing significant growth and expansion, and as a result, we're on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

We want to be upfront about our hiring process. At this moment, we are in the process of securing projects that align with our business goals and objectives. Our intention is to ensure that once we bring new team members on board, they will have a meaningful and impactful role to play from day one. If you're open to the idea of potentially joining our team in the future, we encourage you to continue with our interview process. We value your time and effort and believe that getting to know you better will help us make an informed decision.

Once you have effectively concluded the entire recruitment procedure, we will retain your profile and reach out to you once a suitable opportunity emerges. Additional interviews will not be necessary at this stage, and we anticipate being able to extend an offer to you promptly.

What does the recruitment process look like?

1. Recruiter Screen

In the first call, our recruiter will learn more about you and your story to check a potential fit for gravity9. This is also an opportunity to ask your questions about the role and company. This step might take around 60 mins.

2. Tech 1 Interview with our software consultants

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.

This step will take around 90 mins.

3. Tech 2 Interview with our tech leads

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.

This step will take around 90 mins.

4. Final Interview

You made it to the very last stage! Here we already strive to cooperate with you and give you an opportunity to meet our leadership team during this informal talk. This step will take around 30 mins.

The salary details for the role will be communicated ahead of the first recruitment meeting.

Role Description

We are looking for a smart, enthusiastic backend software engineer with experience in MongoDB and a keen interest in current technology and engineering. Using your knowledge of Java and MongoDB, and engineering best practices, you will be involved in helping clients to adopt the latest version of MongoDB across a suite of their application. You will take an active lead in team discussions and code reviews and work collaboratively with your colleagues to identify, prioritise and deliver features which bring value to our clients. You will also guide less experienced developers.

We believe small, multi-disciplinary teams are most effective in delivering complex change. As such, we are looking for someone with a collaborative mindset who is happy to be flexible and take on different responsibilities over the lifetime of our projects.

Role requirements - technical skills and experience

This role will suit a highly capable developer with extended working experience with Java, AND/OR Python and MongoDB (or any other NoSQL database).

Must-Have:

  • Excellent command / highly proficient in spoken and written English (working directly with UK/US-based clients)

  • Thorough understanding of Spring, especially Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Spring Data

  • Experience working with Azure or AWS

  • Understanding of Synch and Async communication (REST-based, Queue and/or Topic based (depending on technology)

  • Proficiency in working with Microservice Architecture

  • Including containerization, high availability, and failover scenarios

  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.

  • Experience in working with Docker and containerized applications

  • Experience in Maven/Gradle and working with CI/CD pipelines

Nice-to-Have:

  • AI integration

  • AWS Professional Certifications

Role requirements – soft skills

Key attributes and behaviours to succeed in this role will be:

  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements

  • Customer Focus – passion for understanding the problem we are trying to solve with software and to advocate solutions to your client.

  • Delivery focus - strong analysis and problem-solving skills. Ability to evaluate, design and implement effective solutions. Flexibility to adapt skills to a spectrum of client engagements, use cases and modes of change delivery.

  • Exemplary standards of personal integrity and respect for others – professional approach to all aspects of client engagement and collaborative team working, able to quickly build relationships based on trust and transparency. Strong presentation and written and verbal communication are essential given the client facing nature of the role.

  • Value driven - Creative thinking, with aptitude for innovation and strong desire to exceed client expectations.

  • Energy – positive attitude and determination to learn and succeed.

title: Analista de Redes (CGR) - Pleno
description:
Buscamos um profissional com experiência prática em redes de provedores de internet, perfil analítico e autonomia para investigar falhas, executar configurações e conduzir mudanças controladas em ambientes críticos e multivendor.

Sobre o NIIS

O NIIS (Network Intelligence & Infrastructure Services), empresa do IPV7 Group, atua no monitoramento, gerenciamento, suporte avançado, arquitetura e evolução de redes de telecomunicações para provedores, operadoras e empresas.

Aqui, você atuará em ambientes reais e críticos, com diferentes fabricantes, tecnologias e arquiteturas. Oferecemos desenvolvimento contínuo, apoio técnico e incentivo a treinamentos e certificações relevantes para a função.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atender e acompanhar incidentes, requisições e mudanças relacionados à infraestrutura de rede;
  • Realizar troubleshooting em redes de camada 2 e 3, identificando causas, impactos e ações de correção;
  • Configurar e manter roteadores, switches e demais equipamentos de rede;
  • Analisar interfaces, tabelas MAC e ARP, rotas, adjacências, logs e contadores para diagnóstico;
  • Atuar com VLAN, QinQ, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP, OSPF, IS-IS, BGP e MPLS/LDP, conforme cada ambiente;
  • Elaborar procedimentos de mudança com validações, testes e estratégia de rollback;
  • Executar e acompanhar janelas programadas, garantindo comunicação e controle dos riscos;
  • Registrar atividades e decisões técnicas nos chamados, cumprindo os SLAs definidos;
  • Interagir com clientes, operadoras, fornecedores e equipes técnicas em diagnósticos e escalonamentos;
  • Manter documentações, diagramas, inventários e padrões de configuração atualizados;
  • Identificar falhas recorrentes, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar analistas menos experientes.

Conhecimentos necessários

  • Conhecimento intermediário de TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, subnetting e alta disponibilidade;
  • Switching: VLAN, QinQ, STP/RSTP/MSTP e LACP;
  • Roteamento estático e dinâmico, com experiência prática em OSPF e BGP e noções de IS-IS;
  • Capacidade de analisar rotas, políticas, adjacências, convergência, latência, perda de pacotes e utilização de interfaces;
  • Experiência com configuração e troubleshooting via CLI em equipamentos de redes;
  • Familiaridade com ping, traceroute, MTR, tcpdump ou Wireshark e consultas DNS;
  • Noções de MPLS/LDP, NAT, QoS, redundância de gateway e serviços de camada 2;
  • Noções de Linux, SSH, SNMP, Syslog e análise de logs;
  • Vivência com gestão de incidentes, mudanças, documentação técnica e cumprimento de SLA;
  • Boa comunicação, organização, senso de prioridade e disponibilidade para escala, plantões ou janelas programadas.

Será um diferencial

  • Experiência em CGR, NOC ou suporte de provedores, operadoras ou empresas de telecomunicações;
  • Vivência multivendor com Huawei, Nokia, Cisco, Juniper, MikroTik, Datacom, ZTE ou FiberHome;
  • Conhecimento de MPLS/LDP, VPLS, BNG/BRAS, PPPoE, RADIUS, CGNAT, OLTs ou redes de acesso;
  • Automação com Python, Ansible ou scripts e familiaridade com Git;
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes, telecomunicações, Linux, ITIL ou áreas relacionadas.

Perfil que buscamos

  • Perfil analítico e investigativo, com capacidade para identificar a causa dos problemas;
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade para conduzir análises e mudanças compatíveis com a função;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e equilíbrio para atuar em ambientes críticos;
  • Proatividade para identificar riscos e propor melhorias;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e se comunicar com clientes e parceiros.

Experiência necessária

Experiência em operação, suporte ou gerenciamento de redes, preferencialmente em provedores ou operadoras, com vivência prática em configuração de equipamentos, troubleshooting de conectividade e acompanhamento de mudanças.

description:
We are looking for a visionary Head of Content to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role will be responsible for overseeing all content-related activities, including social media, podcasts, UX copy, in-app educational content, and ad copy. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in creating compelling content, with a preference for experience in the health technology sector.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Content Strategy: Develop and implement a comprehensive content strategy that aligns with our brand goals and engages our target audience.

  • Social Media Management: Oversee the creation, scheduling, and management of content across all social media platforms to drive engagement and brand awareness.

  • Podcast Production: Manage the production of our health-related podcasts, including topic selection, guest coordination, and promotional strategies.

  • UX and In-App Copy: Collaborate with the UX/UI team to create intuitive, user-friendly copy for our apps, ensuring an educational and engaging user experience.

  • Passion for Health Tech: Genuine interest in health technology and a commitment to creating content that educates and engages.

MANUAL delivers healthcare at scale thanks to its comprehensive digital clinic. Our ambition is to extend the healthy years of lives for a large part of the population in the UK, Brazil, and beyond focusing on life-impeding conditions like hormonal imbalance, obesity and hair loss.


MANUAL has steadily grown since inception and is now serving 500k+ patients, across 2 geographies. We’re destigmatising how people approach their health by offering easy access to diagnostics, a holistic range of treatments, ongoing care and medical advice, as well as a community to help proactively improve one’s health and wellbeing. A place that didn't exist until now.


Innovating on healthcare delivery, MANUAL provides patients with engaging treatment plans generating superior clinical outcomes: 90%+ of patients see an improvement in their Quality of Life (QoL) within 6 months. title: Product Designer
description:
Waracle are looking for a Product Designer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our Glasgow or Dundee office.

The Role

We're looking for a Product Designer who is ready to own the interaction and user experience for individual features or smaller projects. In this role, you’ll be an essential bridge between strategy, design, and delivery, helping to deliver high-quality, user-centric solutions.

This is more than just making things look good—it's about meticulous design thinking and ensuring every user flow is intuitive, accessible, and aligned with existing design systems.

We're looking for a motivated individual with a passion for inclusive design and excellent communication skills. If you see yourself in the skills below, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't tick every box!

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Interaction Mastery: Take full ownership of interaction design at the feature level, meticulously mapping out happy paths, unhappy paths, and error states.

  • Inclusive Design Champion: Apply accessibility (WCAG) patterns, check designs, and support inclusive language and testing practices to ensure broad usability for diverse users.

  • Prototyping & Documentation: Build low-fidelity and interactive prototypes using tools like Figma, Framer, or Bolt, and document interaction expectations for development teams.

  • Responsive Interface Design: Design responsive interfaces and basic interactions, aligning all work to the existing design system.

  • Testing & Evaluation: Design and execute user tests, including writing clear hypotheses and success criteria, and collaborating on dashboards for tracking user feedback.

What you'll bring to the role

  • Strong UI/UX design experience delivering website refreshes, content migration projects, and scalable digital experiences, including feature-level design and complex user flows covering happy paths, edge cases, and error states.

  • Proven experience designing top-level pages, templates, and reusable components within design systems, with a strong understanding of Content Management System platforms, front-end infrastructure, and technical constraints.

  • Strong foundation in inclusive design and accessibility standards, applying best practices throughout the design process.

  • Experience planning, conducting, and evaluating user research and testing to validate decisions and drive evidence-based improvements.

  • Proficient in modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Framer, and Bolt, creating clear and effective interactive solutions.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and collaboration skills, with experience working across multidisciplinary teams including developers, BAs, copywriters, testers, and stakeholders to support end-to-end delivery..

The Recruitment Process

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!).

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your portfolio, skills and experience. Your Talent Attraction Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

title: Product owner
description:
Dit is een algemene vacature, we kennen verschillende bedrijven waar ze iemand voor een soortgelijke functie zoeken. We gaan graag met je in gesprek om te kijken of we jou kunnen matchen aan een bedrijf uit ons netwerk.

Als product owner ben je verantwoordelijk voor het bepalen van de visie en het leiden van de ontwikkeling van producten. Je zult fungeren als de stem van de klant binnen het team en samenwerken met verschillende belanghebbenden om de behoeften van de gebruikers te begrijpen en te vertalen naar waardevolle en bruikbare functionaliteiten. Deze rol biedt een uitstekende kans om invloed uit te oefenen op de productstrategie en bij te dragen aan de groei en het succes van ons bedrijf.

Dit kunnen jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Definiëren en prioriteren van de product backlog op basis van de visie van het product, klantfeedback en zakelijke vereisten.

  • Werken aan het opstellen van gedetailleerde user stories, requirements en acceptatiecriteria in samenwerking met het ontwikkelingsteam.

  • Fungeren als de primaire contactpersoon tussen het ontwikkelingsteam en andere belanghebbenden, zoals klanten, management en marketing.

  • Zorgen voor een duidelijke communicatie van de productvisie, doelstellingen en prioriteiten aan alle betrokkenen.

  • Faciliteren van sprint planning, review en retrospective meetings om ervoor te zorgen dat het ontwikkelingsteam effectief en efficiënt kan werken.

  • Actief betrokken zijn bij de voortgang van het ontwikkelingsproces en het leveren van feedback aan het team om de kwaliteit en waarde van het product te waarborgen.

  • Regelmatig feedback verzamelen van klanten en gebruikers om de productstrategie te valideren en aan te passen.

  • Voortdurend onderzoeken van markttrends, concurrentieanalyse en gebruikersgedrag om kansen voor productverbetering te identificeren.

  • Samenwerken met marketing- en verkoopteams om productlanceringen te plannen en marketingcampagnes te ondersteunen.

  • Optreden als een leider en mentor binnen het team en het bevorderen van een cultuur van samenwerking, innovatie en continue verbetering.

In deze rol is het essentieel dat je vloeiend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft vanwege de communicatie met klanten en collega’s. Ook is de voorkeur dat je in de omgeving van de werkgever woont, in verband met (deels) werken op kantoor.


Dit is een algemene vacature, zonder directe link aan een bedrijf. We gaan graag met je in gesprek om te kijken of we jou kunnen matchen aan een bedrijf uit ons netwerk. Door jou beter te leren kennen, op de hoogte te zijn van jouw kennen, kunnen en wensen, kunnen wij gericht voor jou gaan zoeken. Neem je contact met ons op?

title: Partner (Sydney, Melb)
description:
As a tech-centric business law firm - think AI, FinTech, Robotics, IoT, AdTech/MarTech, Healthtech, CleanTech, BioTech, etc. we are working with some of the leading companies in their fields as well as the disruptors. Our clients include startups and scaleups, established corporates, private equity firms, fund managers, and angel and venture capital investors.

Most importantly. we are fiercely committed to creating an awesome team environment for both personal and professional achievement.This is your career, and our aim is to supercharge it through the people, the work, and the programs that fuel who we are.

The role:

We are actively seeking a seasoned Partner to join our AU practice. If you crave a challenge within a dynamic, remote-first environment and want to collaborate with a global network of colleagues who live and breathe tech, this is your opportunity. We offer true flexibility, with full or part time options, remote for Partner level, and hybrid approaches. Tell us about what will work for you.

  • Be instrumental in helping to lead our Australian practice. You’ll collaborate with colleagues across the US and EMEA who have steered rapidly growing ventures.

  • Drive business development for the firm. For us, business development means using your network, being engaged in the startup community & thinking about whats next for your clients.

  • Find creative and innovative solutions to client challenges, activating real growth across all facets of technology law

  • Deliver exceptionally high-quality, detailed legal work that sets us apart.

  • Take ownership of key client relationships and matters.

  • Act as a trusted guide, enabling tech innovators to achieve their objectives.

  • Embrace complex problem-solving, proactively driving meaningful results.

  • Cultivate productive relationships internally and externally.

  • Provide pragmatic, actionable legal advice, fostering collaboration within our diverse global team

You will bring:

  • Our Partners require true excellence. You’ll have a track record as a 10 year+ PQE Qualified lawyer.

  • You are a generalist passionate about the diverse challenges faced by tech clients yet come with deep expertise in your field. Particularly within areas like Corporate Commercial, Cyber & Data Privacy, IP or Financing

  • Our nice to have’s include being dual qualified in another jurisdiction, experience from both high-level external legal service (top tier law, or boutique firms) and in-house roles and a robust professional network.

  • You think critically, are intellectually curious, and a highly resourceful problem solver.

  • Adept at understanding and integrating emerging technologies, particularly AI, into legal practice to enhance client solutions and firm efficiency

  • You’re a natural communicator who connects authentically with startup/scaleup founders and C -suite teams, understanding their challenges

  • You work creatively, finding pragmatic solutions even with incomplete information

  • Proficiency in breaking down complexity and developing logical, actionable strategies.

  • You possess a self-starter mentality, comfortable working independently, taking ownership, and driving results.

  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills, valuing independence.

  • You have a venturous, pioneering spirit ready to help lay the foundations for our success in our home market

What else you need to know:

  • Competitive compensation with both a bonus package and profit share program.

  • Have kids? Undertaking further study? Live out of town? We get you! While some client travel may be required, we can offer both reduced hours and flexible working

  • Our team is based in The Commons on George Street Sydney, but if you operate from Melbourne please talk to us

  • Work with exceptional clients from high growth startups to established tech companies to tech investors, often with an international element

  • Get exposure to the latest tech deals and trends in the industry

  • Parental leave and a flexible return-to-work plan.

title: Senior Delivery Manager
description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Delivery Manager for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role working from either our Glasgow, Dundee or London office 2 days a week

The Role

Are you a collaborative delivery leader who excels at bringing people together, nurturing talent, and guiding complex projects to success? As a Senior Delivery Manager at Waracle, you’ll play a pivotal role in creating supportive, high-performing environments where cross-functional teams can thrive. You will lead complex digital transformations end-to-end, serving as a trusted advisor to clients while mentoring the next generation of delivery talent. If you enjoy empowering teams, tackling big ideas, and building meaningful partnerships, we’d love to welcome you aboard.


Key aspects of the role include:

  • Empowering & Coaching Teams: Coach cross-functional team members on estimation and prioritisation, fostering an environment where self-organisation, resilience, and psychological safety can flourish.

  • Proactive Risk Management: Facilitate RAID sessions and guide risks to resolution in alignment with our Delivery Playbook, keeping projects smooth and transparent.

  • Governance & Quality Delivery: Partner with teams to ensure large project outcomes meet quality standards, embedding best practices and "Definition of Done" outcomes.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Bring together Product, Design, and Engineering to build shared clarity on outcomes, manage dependencies, and celebrate shared wins.

  • Stakeholder Partnership: Navigate complex discussions with empathy, simplify technical delivery topics, and build consensus among stakeholders.

  • Thoughtful Commercial Stewardship: Use budget forecasting proactively to adapt team shape and spend, keeping projects healthy and aligned.

  • Building Practice Capability: Mentor junior and mid-level Delivery Managers and help lead Community of Practice initiatives like tooling or delivery metrics.

What you'll bring:

  • Pragmatic expertise in multiple digital delivery frameworks (such as Agile, Lean, XP, or Waterfall) and a passion for adapting them to fit your team's unique needs.

  • Proven experience managing risks and de-risking complex technical projects through open communication and structure.

  • Strong commercial awareness, with comfort around budget forecasting and resource allocation.

  • A genuine passion for coaching, mentoring, and lifting up talent around you.

  • Clear, empathetic communication skills with a track record of building trusted relationships across clients and internal teams

The recruitment process you can expect for this role is an initial call with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner who will chat with you about Waracle, what you are looking for in a new position, the salary for the role, notice period and benefits (the important stuff!).

After that, you'll be invited to a two-stage interview process where you have an opportunity to find out more about the role and showcase your skills and experience. Your Talent Attraction Partner will guide you through the whole process to your first day with us.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.
